玉臂匠。金石篆刻天下第一，伪刻蔡京印信救宋江，掌梁山兵符印信。.en: Jade-Armed Craftsman. The foremost seal engraver, who forges Cai Jing's seal to save Song Jiang. He oversees Liangshan's military tallies and official seals.
玉臂匠。金石篆刻天下第一，伪刻蔡京印信救宋江，掌梁山兵符印信。.ja: 玉臂匠。金石篆刻の第一人者。蔡京の印を偽造して宋江を救い、梁山の兵符と印信を掌る。
玉臂匠。金石篆刻天下第一，伪刻蔡京印信救宋江，掌梁山兵符印信。.zh_TW: 玉臂匠。金石篆刻天下第一，偽刻蔡京印信救宋江，掌梁山兵符印信。

铁笛仙。黄门山头领，能吹铁笛、使双刀，风流潇洒，马军小彪将。.en: Iron-Flute Immortal. A Huangmen Mountain leader who plays an iron flute and wields twin blades. A dashing junior cavalry commander.
铁笛仙。黄门山头领，能吹铁笛、使双刀，风流潇洒，马军小彪将。.ja: 鉄笛仙。黄門山の頭領。鉄笛を吹き、双刀を使う風流な馬軍小彪将。
铁笛仙。黄门山头领，能吹铁笛、使双刀，风流潇洒，马军小彪将。.zh_TW: 鐵笛仙。黃門山頭領，能吹鐵笛、使雙刀，風流瀟灑，馬軍小彪將。

出洞蛟。浔阳江私盐贩，李俊心腹，水中蛟龙，水军头领，后随李俊出海。.en: Cave-Emerging Dragon. Salt smuggler of the Xunyang River and trusted follower of Li Jun, a dragon in the water. A naval commander who later sails overseas with Li Jun.
出洞蛟。浔阳江私盐贩，李俊心腹，水中蛟龙，水军头领，后随李俊出海。.ja: 出洞蛟。潯陽江の塩密売人で李俊の腹心。水中の蛟竜のような水軍頭領。のちに李俊と海へ出る。
出洞蛟。浔阳江私盐贩，李俊心腹，水中蛟龙，水军头领，后随李俊出海。.zh_TW: 出洞蛟。潯陽江私鹽販，李俊心腹，水中蛟龍，水軍頭領，後隨李俊出海。

翻江蜃。童威之弟，水底功夫了得，水军头领，与兄同随李俊浮海。.en: River-Churning Clam. Tong Wei's younger brother and a skilled swimmer. A naval commander who sails overseas with his brother and Li Jun.
翻江蜃。童威之弟，水底功夫了得，水军头领，与兄同随李俊浮海。.ja: 翻江蜃。童威の弟。水中の技に優れた水軍頭領で、兄と共に李俊に従って海を渡る。
翻江蜃。童威之弟，水底功夫了得，水军头领，与兄同随李俊浮海。.zh_TW: 翻江蜃。童威之弟，水底功夫了得，水軍頭領，與兄同隨李俊浮海。

玉幡竿。身长面白如幡竿，造船监工巧匠，督造梁山战船，征方腊阵亡。.en: Jade Banner Pole. Tall and pale as a banner pole, a skilled shipbuilder and overseer. He supervises Liangshan's warship construction and dies in the Fang La campaign.
玉幡竿。身长面白如幡竿，造船监工巧匠，督造梁山战船，征方腊阵亡。.ja: 玉幡竿。幡竿のように背が高く色白。造船の名工で監督役。梁山の軍船建造を指揮し、方臘征討で戦死。
玉幡竿。身长面白如幡竿，造船监工巧匠，督造梁山战船，征方腊阵亡。.zh_TW: 玉幡竿。身長面白如幡竿，造船監工巧匠，督造梁山戰船，徵方臘陣亡。

通臂猿。洪都裁缝，臂长善缝，掌梁山旌旗袍袄，征方腊溺亡钱塘。.en: Long-Armed Ape. A tailor of Hongdu with long arms and expert sewing skills. He makes Liangshan's banners and clothing, then drowns at Qiantang in the Fang La campaign.
通臂猿。洪都裁缝，臂长善缝，掌梁山旌旗袍袄，征方腊溺亡钱塘。.ja: 通臂猿。洪都の仕立屋。腕が長く裁縫に秀で、梁山の旗や衣服を掌る。方臘征討で銭塘に溺死する。
通臂猿。洪都裁缝，臂长善缝，掌梁山旌旗袍袄，征方腊溺亡钱塘。.zh_TW: 通臂猿。洪都裁縫，臂長善縫，掌梁山旌旗袍襖，徵方臘溺亡錢塘。

跳涧虎。少华山头领，使出白点钢枪，借粮华阴遇史进，三人共聚少华山。.en: Ravine-Leaping Tiger. A Shaohua Mountain leader wielding a polished steel spear. While seeking grain in Huayin, he encounters Shi Jin; three heroes unite at Shaohua Mountain.
跳涧虎。少华山头领，使出白点钢枪，借粮华阴遇史进，三人共聚少华山。.ja: 跳澗虎。少華山の頭領。点鋼槍を使う。華陰へ食糧を求めに行って史進に出会い、三人で少華山に集う。
跳涧虎。少华山头领，使出白点钢枪，借粮华阴遇史进，三人共聚少华山。.zh_TW: 跳澗虎。少華山頭領，使出白點鋼槍，借糧華陰遇史進，三人共聚少華山。

白花蛇。少华山头领，使大杆刀，与朱武、陈达结义，后随史进归梁山。.en: White-Spotted Snake. Leader of Shaohua Mountain, armed with a great pole blade. Sworn brother to Zhu Wu and Chen Da, he later follows Shi Jin to Liangshan.
白花蛇。少华山头领，使大杆刀，与朱武、陈达结义，后随史进归梁山。.ja: 白花蛇。少華山の頭領。大杆刀を使い、朱武・陳達と義を結ぶ。のちに史進と梁山へ入る。
白花蛇。少华山头领，使大杆刀，与朱武、陈达结义，后随史进归梁山。.zh_TW: 白花蛇。少華山頭領，使大桿刀，與朱武、陳達結義，後隨史進歸梁山。

白面郎君。清风山头领，面白如玉、使浑铁枪，与燕顺王英同伙，后上山。.en: White-Faced Gentleman. A Qingfeng Mountain leader with a face pale as jade and an iron spear, companion to Yan Shun and Wang Ying before joining Liangshan.
白面郎君。清风山头领，面白如玉、使浑铁枪，与燕顺王英同伙，后上山。.ja: 白面郎君。清風山の頭領。玉のように白い顔で渾鉄槍を使い、燕順・王英と行動する。のちに入山。
白面郎君。清风山头领，面白如玉、使浑铁枪，与燕顺王英同伙，后上山。.zh_TW: 白麵郎君。清風山頭領，面白如玉、使渾鐵槍，與燕順王英同夥，後上山。

九尾龟。庄家出身，使铁锹、善掘壕筑寨，梁山专司土工，润州阵亡。.en: Nine-Tailed Turtle. A farmer armed with a shovel, skilled at digging trenches and building stockades. Liangshan's earthworks specialist, killed at Runzhou.
九尾龟。庄家出身，使铁锹、善掘壕筑寨，梁山专司土工，润州阵亡。.ja: 九尾亀。農家の出身。鉄鍬を使い、塹壕掘りと築寨を得意とする。梁山の土木を専らとし、潤州で戦死。
九尾龟。庄家出身，使铁锹、善掘壕筑寨，梁山专司土工，润州阵亡。.zh_TW: 九尾龜。莊家出身，使鐵鍬、善掘壕築寨，梁山專司土工，潤州陣亡。

铁扇子。宋江之弟，随兄上山，掌梁山筵宴庆赏，招安后辞官归乡务农。.en: Iron Fan. Song Jiang's younger brother, who joins him at Liangshan and manages feasts and celebrations. After the amnesty, he leaves office to farm in his hometown.
铁扇子。宋江之弟，随兄上山，掌梁山筵宴庆赏，招安后辞官归乡务农。.ja: 鉄扇子。宋江の弟。兄と入山し、梁山の宴席と祝賀を掌る。招安後に辞官し、郷里で農業を営む。
铁扇子。宋江之弟，随兄上山，掌梁山筵宴庆赏，招安后辞官归乡务农。.zh_TW: 鐵扇子。宋江之弟，隨兄上山，掌梁山筵宴慶賞，招安後辭官歸鄉務農。

铁叫子。登州小牢子，能歌善唱、机灵伶俐，参与劫牢，掌梁山歌乐宣赞。.en: Iron Whistle. A clever young jailer of Dengzhou and gifted singer. He joins the prison rescue and oversees Liangshan's music and proclamations.
铁叫子。登州小牢子，能歌善唱、机灵伶俐，参与劫牢，掌梁山歌乐宣赞。.ja: 鉄叫子。登州の若い獄卒。歌が上手く機転が利く。牢破りに加わり、梁山の歌楽と宣唱を掌る。
铁叫子。登州小牢子，能歌善唱、机灵伶俐，参与劫牢，掌梁山歌乐宣赞。.zh_TW: 鐵叫子。登州小牢子，能歌善唱、機靈伶俐，參與劫牢，掌梁山歌樂宣贊。

小遮拦。揭阳镇穆弘之弟，与兄称霸一方，随兄上山，征方腊后辞官归乡。.en: Lesser Unrestrained. Mu Hong's younger brother of Jieyang Town, sharing his local power. He follows his brother to Liangshan and returns home after resigning office following the Fang La campaign.
小遮拦。揭阳镇穆弘之弟，与兄称霸一方，随兄上山，征方腊后辞官归乡。.ja: 小遮攔。掲陽鎮の穆弘の弟。兄と一帯を支配して入山し、方臘征討後に辞官して郷里へ帰る。
小遮拦。揭阳镇穆弘之弟，与兄称霸一方，随兄上山，征方腊后辞官归乡。.zh_TW: 小遮攔。揭陽鎮穆弘之弟，與兄稱霸一方，隨兄上山，徵方臘後辭官歸鄉。

操刀鬼。林冲徒弟、屠户出身，献计智取二龙山，掌梁山屠宰，征方腊阵亡。.en: Knife-Wielding Devil. Lin Chong's pupil and a butcher. He devises the plan to take Twin Dragon Mountain, manages Liangshan's slaughtering, and dies in the Fang La campaign.
操刀鬼。林冲徒弟、屠户出身，献计智取二龙山，掌梁山屠宰，征方腊阵亡。.ja: 操刀鬼。林冲の弟子で屠夫の出身。二竜山智取の計を立て、梁山の屠畜を掌る。方臘征討で戦死。
操刀鬼。林冲徒弟、屠户出身，献计智取二龙山，掌梁山屠宰，征方腊阵亡。.zh_TW: 操刀鬼。林沖徒弟、屠戶出身，獻計智取二龍山，掌梁山屠宰，徵方臘陣亡。

云里金刚。梁山开山元老，身躯高大，守山寨关隘，润州乱军阵亡。.en: Guardian in the Clouds. A towering founding veteran of Liangshan who guards the mountain passes. He falls amid the fighting at Runzhou.
云里金刚。梁山开山元老，身躯高大，守山寨关隘，润州乱军阵亡。.ja: 雲裏金剛。梁山草創の古参。大柄な体で山寨の関所を守り、潤州の乱戦で戦死。
云里金刚。梁山开山元老，身躯高大，守山寨关隘，润州乱军阵亡。.zh_TW: 雲裡金剛。梁山開山元老，身軀高大，守山寨關隘，潤州亂軍陣亡。

摸着天。梁山开山元老，身材瘦高，与宋万同守关隘，清溪乱军阵亡。.en: Sky-Toucher. A tall, thin founding veteran of Liangshan who guards the passes with Song Wan. He falls amid the fighting at Qingxi.
摸着天。梁山开山元老，身材瘦高，与宋万同守关隘，清溪乱军阵亡。.ja: 摸着天。梁山草創の古参。痩せた長身で宋万と関所を守り、清渓の乱戦で戦死。
摸着天。梁山开山元老，身材瘦高，与宋万同守关隘，清溪乱军阵亡。.zh_TW: 摸著天。梁山開山元老，身材瘦高，與宋萬同守關隘，清溪亂軍陣亡。

病大虫。江湖卖艺使枪棒，落魄遇宋江，大名府内应放火，征方腊阵亡。.en: Sick Tiger. A wandering spear-and-staff performer who meets Song Jiang in poverty. He sets fires as an inside agent at Daming and dies in the Fang La campaign.
病大虫。江湖卖艺使枪棒，落魄遇宋江，大名府内应放火，征方腊阵亡。.ja: 病大虫。槍棒で見世物をする旅芸人。困窮中に宋江と出会う。大名府では内応して放火し、方臘征討で戦死。
病大虫。江湖卖艺使枪棒，落魄遇宋江，大名府内应放火，征方腊阵亡。.zh_TW: 病大蟲。江湖賣藝使槍棒，落魄遇宋江，大名府內應放火，徵方臘陣亡。

打虎将。卖艺师父、史进开手师，桃花山头领，后随鲁智深武松归梁山。.en: Tiger-Slaying General. A martial performer and Shi Jin's first teacher, later leader of Peach Blossom Mountain. He joins Liangshan with Lu Zhishen and Wu Song.
打虎将。卖艺师父、史进开手师，桃花山头领，后随鲁智深武松归梁山。.ja: 打虎将。武芸の見世物師で史進の最初の師。桃花山の頭領となり、魯智深・武松と共に梁山へ帰順。
打虎将。卖艺师父、史进开手师，桃花山头领，后随鲁智深武松归梁山。.zh_TW: 打虎將。賣藝師父、史進開手師，桃花山頭領，後隨魯智深武松歸梁山。

小霸王。桃花山头领，强抢民女被鲁智深痛打，使点钢枪，后归梁山。.en: Little Conqueror. Leader of Peach Blossom Mountain, beaten by Lu Zhishen for trying to abduct a village girl. A steel-spear fighter who later joins Liangshan.
小霸王。桃花山头领，强抢民女被鲁智深痛打，使点钢枪，后归梁山。.ja: 小覇王。桃花山の頭領。村娘を奪おうとして魯智深に打たれる。点鋼槍を使い、のちに梁山へ入る。
小霸王。桃花山头领，强抢民女被鲁智深痛打，使点钢枪，后归梁山。.zh_TW: 小霸王。桃花山頭領，強搶民女被魯智深痛打，使點鋼槍，後歸梁山。

鬼脸儿。李家庄主管，貌丑怪、机警善应对，随李应上山。.en: Demon Face. Steward of Li Family Manor, ugly in appearance but quick-witted and resourceful. He follows Li Ying to Liangshan.
鬼脸儿。李家庄主管，貌丑怪、机警善应对，随李应上山。.ja: 鬼臉児。李家荘の主管。容貌は異様だが機転と応対に優れ、李応と共に入山する。
鬼脸儿。李家庄主管，貌丑怪、机警善应对，随李应上山。.zh_TW: 鬼臉兒。李家莊主管，貌醜怪、機警善應對，隨李應上山。

出林龙。登云山草莽，与侄邹润打家劫舍，随杨林上山，步军头领。.en: Forest-Emerging Dragon. An outlaw of Dengyun Mountain who raids homes with his nephew Zou Run. He follows Yang Lin to Liangshan and becomes an infantry commander.
出林龙。登云山草莽，与侄邹润打家劫舍，随杨林上山，步军头领。.ja: 出林竜。登雲山の草莽。甥の鄒潤と屋敷を襲い、楊林と入山して歩軍頭領となる。
出林龙。登云山草莽，与侄邹润打家劫舍，随杨林上山，步军头领。.zh_TW: 出林龍。登雲山草莽，與侄鄒潤打家劫舍，隨楊林上山，步軍頭領。

独角龙。邹渊之侄，后脑生肉瘤如角、能以头触树，与叔同上梁山。.en: One-Horned Dragon. Zou Yuan's nephew, with a horn-like growth on the back of his head and a headbutt strong enough to strike trees. He joins Liangshan with his uncle.
独角龙。邹渊之侄，后脑生肉瘤如角、能以头触树，与叔同上梁山。.ja: 独角竜。鄒淵の甥。後頭部に角のような瘤があり、頭で木に体当たりする。叔父と共に梁山へ入る。
独角龙。邹渊之侄，后脑生肉瘤如角、能以头触树，与叔同上梁山。.zh_TW: 獨角龍。鄒淵之侄，後腦生肉瘤如角、能以頭觸樹，與叔同上梁山。

旱地忽律。梁山泊酒店店主、山寨眼线总管，迎来送往、通报军情。.en: Dry-Land Crocodile. Tavern keeper by Liangshan Marsh and chief of its informants, greeting travelers and passing along intelligence.
旱地忽律。梁山泊酒店店主、山寨眼线总管，迎来送往、通报军情。.ja: 旱地忽律。梁山泊の酒店主で、山寨の情報網をまとめる。旅人を迎え送りし、軍情を伝える。
旱地忽律。梁山泊酒店店主、山寨眼线总管，迎来送往、通报军情。.zh_TW: 旱地忽律。梁山泊酒店店主、山寨眼線總管，迎來送往、通報軍情。

笑面虎。朱贵之弟，开酒店惯下蒙汗药，赚李云上山，掌山寨酒店。.en: Smiling Tiger. Zhu Gui's younger brother, a tavern keeper adept with sedatives. He tricks Li Yun into joining Liangshan and manages the stockade's taverns.
笑面虎。朱贵之弟，开酒店惯下蒙汗药，赚李云上山，掌山寨酒店。.ja: 笑面虎。朱貴の弟。酒店を開き、蒙汗薬を使い慣れる。李雲を計略で入山させ、山寨の酒店を掌る。
笑面虎。朱贵之弟，开酒店惯下蒙汗药，赚李云上山，掌山寨酒店。.zh_TW: 笑面虎。朱貴之弟，開酒店慣下蒙汗藥，賺李雲上山，掌山寨酒店。

铁臂膊。大名府押狱兼刽子手，膀大力沉，受托保全卢俊义、石秀，后归梁山。.en: Iron Arms. Daming's jailer and executioner, broad-shouldered and powerful. He protects Lu Junyi and Shi Xiu at others' request, then joins Liangshan.
铁臂膊。大名府押狱兼刽子手，膀大力沉，受托保全卢俊义、石秀，后归梁山。.ja: 鉄臂膊。大名府の押獄兼処刑人。肩幅広く力強い。頼まれて盧俊義と石秀を守り、のちに梁山へ入る。
铁臂膊。大名府押狱兼刽子手，膀大力沉，受托保全卢俊义、石秀，后归梁山。.zh_TW: 鐵臂膊。大名府押獄兼劊子手，膀大力沉，受託保全盧俊義、石秀，後歸梁山。

一枝花。蔡福之弟，行刑却鬓边簪花，与兄同护卢俊义，后归梁山。.en: Single Flower. Cai Fu's younger brother, an executioner who wears a flower at his temple. He helps protect Lu Junyi and later joins Liangshan.
一枝花。蔡福之弟，行刑却鬓边簪花，与兄同护卢俊义，后归梁山。.ja: 一枝花。蔡福の弟。処刑人ながら鬢に花を挿す。兄と盧俊義を守り、のちに梁山へ入る。
一枝花。蔡福之弟，行刑却鬓边簪花，与兄同护卢俊义，后归梁山。.zh_TW: 一枝花。蔡福之弟，行刑卻鬢邊簪花，與兄同護盧俊義，後歸梁山。

催命判官。揭阳岭黑店主，惯使蒙汗药剪径，与李俊相识，后上梁山。.en: Death-Dealing Judge. Owner of a murderous inn at Jieyang Ridge, accustomed to sedating and robbing travelers. An acquaintance of Li Jun who later joins Liangshan.
催命判官。揭阳岭黑店主，惯使蒙汗药剪径，与李俊相识，后上梁山。.ja: 催命判官。掲陽嶺の悪質な宿屋の主。蒙汗薬で旅人を襲って奪い、李俊と知り合う。のちに入山。
催命判官。揭阳岭黑店主，惯使蒙汗药剪径，与李俊相识，后上梁山。.zh_TW: 催命判官。揭陽嶺黑店主，慣使蒙汗藥剪徑，與李俊相識，後上梁山。

青眼虎。沂水县都头，眼带青光、刚直善战，受朱富蒙汗药赚上山。.en: Blue-Eyed Tiger. Constable of Yishui County, blue-eyed, upright, and skilled in battle. Zhu Fu's drugged wine tricks him into joining Liangshan.
青眼虎。沂水县都头，眼带青光、刚直善战，受朱富蒙汗药赚上山。.ja: 青眼虎。沂水県の都頭。青い眼で剛直、戦いに長ける。朱富の蒙汗薬の計で梁山へ入る。
青眼虎。沂水县都头，眼带青光、刚直善战，受朱富蒙汗药赚上山。.zh_TW: 青眼虎。沂水縣都頭，眼帶青光、剛直善戰，受朱富蒙汗藥賺上山。

没面目。相扑高手，性冷漠不近人情，李逵荐之上山，步军头领。.en: Faceless. A master wrestler, cold and aloof. Li Kui recommends him to Liangshan, where he becomes an infantry commander.
没面目。相扑高手，性冷漠不近人情，李逵荐之上山，步军头领。.ja: 没面目。相撲の達人。冷淡で人付き合いを好まない。李逵の推薦で入山し、歩軍頭領となる。
没面目。相扑高手，性冷漠不近人情，李逵荐之上山，步军头领。.zh_TW: 沒面目。相撲高手，性冷漠不近人情，李逵薦之上山，步軍頭領。

石将军。江湖赌徒、使朴刀，传宋江家书牵线，落草梁山，步军头领。.en: Stone General. A wandering gambler who uses a broadsword. Carrying Song Jiang's family letter connects him to Liangshan, where he becomes an infantry commander.
石将军。江湖赌徒、使朴刀，传宋江家书牵线，落草梁山，步军头领。.ja: 石将軍。江湖の賭博師で朴刀を使う。宋江の家書を届けた縁で梁山に落草し、歩軍頭領となる。
石将军。江湖赌徒、使朴刀，传宋江家书牵线，落草梁山，步军头领。.zh_TW: 石將軍。江湖賭徒、使朴刀，傳宋江家書牽線，落草梁山，步軍頭領。

小尉迟。孙立之弟，与妻顾大嫂开店，劫牢救解珍解宝，随兄破祝家庄。.en: Little Yuchi. Sun Li's younger brother, who runs an inn with his wife Gu Dasao. He rescues Xie Zhen and Xie Bao from prison and helps his brother take Zhu Family Manor.
小尉迟。孙立之弟，与妻顾大嫂开店，劫牢救解珍解宝，随兄破祝家庄。.ja: 小尉遅。孫立の弟。妻の顧大嫂と店を営み、牢を破って解珍・解宝を救う。兄と祝家荘を破る。
小尉迟。孙立之弟，与妻顾大嫂开店，劫牢救解珍解宝，随兄破祝家庄。.zh_TW: 小尉遲。孫立之弟，與妻顧大嫂開店，劫牢救解珍解寶，隨兄破祝家莊。

母大虫。孙新之妻，泼辣彪悍、使双刀，劫登州大牢救表弟，梁山三女将之一。.en: Tigress. Sun Xin's fierce wife, wielding twin blades. She raids Dengzhou prison to rescue her cousins and becomes one of Liangshan's three women generals.
母大虫。孙新之妻，泼辣彪悍、使双刀，劫登州大牢救表弟，梁山三女将之一。.ja: 母大虫。孫新の妻。気が強く勇猛で双刀を使う。従弟を救うため登州の牢を破る。梁山の三女将の一人。
母大虫。孙新之妻，泼辣彪悍、使双刀，劫登州大牢救表弟，梁山三女将之一。.zh_TW: 母大蟲。孫新之妻，潑辣彪悍、使雙刀，劫登州大牢救表弟，梁山三女將之一。

菜园子。十字坡黑店主，孙二娘之夫，与武松结义，后上二龙山归梁山。.en: Gardener. Owner of a murderous inn at Crossroads Slope and husband of Sun Erniang. He becomes Wu Song's sworn brother, then joins Twin Dragon Mountain and later Liangshan.
菜园子。十字坡黑店主，孙二娘之夫，与武松结义，后上二龙山归梁山。.ja: 菜園子。十字坡の悪質な宿屋の主で孫二娘の夫。武松と義兄弟となり、二竜山を経て梁山へ入る。
菜园子。十字坡黑店主，孙二娘之夫，与武松结义，后上二龙山归梁山。.zh_TW: 菜園子。十字坡黑店主，孫二孃之夫，與武松結義，後上二龍山歸梁山。

母夜叉。十字坡黑店女老板，张青之妻，蒙汗药做人肉包，助武松扮行者，三女将之一。.en: She-Demon. Mistress of the murderous inn at Crossroads Slope and wife of Zhang Qing. She drugs travelers for human-flesh buns and helps Wu Song disguise himself as a pilgrim. One of the three women generals.
母夜叉。十字坡黑店女老板，张青之妻，蒙汗药做人肉包，助武松扮行者，三女将之一。.ja: 母夜叉。十字坡の悪質な宿屋の女主人で張青の妻。蒙汗薬を使って人肉饅頭を作り、武松の行者姿への変装を助ける。三女将の一人。
母夜叉。十字坡黑店女老板，张青之妻，蒙汗药做人肉包，助武松扮行者，三女将之一。.zh_TW: 母夜叉。十字坡黑店女老闆，張青之妻，蒙汗藥做人肉包，助武松扮行者，三女將之一。

活闪婆。建康府江边卖酒，身轻脚快奔走如飞，随张顺上山，专司探事走报。.en: Living Flash. A wine seller by the river at Jiankang, light-footed and swift. He follows Zhang Shun to Liangshan and specializes in scouting and carrying messages.
活闪婆。建康府江边卖酒，身轻脚快奔走如飞，随张顺上山，专司探事走报。.ja: 活閃婆。建康府の川辺の酒売り。身軽で足が速い。張順と入山し、探索と伝令を専らとする。
活闪婆。建康府江边卖酒，身轻脚快奔走如飞，随张顺上山，专司探事走报。.zh_TW: 活閃婆。建康府江邊賣酒，身輕腳快奔走如飛，隨張順上山，專司探事走報。

险道神。身长一丈的巨汉，原曾头市人，反正归梁山，掌中军帅字大旗。.en: God of the Perilous Path. A giant one zhang tall, originally of Zengtou Town. He changes sides to join Liangshan and carries the commander's great central banner.
险道神。身长一丈的巨汉，原曾头市人，反正归梁山，掌中军帅字大旗。.ja: 険道神。身長一丈の巨漢で、もとは曾頭市の人。寝返って梁山に入り、中軍の大将旗を掌る。
险道神。身长一丈的巨汉，原曾头市人，反正归梁山，掌中军帅字大旗。.zh_TW: 險道神。身長一丈的巨漢，原曾頭市人，反正歸梁山，掌中軍帥字大旗。

鼓上蚤。江湖第一飞贼，飞檐走壁、轻功盖世，盗甲赚徐宁、火烧翠云楼，神出鬼没。.en: Flea on a Drum. The greatest burglar in the realm, unmatched at scaling roofs and walls. He steals armor to lure Xu Ning and sets fire to Cuiyun Tower, appearing and vanishing like a ghost.
鼓上蚤。江湖第一飞贼，飞檐走壁、轻功盖世，盗甲赚徐宁、火烧翠云楼，神出鬼没。.ja: 鼓上蚤。江湖随一の盗賊。屋根と壁を自在に走り、軽功に並ぶ者がない。鎧を盗んで徐寧を誘い、翠雲楼を焼く。神出鬼没。
鼓上蚤。江湖第一飞贼，飞檐走壁、轻功盖世，盗甲赚徐宁、火烧翠云楼，神出鬼没。.zh_TW: 鼓上蚤。江湖第一飛賊，飛簷走壁、輕功蓋世，盜甲賺徐寧、火燒翠雲樓，神出鬼沒。

金毛犬。涿州盗马好汉，赤发黄须，盗照夜玉狮子马献宋江，掌梁山买马。.en: Golden-Haired Hound. A horse thief from Zhuozhou, with red hair and yellow whiskers. He steals the Night-Shining Jade Lion horse for Song Jiang and oversees Liangshan's horse purchases.
金毛犬。涿州盗马好汉，赤发黄须，盗照夜玉狮子马献宋江，掌梁山买马。.ja: 金毛犬。涿州の馬泥棒。赤髪と黄鬚を持ち、照夜玉獅子馬を盗んで宋江に献じる。梁山の馬の買い付けを掌る。
金毛犬。涿州盗马好汉，赤发黄须，盗照夜玉狮子马献宋江，掌梁山买马。.zh_TW: 金毛犬。涿州盜馬好漢，赤發黃須，盜照夜玉獅子馬獻宋江，掌梁山買馬。

及时雨宋江，表字公明，郓城县押司。平生仗义疏财、扶危济困，江湖上但闻「宋公明」三.en: Song Jiang, Timely Rain, bears the courtesy name Gongming and serves as a clerk in Yuncheng County. Generous with his wealth and ready to aid those in peril, he is so renowned that the name Song Gongming resounds throughout the wandering world. After killing Yan Poxi in anger, he becomes a fugitive. A seditious poem written while drunk at Xunyang Tower nearly sends him to the block, until Liangshan's heroes storm the execution ground to rescue him. When Heavenly King Chao dies from an arrow wound, Song Jiang takes command, raises the apricot-yellow banner of Heaven's Justice, and gathers the 108 heroes at Liangshan Marsh. He later champions imperial amnesty and leads his companions against Liao and Fang La. His campaigns succeed, but he dies at Chuzhou, leaving a name for loyalty and righteousness remembered through the ages.
及时雨宋江，表字公明，郓城县押司。平生仗义疏财、扶危济困，江湖上但闻「宋公明」三.ja: 及時雨の宋江、字は公明。鄆城県の押司を務める。義を重んじて財を惜しまず、危難にある人を助け、江湖では「宋公明」の名を知らぬ者がないほどであった。怒りに任せて閻婆惜を殺し、流浪の身となる。潯陽楼で酔って反逆の詩を書き、斬首されかけたが、梁山の好漢が刑場を襲って救出した。晁天王が矢傷で死ぬと寨主を継ぎ、「替天行道」の杏黄旗を掲げて水泊梁山に百八人を集める。のちに招安を強く主張し、皆を率いて遼と方臘を征討。功を成すも楚州で没し、その忠義の名は後世まで語り継がれる。
及时雨宋江，表字公明，郓城县押司。平生仗义疏财、扶危济困，江湖上但闻「宋公明」三.zh_TW: 及時雨宋江，表字公明，鄆城縣押司。平生仗義疏財、扶危濟困，江湖上但聞「宋公明」三字便如雷貫耳。怒殺閻婆惜亡命天涯，潯陽樓醉題反詩幾遭問斬，幸得梁山好漢劫法場相救。晁天王中箭身亡，宋江接掌山寨，豎起「替天行道」杏黃大旗，聚一百單八將於水泊梁山。後力主招安，率眾徵遼國、平方臘，功成而身死於楚州，忠義之名千古傳誦。

智多星吴用，表字学究，道号加亮先生，本是村中教书先生，却胸藏百万甲兵。黄泥冈上智.en: Wu Yong, the Resourceful Star, has the courtesy name Xuejiu and the Daoist title Master Jialiang. Though once a village teacher, his mind can command a million soldiers. His plan to take the Birthday Tribute on Huangni Ridge first reveals his genius. Luring Lu Junyi to the mountain, defeating Linked Cavalry with hooked spears, the three assaults on Zhu Family Manor, and further victories over linked formations all spring from his stratagems. Feather fan in hand, he directs armies as calmly as a conversation, Liangshan's unrivaled strategist. After Song Jiang's death, Wu Yong and Hua Rong hang themselves at Liao'er Hollow to fulfill their bond of loyalty.
智多星吴用，表字学究，道号加亮先生，本是村中教书先生，却胸藏百万甲兵。黄泥冈上智.ja: 智多星の呉用、字は学究、道号は加亮先生。村の教師でありながら、その胸には百万の兵を収めていた。黄泥岡で生辰綱を智取して名を示し、その後も盧俊義を山へ誘い、鉤鎌槍で連環馬を破り、祝家荘を三度攻め、連環の陣を崩すなど、奇計はことごとく彼から出た。羽扇を揺らし、談笑するように軍を動かす梁山随一の軍師。宋江の死後、花栄と共に蓼児窪で首をくくり、君臣の義を全うした。
智多星吴用，表字学究，道号加亮先生，本是村中教书先生，却胸藏百万甲兵。黄泥冈上智.zh_TW: 智多星吳用，表字學究，道號加亮先生，本是村中教書先生，卻胸藏百萬甲兵。黃泥岡上智取生辰綱一鳴驚人；此後賺盧俊義上山、用鉤鐮槍破連環馬、三打祝家莊、大破連環，樁樁奇計皆出其手。手搖羽扇、談笑用兵，乃梁山泊不二軍師。宋江死後，吳用與花榮同縊於蓼兒窪，以全君臣義氣。

入云龙公孙胜，蓟州人，师从二仙山罗真人，得五雷天罡正法，能呼风唤雨、驾雾腾云、役.en: Gongsun Sheng, Dragon in the Clouds, comes from Jizhou. A disciple of Master Luo on Two Immortals Mountain, he learns the orthodox Five Celestial Thunders art and can command wind and rain, ride clouds and mist, and employ spirits. The Birthday Tribute affair binds him to Chao Gai, and he joins the mountain cause. At Gaotangzhou he defeats Gao Lian's sorcery, and at Mangdang Mountain he subdues Fan Rui, displaying extraordinary power. Before the Fang La campaign, he retires after his achievements and returns to the mountains to cultivate the Dao, one of the few Liangshan heroes to meet a peaceful end.
入云龙公孙胜，蓟州人，师从二仙山罗真人，得五雷天罡正法，能呼风唤雨、驾雾腾云、役.ja: 入雲竜の公孫勝は薊州の人。二仙山の羅真人に師事し、五雷天罡の正法を授かる。風雨を呼び、霧や雲に乗り、鬼神を使う。生辰綱の一件で晁蓋と義を結び、入山して助力した。高唐州では高廉の妖術を破り、芒碭山では樊瑞を降すなど、神通力を示す。方臘征討の前に功成って退き、山へ帰って道を修めた。梁山では数少ない、安らかな最期を得た一人である。
入云龙公孙胜，蓟州人，师从二仙山罗真人，得五雷天罡正法，能呼风唤雨、驾雾腾云、役.zh_TW: 入雲龍公孫勝，薊州人，師從二仙山羅真人，得五雷天罡正法，能呼風喚雨、駕霧騰雲、役使鬼神。生辰綱一案與晁蓋結義，上山助陣；高唐州鬥法破高廉妖術，芒碭山降樊瑞，神通廣大。徵方臘前功成身退，歸山修道，是梁山少有得善終之人。

豹子头林冲，原任八十万禁军枪棒教头，武艺超群、为人忠厚。只因娘子貌美遭高衙内觊觎.en: Lin Chong, Leopard Head, once teaches spear and staff to the imperial army of eight hundred thousand. A loyal, honest man of exceptional skill, he is ruined because Gao Qiu's son covets his beautiful wife. Gao Qiu's plots lead him into White Tiger Hall, send him into exile at Cangzhou, and burn the forage depot. On a snowy night, he kills Lu Qian and his other enemies, then becomes an outlaw after the Mountain God Temple ordeal. At Liangshan he kills Wang Lun, the White-Robed Scholar, and seats Chao Gai as leader. His long serpent spear earns him a place among the Five Tiger Generals of the cavalry.
豹子头林冲，原任八十万禁军枪棒教头，武艺超群、为人忠厚。只因娘子貌美遭高衙内觊觎.ja: 豹子頭の林冲は、もと八十万禁軍の槍棒教頭。武芸に秀で、忠厚な人柄であった。美しい妻を高衙内に狙われたため、高俅の罠に掛かる。白虎堂へ迷い込み、滄州への刺配となり、飼料庫を焼かれる。雪夜に陸謙ら仇敵を手にかけ、風雪の山神廟の一件を経て憤然と落草した。梁山では白衣秀士の王倫を斬り、晁蓋を第一の座に据える。丈八の蛇矛を振るって天下に名を馳せ、馬軍五虎将に列した。
豹子头林冲，原任八十万禁军枪棒教头，武艺超群、为人忠厚。只因娘子貌美遭高衙内觊觎.zh_TW: 豹子頭林沖，原任八十萬禁軍槍棒教頭，武藝超群、為人忠厚。只因娘子貌美遭高衙內覬覦，被高俅設計：誤入白虎堂、刺配滄州道、火燒草料場，雪夜手刃陸謙等仇敵，於風雪山神廟後憤然落草。上梁山火併白衣秀士王倫，扶晁蓋坐第一把交椅。一條丈八蛇矛縱橫天下，位列馬軍五虎將。

小李广花荣，清风寨副知寨，仪表堂堂、武艺出众，尤精射术。一张铁胎弓百步穿杨、神箭.en: Hua Rong, Little Li Guang, is deputy commander of Qingfeng Fort, handsome, accomplished in arms, and especially gifted with the bow. With an iron-backed bow he can split a willow leaf at a hundred paces. He proves his skill by shooting a wild goose at Liangshan and cutting a tassel with one arrow at Zhu Family Manor, astonishing the armies. His bond with Song Jiang is as close as flesh and blood, entrusted through life and death. When Song Jiang dies by poison, Hua Rong and Wu Yong hang themselves before his grave at Liao'er Hollow. Their devotion remains a source of grief long afterward.
小李广花荣，清风寨副知寨，仪表堂堂、武艺出众，尤精射术。一张铁胎弓百步穿杨、神箭.ja: 小李広の花栄は清風寨の副知寨。容姿端麗で武芸に優れ、とりわけ弓術に長ける。鉄胎弓で百歩先の柳葉を射抜き、梁山で雁を射て腕を示し、祝家荘では一矢で飾り紐を断ち、三軍を驚かせた。宋江とは肉親にも等しい間柄で、生死を託し合う。宋江が毒酒で死ぬと、呉用と共に蓼児窪の墓前で首をくくって義を全うした。その最期は後世の人の心をも痛ませる。
小李广花荣，清风寨副知寨，仪表堂堂、武艺出众，尤精射术。一张铁胎弓百步穿杨、神箭.zh_TW: 小李廣花榮，清風寨副知寨，儀表堂堂、武藝出眾，尤精射術。一張鐵胎弓百步穿楊、神箭無雙——曾梁山泊射雁示威、祝家莊一箭斷絨絛，威震三軍。與宋江情同骨肉，生死相托；宋江飲鴆而亡，花榮與吳用雙雙自縊於蓼兒窪墳前，全其一片義氣，千載之下猶令人扼腕。

花和尚鲁智深，本名鲁达，渭州经略府提辖。为救金翠莲三拳打死镇关西，亡命途中于五台.en: Lu Zhishen, the Tattooed Monk, was originally Lu Da, a garrison officer in Weizhou. To save Jin Cuilian, he kills the Bully of the West with three punches, then takes the tonsure at Mount Wutai while fleeing. He uproots a willow, rescues Lin Chong in Wild Boar Forest, and beats the Little Conqueror Zhou Tong at Peach Blossom Village. His sixty-two-jin monk's staff strikes at injustice everywhere. Though he says he has sought no virtuous fruit and loved only killing and burning, beneath his fierce exterior lies compassion. At Six Harmonies Temple he hears the tidal bore, passes peacefully into nirvana, and attains spiritual fulfillment.
花和尚鲁智深，本名鲁达，渭州经略府提辖。为救金翠莲三拳打死镇关西，亡命途中于五台.ja: 花和尚の魯智深は、本名を魯達といい、渭州経略府の提轄であった。金翠蓮を救うため三拳で鎮関西を殺し、逃亡中に五台山で出家する。柳を根ごと引き抜き、野猪林で林冲の命を救い、桃花村では小覇王の周通を打ち据えた。六十二斤の水磨禅杖で、天下の不正を薙ぎ払う。「生涯、善果を修めず、人を殺し火を放つことばかり好んだ」と自ら語るが、その内には侠骨と優しい心があった。ついに六和寺で潮の音を聞いて入寂し、悟りに至る。
花和尚鲁智深，本名鲁达，渭州经略府提辖。为救金翠莲三拳打死镇关西，亡命途中于五台.zh_TW: 花和尚魯智深，本名魯達，渭州經略府提轄。為救金翠蓮三拳打死鎮關西，亡命途中於五臺山落髮為僧。倒拔垂楊柳、大鬧野豬林救林沖性命、桃花村痛打小霸王周通，一條六十二斤水磨禪杖橫掃天下不平。自言「平生不修善果，只愛殺人放火」，卻俠骨柔腸，終於六和寺聽潮信而圓寂，得成正果。

行者武松，清河县人，身长八尺、相貌堂堂。景阳冈上趁醉赤手空拳打死吊睛白额猛虎，名.en: Wu Song the Pilgrim, a native of Qinghe County, stands eight chi tall and cuts a handsome figure. Drunk on Jingyang Ridge, he kills a fierce white-browed tiger with his bare hands and becomes famous throughout the land. When Pan Jinlian and Ximen Qing poison his elder brother Wu Dalang, he kills the pair in revenge. Exiled to Mengzhou, he drunkenly defeats Jiang the Door God and recovers Happy Grove. Framed again by Commander Zhang, he stains Mandarin Duck Tower with blood, killing more than a dozen people. At Centipede Ridge he adopts an ascetic's appearance and becomes known as the Pilgrim. He loses an arm in the Fang La campaign and spends his remaining years at Six Harmonies Temple.
行者武松，清河县人，身长八尺、相貌堂堂。景阳冈上趁醉赤手空拳打死吊睛白额猛虎，名.ja: 行者武松は清河県の人。身長八尺、堂々たる容姿を持つ。景陽岡で酔ったまま吊睛白額の猛虎を素手で打ち殺し、天下に名を知られた。兄の武大郎を潘金蓮と西門慶が毒殺すると、二人を討って兄を弔う。孟州へ刺配されてからは酔って蒋門神を打ち、快活林を取り戻した。さらに張都監に陥れられ、鴛鴦楼で十数人を斬る。蜈蚣嶺で頭陀姿となり、以後「行者」と呼ばれた。方臘征討で片腕を失い、六和寺で余生を送る。
行者武松，清河县人，身长八尺、相貌堂堂。景阳冈上趁醉赤手空拳打死吊睛白额猛虎，名.zh_TW: 行者武松，清河縣人，身長八尺、相貌堂堂。景陽岡上趁醉赤手空拳打死吊睛白額猛虎，名震天下。兄長武大郎被潘金蓮、西門慶毒害，武松鬥殺姦夫淫婦祭兄。刺配孟州後醉打蔣門神、奪回快活林，又遭張都監陷害，血濺鴛鴦樓連殺十數口，於蜈蚣嶺改作頭陀，自此號「行者」。徵方臘斷一臂，留六和寺終老。

没羽箭张清，彰德府人，善用飞石打将——囊中石子信手掷出，百发百中、例不虚发。东昌.en: Zhang Qing, Featherless Arrow, comes from Zhangde Prefecture and excels at felling generals with thrown stones. He draws pebbles from his pouch and never misses. At Dongchang he strikes down fifteen Liangshan generals in succession; none can approach him, and Song Jiang nearly has no answer. Wu Yong's plan eventually captures him. Moved by Liangshan's righteousness, he joins and marries Qiongying. During the Fang La campaign, he fights to the death beneath Dusong Pass, a fine general lost too soon.
没羽箭张清，彰德府人，善用飞石打将——囊中石子信手掷出，百发百中、例不虚发。东昌.ja: 没羽箭の張清は彰徳府の人。袋から石を取り出して将を打つ技に長け、百発百中であった。東昌府では梁山の大将十五人を続けて打ち、誰も近寄れず、宋江も手を尽くしかける。やがて呉用の計で捕らえられ、その義に感じて帰順し、瓊英を妻とした。方臘征討では独松関の下で力戦して戦死。惜しむべき良将である。
没羽箭张清，彰德府人，善用飞石打将——囊中石子信手掷出，百发百中、例不虚发。东昌.zh_TW: 沒羽箭張清，彰德府人，善用飛石打將——囊中石子信手擲出，百發百中、例不虛發。東昌府一戰連打梁山一十五員大將，無人能近其身，宋江幾乎束手；後中吳用之計被擒，感其義氣歸順，娶瓊英為妻。徵方臘時力戰陣亡於獨松關下，一員良將，惜哉。

青面兽杨志，三代将门之后、杨家将嫡派，面有青色胎记故得诨名。原为殿司制使，押运花.en: Yang Zhi, the Blue-Faced Beast, descends from three generations of military officers and the renowned Yang family generals; a blue birthmark gives him his name. Formerly an imperial palace officer, he loses a shipment of ornamental stones, then kills the ruffian Niu Er while selling his sword in the capital. Secretary Liang later recognizes his ability and entrusts him with a Birthday Tribute worth one hundred thousand strings of cash. Chao Gai's band takes it by stratagem on Huangni Ridge. With nowhere to turn, Yang Zhi becomes an outlaw on Twin Dragon Mountain, later joining Liangshan as one of its Eight Cavalry Vanguards.
青面兽杨志，三代将门之后、杨家将嫡派，面有青色胎记故得诨名。原为殿司制使，押运花.ja: 青面獣の楊志は三代続く将門、楊家将の直系。顔の青い痣から異名を得た。もとは殿司の制使であったが、花石綱の護送を失敗し、東京で刀を売る際には無頼の牛二を殺すなど、不運を重ねる。のちに梁中書に認められ、十万貫の生辰綱を護送したが、黄泥岡で晁蓋らに智取された。行き場を失って二竜山に落草し、やがて梁山に帰順。馬軍八驃騎に列する。
青面兽杨志，三代将门之后、杨家将嫡派，面有青色胎记故得诨名。原为殿司制使，押运花.zh_TW: 青面獸楊志，三代將門之後、楊家將嫡派，面有青色胎記故得諢名。原為殿司制使，押運花石綱失陷、東京賣刀殺潑皮牛二，幾番坎坷。後得梁中書賞識，押送十萬貫生辰綱，又被晁蓋一夥智取於黃泥岡，走投無路落草二龍山，終歸梁山，位列馬軍八驃騎。

金枪手徐宁，东京金枪班教师，一手钩镰枪法独步天下。其家传宝甲雁翎砌就圈金甲，人称.en: Xu Ning, Golden Spear, is instructor of the capital's Golden Spear corps and unrivaled in the hooked-spear art. Shi Qian steals his ancestral treasure, gold-ringed armor of overlapping goose-feather plates known as the Rival of Tangni. Tang Long's scheme then draws him to Liangshan. Xu Ning teaches the hooked spear, drills the troops to mastery, and wins great merit by crushing Huyan Zhuo's Linked Cavalry. Later, on the southern campaign, he dies at Hangzhou from a poisoned arrow wound.
金枪手徐宁，东京金枪班教师，一手钩镰枪法独步天下。其家传宝甲雁翎砌就圈金甲，人称.ja: 金槍手の徐寧は東京の金槍班師範で、鉤鎌槍の腕は天下に並ぶ者がない。家伝の宝甲、雁翎砌就圏金甲は「賽唐猊」と呼ばれたが、時遷に盗まれる。湯隆の計で梁山へ誘い込まれた徐寧は鉤鎌槍を教え、兵を十分に鍛えて呼延灼の連環馬を一挙に破り、大功を立てた。のちに南征へ従い、杭州で毒矢を受けて死ぬ。
金枪手徐宁，东京金枪班教师，一手钩镰枪法独步天下。其家传宝甲雁翎砌就圈金甲，人称.zh_TW: 金槍手徐寧，東京金槍班教師，一手鉤鐮槍法獨步天下。其家傳寶甲雁翎砌就圈金甲，人稱「賽唐猊」，為時遷所盜；湯隆設計賺他上山，徐寧遂傳授鉤鐮槍法，教演已熟，一舉大破呼延灼的連環馬陣，建下奇功。後隨軍南征，於杭州中箭毒發而亡。

神行太保戴宗，江州两院押牢节级。会一道「神行法」，腿绑四个甲马、口诵神咒，便可日.en: Dai Zong, the Divine Traveler, is chief jailer of Jiangzhou's two courts. His divine-travel art uses four talismans tied to his legs and spoken charms to cover eight hundred li a day. He carries military intelligence like the wind, becoming Liangshan's eyes and ears. Condemned alongside Song Jiang over the seditious poem, he is rescued with him when the heroes storm the execution ground, and joins their cause. After amnesty and victory, he returns his official appointment and becomes a temple attendant at the Yue Temple in Tai'an, dying with a great laugh.
神行太保戴宗，江州两院押牢节级。会一道「神行法」，腿绑四个甲马、口诵神咒，便可日.ja: 神行太保の戴宗は江州両院の押牢節級。「神行法」を心得、脚に四枚の甲馬を結び、神呪を唱えると一日に八百里を走れた。軍情を飛ぶように伝える梁山の耳目となる。宋江の反詩事件で共に斬刑を宣告されるが、好漢たちの刑場襲撃で一緒に救い出され、仲間入りした。招安後に功を成すと官誥を返し、泰安州の岳廟で出家して陪堂となり、大笑いして最期を迎えた。
神行太保戴宗，江州两院押牢节级。会一道「神行法」，腿绑四个甲马、口诵神咒，便可日.zh_TW: 神行太保戴宗，江州兩院押牢節級。會一道「神行法」，腿綁四個甲馬、口誦神咒，便可日行八百里，往來傳遞軍情如飛，乃梁山耳目。因宋江反詩案一同被判斬刑，梁山好漢劫法場時與宋江同被救出，自此入夥。招安功成後，納還官誥，於泰安州岳廟陪堂出家，大笑而終。

赤发鬼刘唐，鬓边一搭朱砂记，江湖亡命好汉。为报晁盖一饭之恩，千里迢迢报送生辰纲消.en: Liu Tang, the Red-Haired Devil, is a wandering outlaw with a cinnabar-red mark at his temple. To repay Chao Gai for a meal, he travels far to bring news of the Birthday Tribute, and they take that ill-gotten wealth together. Fiery in temper and hating evil, he charges with his broadsword without regard for his own life. In the Fang La campaign he dies amid the fighting at Hangzhou's gate, unyielding to the end.
赤发鬼刘唐，鬓边一搭朱砂记，江湖亡命好汉。为报晁盖一饭之恩，千里迢迢报送生辰纲消.ja: 赤髪鬼の劉唐は、鬢に朱砂のような痣を持つ江湖の亡命好漢。晁蓋の一飯の恩に報いるため、遠路はるばる生辰綱の知らせを届け、共に不義の財を奪った。気性は火のように激しく、悪を憎み、朴刀を振るって命を惜しまず突撃する。方臘征討では杭州の城門の乱戦で没し、最後まで剛烈であった。
赤发鬼刘唐，鬓边一搭朱砂记，江湖亡命好汉。为报晁盖一饭之恩，千里迢迢报送生辰纲消.zh_TW: 赤發鬼劉唐，鬢邊一搭硃砂記，江湖亡命好漢。為報晁蓋一飯之恩，千里迢迢報送生辰綱訊息，遂同取這套不義之財。性烈如火、嫉惡如仇，使一口朴刀衝鋒陷陣從不惜命。徵方臘時於杭州城門歿於亂軍，剛烈到底。

黑旋风李逵，沂州沂水县人，小名铁牛，生得黑凛凛一身蛮力。两把板斧排头砍去，杀得性.en: Li Kui, the Black Whirlwind, comes from Yishui County in Yizhou. Nicknamed Iron Ox, he is dark and immensely strong. When his twin broad axes swing and bloodlust takes him, he no longer distinguishes friend from foe. He leaps out first in the Jiangzhou rescue, kills four tigers on Yi Ridge to avenge his mother, encounters an impostor, and causes havoc in the capital at the Lantern Festival. Reckless in every deed, he is utterly sincere. His loyalty to Song Jiang never wavers. Fearing that Li Kui will rebel after his death, Song Jiang gives him poisoned wine. Li Kui drinks with a smile, wishing to follow his elder brother even beyond death, his simple devotion bringing tears.
黑旋风李逵，沂州沂水县人，小名铁牛，生得黑凛凛一身蛮力。两把板斧排头砍去，杀得性.ja: 黒旋風の李逵は沂州沂水県の人。幼名は鉄牛。黒々とした体に並外れた力を持ち、二本の板斧で真っ向から斬り込む。興奮すると敵味方の区別もつかない。江州の刑場では真っ先に飛び出し、沂嶺では母の仇に四頭の虎を殺し、偽の李逵に出会い、元宵の東京を騒がせる。どれも無鉄砲だが心は純一であった。宋江への忠誠は揺るがず、死後の反乱を恐れた宋江に毒酒を与えられると、笑って飲み、死んでも兄に従いたいと願う。その愚直さは涙を誘う。
黑旋风李逵，沂州沂水县人，小名铁牛，生得黑凛凛一身蛮力。两把板斧排头砍去，杀得性.zh_TW: 黑旋風李逵，沂州沂水縣人，小名鐵牛，生得黑凜凜一身蠻力。兩把板斧排頭砍去，殺得性起便不分敵我。江州劫法場第一個跳出、沂嶺殺四虎為老母報仇、真假李逵、元夜鬧東京，樁樁莽撞卻一片赤誠。對宋江忠心不二——宋江恐其反，賜以鴆酒，李逵含笑飲之，願死後仍隨哥哥，憨直令人垂淚。

浪里白条张顺，浔阳江上渔牙，船火儿张横之弟。水底功夫天下无双，能在水中潜伏七日七.en: Zhang Shun, the White Streak in the Waves, is a fish broker on the Xunyang River and younger brother of Zhang Heng the Boatman. Unmatched underwater, he can remain submerged for seven days and nights and tread waves as though on level ground. He beats Li Kui in Jiangzhou, captures Huang Wenbing alive, and earns his place among the heroes. During the Fang La campaign, he infiltrates Yongjin Gate at night, is struck by many arrows, and sinks into West Lake. His heroic spirit later appears to aid the taking of Hangzhou. Honored by imperial decree as General Jinhua, he is worshiped in a dedicated temple.
浪里白条张顺，浔阳江上渔牙，船火儿张横之弟。水底功夫天下无双，能在水中潜伏七日七.ja: 浪裏白跳の張順は潯陽江の魚仲買人で、船火児の張横の弟。水中の技は天下無双で、七日七晩潜り、波の上を平地のように歩けた。江州で李逵を懲らしめ、黄文炳を生け捕りにして功を立て、仲間に入る。方臘征討では夜に湧金門へ潜入し、乱れ飛ぶ矢を受けて西湖に沈んだ。死後は英魂が現れて杭州攻略を助け、「金華将軍」に勅封され、廟に祀られた。
浪里白条张顺，浔阳江上渔牙，船火儿张横之弟。水底功夫天下无双，能在水中潜伏七日七.zh_TW: 浪裡白條張順，潯陽江上漁牙，船火兒張橫之弟。水底功夫天下無雙，能在水中潛伏七日七夜、踏浪如平地。江州揪打李逵、活捉黃文炳，立功入夥。徵方臘夜伏湧金門，身中亂箭沉於西湖；死後英魂顯聖助破杭州，敕封「金華將軍」，立廟享祀。

拼命三郎石秀，金陵建康府人，流落蓟州贩柴度日，仗义豪侠、遇事奋不顾身。识破裴如海.en: Shi Xiu, the Reckless Third, comes from Jiankang Prefecture in Jinling. Stranded in Jizhou, he earns a living selling firewood, a chivalrous man who throws himself into danger for others. He exposes Pei Ruhai's affair with Pan Qiaoyun and causes the confrontation at Cuiping Mountain. Alone, he scouts the winding paths of Zhu Family Manor; later he leaps from a building to storm the execution ground and save Lu Junyi. Such fearless daring earns his name. He dies at Changzhou in the Fang La campaign.
拼命三郎石秀，金陵建康府人，流落蓟州贩柴度日，仗义豪侠、遇事奋不顾身。识破裴如海.ja: 拚命三郎の石秀は金陵建康府の人。薊州に流れ着いて薪を売り暮らした。義侠に厚く、事があれば我が身を顧みない。裴如海と潘巧雲の密通を見抜き、翠屏山で騒動を起こす。祝家荘の曲がりくねった道を一人で探り、さらに楼から飛び降りて刑場を襲い、盧俊義を救った。全身が胆のような勇気から「拚命」の名を得る。方臘征討で常州に戦死した。
拼命三郎石秀，金陵建康府人，流落蓟州贩柴度日，仗义豪侠、遇事奋不顾身。识破裴如海.zh_TW: 拼命三郎石秀，金陵建康府人，流落薊州販柴度日，仗義豪俠、遇事奮不顧身。識破裴如海與潘巧雲姦情、大鬧翠屏山；又隻身潛探祝家莊盤陀路、跳樓劫法場救盧俊義，一身是膽，故得「拼命」之名。徵方臘於常州陣亡。

双鞭呼延灼，开国名将「铁鞭」呼延赞嫡派子孙，使两条水磨钢鞭，万夫不当。奉旨征讨梁.en: Huyan Zhuo, Twin Steel Rods, is a direct descendant of Huyan Zan, the founding general known as Iron Rod. His pair of polished steel rods makes him a match for ten thousand men. Ordered to attack Liangshan, he deploys three thousand armored horsemen linked together in charging formations, inflicting repeated defeats. Xu Ning's hooked-spear troops break the Linked Cavalry, and Huyan Zhuo escapes alone to Qingzhou. When the united heroes of the three mountains later attack Qingzhou, he is captured by stratagem. Song Jiang treats him with honor, winning his allegiance, and he becomes one of the Five Tiger Generals.
双鞭呼延灼，开国名将「铁鞭」呼延赞嫡派子孙，使两条水磨钢鞭，万夫不当。奉旨征讨梁.ja: 双鞭の呼延灼は、開国の名将「鉄鞭」呼延賛の直系の子孫。二本の水磨鋼鞭を使い、万夫不当の勇を誇る。勅命で梁山を討ち、三千の鉄騎を鎧ごとつないだ連環馬陣で突撃し、梁山を幾度も苦しめた。徐寧が教えた鉤鎌槍に陣を破られると、単騎で青州へ敗走。のちに三山の義軍が青州を攻めた際、計略で捕らえられる。宋江に礼遇されて帰順し、馬軍五虎将に列した。
双鞭呼延灼，开国名将「铁鞭」呼延赞嫡派子孙，使两条水磨钢鞭，万夫不当。奉旨征讨梁.zh_TW: 雙鞭呼延灼，開國名將「鐵鞭」呼延贊嫡派子孫，使兩條水磨鋼鞭，萬夫不當。奉旨征討梁山，擺下連環馬陣——三千鐵騎披甲相連衝鋒，梁山連番受挫。連環馬被徐寧所教鉤鐮槍法擊破後，呼延灼獨騎敗走青州；後來三山聚義攻打青州，他中計被擒，方受宋江禮待歸順，位列馬軍五虎將。

一丈青扈三娘，扈家庄庄主之女，生得眉似初春柳、脸如三月桃，使两口日月双刀。三打祝.en: Hu Sanniang, Ten-Foot Green, is the daughter of Hu Family Manor's lord, with brows like spring willow and cheeks like peach blossoms. She wields twin Sun-and-Moon blades. During the three assaults on Zhu Family Manor, she captures Wang Ying in battle, but Lin Chong later takes her alive and sends her to Elder Song's custody. After joining Liangshan, she captures Peng Qi before the Linked Cavalry. At Song Jiang's command she marries Wang Ying. Husband and wife fight together in the Fang La campaign and both perish amid the fighting.
一丈青扈三娘，扈家庄庄主之女，生得眉似初春柳、脸如三月桃，使两口日月双刀。三打祝.ja: 一丈青の扈三娘は扈家荘の主の娘。眉は春柳、顔は桃花のようで、日月双刀を使う。三打祝家荘では陣前で王英を捕らえたが、のちに林冲に生け捕られ、宋太公のもとに預けられた。梁山へ帰順してからは、連環馬の前陣で彭玘も捕らえる。宋江の命で王英に嫁ぎ、夫婦そろって方臘征討へ出陣し、二人とも乱戦の中で没した。
一丈青扈三娘，扈家庄庄主之女，生得眉似初春柳、脸如三月桃，使两口日月双刀。三打祝.zh_TW: 一丈青扈三娘，扈家莊莊主之女，生得眉似初春柳、臉如三月桃，使兩口日月雙刀。三打祝家莊時她陣前擒住王英，隨後被林沖活捉送往宋太公處看管；歸梁山後又在連環馬前陣擒住彭玘。奉宋江之命嫁與王英後，夫妻同徵方臘，雙雙歿於亂軍。

金眼彪施恩，孟州牢城管营之子，凭一身好拳脚开「快活林」酒店，称霸一方。被蒋门神倚.en: Shi En, the Golden-Eyed Leopard, is the son of Mengzhou prison camp's warden. A strong fighter, he opens the Happy Grove tavern and becomes a local power. Jiang the Door God uses powerful backing to seize his business, but the exiled Wu Song generously comes to his aid, drunkenly defeating Jiang and recovering the tavern. When later events expose them, Shi En follows Wu Song to Twin Dragon Mountain and then Liangshan, serving as an infantry commander. He dies in the Fang La campaign.
金眼彪施恩，孟州牢城管营之子，凭一身好拳脚开「快活林」酒店，称霸一方。被蒋门神倚.ja: 金眼彪の施恩は孟州牢城の管営の子。優れた拳脚を頼りに「快活林」の酒店を開き、一帯に勢力を持った。蒋門神に権勢を笠に商売を奪われるが、刺配されてきた武松が義によって助け、酔って蒋門神を打ち、快活林を取り戻す。のちに事件が露見すると武松と二竜山へ行き、梁山に帰順して歩軍頭領となる。方臘征討で戦死した。
金眼彪施恩，孟州牢城管营之子，凭一身好拳脚开「快活林」酒店，称霸一方。被蒋门神倚.zh_TW: 金眼彪施恩，孟州牢城管營之子，憑一身好拳腳開「快活林」酒店，稱霸一方。被蔣門神倚勢奪了生意，幸得刺配到此的武松仗義相助，醉打蔣門神奪回快活林。後事發，隨武松上二龍山、歸梁山，為步軍頭領，徵方臘時陣亡。

金钱豹子汤隆，打铁出身，浑身有麻点，使一柄铁瓜锤。本是延安府老种经略相公帐前军匠.en: Tang Long, the Coin-Spotted Leopard, is a pockmarked blacksmith armed with an iron melon-shaped hammer. The son of a military craftsman who served Elder Commander Zhong in Yan'an, he falls into hardship on the road. After joining Liangshan, he supplies hooked-spear designs and devises the plan to bring his cousin Xu Ning to teach the art. His efforts are crucial to the defeat of the Linked Cavalry, establishing him as Liangshan's foremost craftsman.
金钱豹子汤隆，打铁出身，浑身有麻点，使一柄铁瓜锤。本是延安府老种经略相公帐前军匠.ja: 金銭豹子の湯隆は鍛冶屋の出身で、全身に痘痕があり、鉄瓜鎚を使う。もとは延安府の老種経略相公に仕えた軍匠の子だが、江湖に落ちぶれた。梁山へ入ると鉤鎌槍の図面を献じ、従兄の徐寧を山へ誘って技を教えさせる計を立てる。連環馬攻略に第一の功を立てた、梁山軍随一の名工。
金钱豹子汤隆，打铁出身，浑身有麻点，使一柄铁瓜锤。本是延安府老种经略相公帐前军匠.zh_TW: 金錢豹子湯隆，打鐵出身，渾身有麻點，使一柄鐵瓜錘。本是延安府老種經略相公帳前軍匠之子，落魄江湖。上梁山後獻鉤鐮槍圖本、又獻計賺表兄徐寧上山傳藝，為大破連環馬立下首功，乃梁山軍中第一巧匠。

锦毛虎燕顺，山东莱州人，原为羊马贩子，后聚啸清风山为大头领，与王英、郑天寿打家劫.en: Yan Shun, the Multicolored Tiger, comes from Laizhou in Shandong. Once a sheep and horse trader, he becomes chief of Qingfeng Mountain, raiding homes with Wang Ying and Zheng Tianshou. After capturing Song Jiang as he passes through, he hears his name and immediately bows in reverence. This encounter leads to the turmoil at Qingfeng Fort. He eventually follows Song Jiang to Liangshan and becomes an infantry commander.
锦毛虎燕顺，山东莱州人，原为羊马贩子，后聚啸清风山为大头领，与王英、郑天寿打家劫.ja: 錦毛虎の燕順は山東萊州の人。もとは羊と馬の商人で、のちに清風山へ集って大頭領となり、王英・鄭天寿と屋敷を襲った。通り掛かった宋江を捕らえるが、その名を聞くや頭を下げて拝する。この出会いから清風寨の騒動へつながり、ついに宋江と梁山へ入って歩軍頭領となった。
锦毛虎燕顺，山东莱州人，原为羊马贩子，后聚啸清风山为大头领，与王英、郑天寿打家劫.zh_TW: 錦毛虎燕順，山東萊州人，原為羊馬販子，後聚嘯清風山為大頭領，與王英、鄭天壽打家劫舍。因擒得過路的宋江、又聽其名而納頭便拜，由此牽出清風寨一段風波，終隨宋江歸梁山，為步軍頭領。

百胜将韩滔，东京人氏，原任陈州团练使，使一条枣木槊。随双鞭呼延灼征剿梁山，充当先.en: Han Tao, the Hundred-Victory General, is a native of the capital and former militia commander of Chenzhou, armed with a jujube-wood lance. Serving as Huyan Zhuo's vanguard against Liangshan, he fights fiercely in the Linked Cavalry formation. Defeated and captured, he is moved by the heroes' righteousness and joins them as a junior cavalry commander. During the Fang La campaign, he is killed by a surprise arrow at Changzhou.
百胜将韩滔，东京人氏，原任陈州团练使，使一条枣木槊。随双鞭呼延灼征剿梁山，充当先.ja: 百勝将の韓滔は東京の人。もとは陳州団練使で棗木槊を使う。双鞭の呼延灼に従って梁山を討ち、先鋒として連環馬陣の中で勇猛に戦った。敗れて捕らえられると義に感じて帰順し、梁山馬軍の小彪将となる。方臘征討では常州で不意の矢を受けて死んだ。
百胜将韩滔，东京人氏，原任陈州团练使，使一条枣木槊。随双鞭呼延灼征剿梁山，充当先.zh_TW: 百勝將韓滔，東京人氏，原任陳州團練使，使一條棗木槊。隨雙鞭呼延灼征剿梁山，充當先鋒，連環馬陣中衝殺驍勇。兵敗被擒，感義歸降，為梁山馬軍小彪將。徵方臘時於常州中冷箭而亡。

天目将彭玘，东京人，原任颍州团练使，将门之后，使一口三尖两刃刀。随呼延灼征梁山为.en: Peng Qi, the Heavenly-Eyed General, comes from the capital and a military family. Formerly militia commander of Yingzhou, he wields a three-pointed, double-edged blade. As Huyan Zhuo's deputy vanguard against Liangshan, he is captured by Hu Sanniang, Ten-Foot Green. Grateful that Liangshan spares his life, he joins as a junior cavalry commander and later dies at Changzhou during the Fang La campaign.
天目将彭玘，东京人，原任颍州团练使，将门之后，使一口三尖两刃刀。随呼延灼征梁山为.ja: 天目将の彭玘は東京の人で将門の出。もとは潁州団練使で、三尖両刃刀を使う。呼延灼の副先鋒として梁山を討つが、陣前で一丈青の扈三娘に生け捕られる。命を助けられた恩に感じて帰順し、馬軍小彪将となった。方臘征討で常州に戦死。
天目将彭玘，东京人，原任颍州团练使，将门之后，使一口三尖两刃刀。随呼延灼征梁山为.zh_TW: 天目將彭玘，東京人，原任潁州團練使，將門之後，使一口三尖兩刃刀。隨呼延灼徵梁山為副先鋒，陣前被一丈青扈三娘生擒，感梁山不殺之恩歸順，為馬軍小彪將。徵方臘於常州陣亡。

花项虎龚旺，张清麾下副将，浑身刺着虎斑、项上一颗虎头，善使飞枪，能在马上掷标枪取.en: Gong Wang, the Tiger-Necked Warrior, serves as Zhang Qing's deputy. His body bears tiger-stripe tattoos and a tiger's head at the neck. An expert with throwing spears, he can strike men with javelins from horseback. At Dongchang he helps Zhang Qing repeatedly repulse Liangshan. They later surrender together, and Gong Wang becomes a cavalry commander. He dies amid the fighting in the Fang La campaign.
花项虎龚旺，张清麾下副将，浑身刺着虎斑、项上一颗虎头，善使飞枪，能在马上掷标枪取.ja: 花項虎の龔旺は張清の副将。全身に虎縞、首に虎の頭の刺青がある。投げ槍に長け、馬上から標槍で敵を倒す。東昌府では張清と共に梁山を幾度も退け、のちに一緒に帰順して馬軍頭領となった。方臘征討の乱戦で没する。
花项虎龚旺，张清麾下副将，浑身刺着虎斑、项上一颗虎头，善使飞枪，能在马上掷标枪取.zh_TW: 花項虎龔旺，張清麾下副將，渾身刺著虎斑、項上一顆虎頭，善使飛槍，能在馬上擲標槍取人。東昌府隨張清屢挫梁山，後一同歸降，為梁山馬軍頭領，徵方臘時歿於亂軍。

中箭虎丁得孙，张清麾下副将，面颊连项都有疤痕，善使飞叉，与龚旺并称张清左右翼。东.en: Ding Desun, the Arrow-Struck Tiger, serves as Zhang Qing's deputy. Scars run from his cheeks down his neck, and he excels with throwing forks. He and Gong Wang are Zhang Qing's two wings. After surrendering at Dongchang, he becomes a Liangshan cavalry commander. On the Fang La campaign, he dies after accidentally being bitten by a venomous snake.
中箭虎丁得孙，张清麾下副将，面颊连项都有疤痕，善使飞叉，与龚旺并称张清左右翼。东.ja: 中箭虎の丁得孫は張清の副将。頬から首まで傷があり、投げ叉に長ける。龔旺と共に張清の左右の翼と呼ばれた。東昌府で梁山に帰順して馬軍頭領となるが、方臘征討の途中で毒蛇に噛まれて死ぬ。
中箭虎丁得孙，张清麾下副将，面颊连项都有疤痕，善使飞叉，与龚旺并称张清左右翼。东.zh_TW: 中箭虎丁得孫，張清麾下副將，面頰連項都有疤痕，善使飛叉，與龔旺並稱張清左右翼。東昌府歸順梁山後為馬軍頭領，徵方臘途中誤為毒蛇所咬而亡。

白日鼠白胜，安乐村闲汉。黄泥冈上依计挑酒叫卖，先与晁盖等人配合消除押送者疑心；吴.en: Bai Sheng, the Daylight Rat, is an idle fellow of Anle Village. Following the plan on Huangni Ridge, he carries wine to sell and works with Chao Gai's companions to dispel the escorts' suspicions. Wu Yong uses a ladle to slip sedative powder into the wine; Bai Sheng snatches the ladle back to conceal the trick. Together they fool Yang Zhi's party into drinking. Arrested after the plot is exposed, he cannot endure torture and names his accomplices. Later rescued, he joins Liangshan as a leader of military couriers.
白日鼠白胜，安乐村闲汉。黄泥冈上依计挑酒叫卖，先与晁盖等人配合消除押送者疑心；吴.ja: 白日鼠の白勝は安楽村の閑漢。黄泥岡では計に従って酒を担いで売り、晁蓋たちと協力して護送役の疑いを解いた。呉用が柄杓を使って酒に蒙汗薬を落とすと、白勝がすかさず柄杓を奪って隠し、楊志一行をだまして飲ませる。発覚後に捕らえられ、拷問に耐えかねて仲間を白状した。のちに救われて入山し、軍の伝令頭領となる。
白日鼠白胜，安乐村闲汉。黄泥冈上依计挑酒叫卖，先与晁盖等人配合消除押送者疑心；吴.zh_TW: 白日鼠白勝，安樂村閒漢。黃泥岡上依計挑酒叫賣，先與晁蓋等人配合消除押送者疑心；吳用借瓢把蒙汗藥抖入酒中，白勝隨即奪瓢遮掩，共同騙楊志一行飲下。事發被捕後熬刑不過供出眾人，後來獲救上山，為軍中走報頭領。

高俅，本东京市井浮浪破落户，因善蹴鞠得幸于端王（后即位为徽宗），一朝发迹、平步青.en: Gao Qiu begins as an idle rogue in the capital's streets. His skill at cuju wins the favor of Prince Duan, later Emperor Huizong, and he rises rapidly to Grand Marshal of the palace army. On his very first day in office, he uses public authority to settle a private grudge and drives Wang Jin away. He then plots against Lin Chong and sends armies against Liangshan three times, returning defeated each time. A treacherous official whose power harms the realm and its people, he stands among Water Margin's foremost villains.
高俅，本东京市井浮浪破落户，因善蹴鞠得幸于端王（后即位为徽宗），一朝发迹、平步青.ja: 高俅はもと東京の市井に暮らす浮浪の無頼。蹴鞠の腕で端王、のちの徽宗に気に入られ、一朝にして出世し、殿帥府の太尉に至った。就任初日から公権力で私怨を晴らして王進を追い出し、その後は林冲を陥れ、三度大軍を梁山へ送って、いずれも敗れて帰る。奸臣が権力を握り、国と民を害する、『水滸伝』を代表する悪役である。
高俅，本东京市井浮浪破落户，因善蹴鞠得幸于端王（后即位为徽宗），一朝发迹、平步青.zh_TW: 高俅，本東京市井浮浪破落戶，因善蹴鞠得幸於端王（後即位為徽宗），一朝發跡、平步青雲，官至殿帥府太尉。上任頭一日便公報私仇逼走王進；此後設計陷害林沖、三番調遣大軍征剿梁山皆鎩羽而歸。奸佞當權、誤國害民，乃《水滸》第一等的反面人物。

史文恭，曾头市教师，武艺绝伦，与铁棒栾廷玉同出周侗门下。曾头市与梁山争夺照夜玉狮.en: Shi Wengong is the arms instructor of Zengtou Town, a peerless fighter trained under Zhou Tong alongside Iron Staff Luan Tingyu. Rivalry with Liangshan over the Night-Shining Jade Lion horse leads to bitter conflict. Shi Wengong's arrow strikes Heavenly King Chao in the cheek and causes his death, creating a blood feud. Lu Junyi later captures him alive amid the fighting. Liangshan cuts out his heart and liver, offering his blood in sacrifice to Chao Gai, and the vengeance is complete.
史文恭，曾头市教师，武艺绝伦，与铁棒栾廷玉同出周侗门下。曾头市与梁山争夺照夜玉狮.ja: 史文恭は曾頭市の武術師範。武芸は絶倫で、鉄棒の欒廷玉と共に周侗の門下で学んだ。曾頭市と梁山が照夜玉獅子馬を争って対立し、史文恭の矢が晁天王の頬を射抜いて死なせたため、深い血の恨みとなる。のちに盧俊義が乱戦中に生け捕りにした。梁山は心肝を抉り、血を晁蓋に捧げて弔い、復讐を遂げた。
史文恭，曾头市教师，武艺绝伦，与铁棒栾廷玉同出周侗门下。曾头市与梁山争夺照夜玉狮.zh_TW: 史文恭，曾頭市教師，武藝絕倫，與鐵棒欒廷玉同出周侗門下。曾頭市與梁山爭奪照夜玉獅子馬結怨，史文恭一箭射中晁天王面頰、致其身亡，結下血海深仇。後盧俊義於亂軍中將其活捉，梁山剜其心肝、瀝血祭奠晁蓋，方了此案。

蒋门神，本名蒋忠，身长九尺、相扑了得，倚仗张团练之势强占施恩的快活林酒店，横行霸.en: Jiang the Door God, originally named Jiang Zhong, stands nine chi tall and is a formidable wrestler. Backed by Commander Zhang, he seizes Shi En's Happy Grove tavern and rules by intimidation. Wu Song, exiled to Mengzhou, comes at Shi En's request. With Jade Ring Steps and Mandarin Duck Kicks, he knocks the giant to the ground until he begs for his life, recovering Happy Grove.
蒋门神，本名蒋忠，身长九尺、相扑了得，倚仗张团练之势强占施恩的快活林酒店，横行霸.ja: 蒋門神は本名を蒋忠といい、身長九尺の相撲の達人。張団練の威勢を頼りに施恩の快活林の酒店を奪い、横暴を働いた。孟州へ刺配された武松が施恩の頼みで訪れ、「玉環歩・鴛鴦脚」でこの巨漢を地面に打ち倒す。蒋門神は繰り返し命乞いをし、快活林は取り戻された。
蒋门神，本名蒋忠，身长九尺、相扑了得，倚仗张团练之势强占施恩的快活林酒店，横行霸.zh_TW: 蔣門神，本名蔣忠，身長九尺、相撲了得，倚仗張團練之勢強佔施恩的快活林酒店，橫行霸道。刺配孟州的武松受施恩之託尋上門來，一套「玉環步、鴛鴦腳」將這九尺大漢打翻在地、連討饒命，奪回了快活林。

安道全，绰号「神医」，建康府人氏。其人医道精通，针灸药石，无所不晓，凡疑难重症、.en:
An Daoquan, known as the Divine Physician, came from Jiankang Prefecture. He was versed in every branch of medicine, from acupuncture to drugs and mineral remedies. Difficult illnesses, severe disorders, abscesses and ulcers, internal injuries and ailments contracted from outside all yielded remarkable results under his care. Throughout the martial world he was therefore respectfully called the Divine Physician. His skill could stand beside that of the ancient masters Bian Que and Hua Tuo, whose hands restored the dying to health, and his reputation spread far and wide.

An Daoquan had originally been a respected doctor in Jiankang, running an apothecary and treating the sick. He had no connection with Liangshan Marsh until a grave illness struck Song Jiang. The Liangshan heroes had defeated Gaotangzhou and Huazhou and were gaining renown. After receiving heavenly books at the Temple of the Mystic Lady and leading an attack on Zengtou Market, Song Jiang was exhausted by campaigning. A malignant sore erupted on his back; the infection grew dangerous, his whole body became red and swollen, and he could take neither food nor water. His life was in peril, and the doctors in the stronghold could do nothing. Dai Zong, the Marvelous Traveler, anxiously sought renowned physicians without success. Then Zhang Shun, the White Streak in the Waves, recalled that his mother had once been cured by An Daoquan of Jiankang. Such a miraculous doctor, he said, could surely save Song Jiang. Delighted, the chieftains asked Dai Zong and Zhang Shun to travel overnight to Jiankang and respectfully invite him.

They found An Daoquan in Jiankang, but he was then deeply involved with a courtesan named Li Qiaonu. Absorbed in wine and pleasure, he refused to accompany Zhang Shun to Liangshan. Repeated pleas and promises of a handsome reward only brought excuses. While Zhang Shun struggled with this refusal, disaster struck. Li Qiaonu had another lover, Zhang Wang, a hanger-on maintained by the brothel keeper and a villain who murdered for money. One night Zhang Wang killed both Li Qiaonu and the madam and stole their valuables. Zhang Shun stumbled into the affair and nearly became entangled in the prosecution. In desperation he turned the situation to his advantage, writing on the wall in blood: “The murderer is An Daoquan.” This cut off the physician's retreat. Seeing the bloodstained accusation, An Daoquan knew that remaining in Jiankang would bring legal disaster. With no way out, he packed his belongings and fled that night to Liangshan with Zhang Shun and Dai Zong. The episode of Zhang Shun's night of turmoil in Jiankang and his trick to bring the Divine Physician to the mountain introduces An Daoquan and also reveals how far Liangshan would go to recruit talent.

On reaching Liangshan, An Daoquan immediately examined Song Jiang's sore. After carefully assessing it, he used acupuncture, external medicines and restorative decoctions. Over several days the swelling subsided, and in fewer than ten days Song Jiang recovered, regained his spirits and resumed military affairs. An Daoquan remained in the stronghold to treat the chieftains and soldiers for illnesses and battle wounds, with success wherever his care was needed. When the 108 heroes assembled and their ranks were fixed, he was assigned the Earthly Spirit Star and the fifty-sixth seat among the Earthly Fiends. He supervised the physicians practicing both internal medicine and surgery, becoming the army's chief doctor.

After Song Jiang accepted the imperial amnesty, An Daoquan accompanied the army. During the northern campaign against Great Liao and the campaigns against Tian Hu and Wang Qing, sick and wounded soldiers depended on his treatment. He saved countless lives through his medical skill. His eventual fate, however, differed from that of most comrades. As the army prepared to march south against Fang La, the emperor fell mildly ill, and the court physicians could not cure him. Someone recommended An Daoquan's extraordinary abilities. An imperial decree retained him in the capital and appointed him to the Imperial Medical Academy to attend the sovereign. Thus, ordered to remain in the capital, he did not join Song Jiang's southern campaign against Fang La.

Later generations have often remarked upon his good fortune. In the campaign against Fang La, seven or eight of every ten Liangshan heroes were killed or grievously lost, leaving a scene of terrible devastation. By remaining in the capital, An Daoquan escaped that catastrophe intact. Instead of returning wrapped in a horsehide shroud, he received a post at the Imperial Medical Academy, enjoyed his salary and died peacefully in the capital. He was one of the rare members of the 108 to preserve his life and live out his natural years. The healing skills that saved so many Liangshan brothers ultimately saved their owner as well. The name Divine Physician was deserved: his story began well and ended well.
安道全，绰号「神医」，建康府人氏。其人医道精通，针灸药石，无所不晓，凡疑难重症、.ja:
安道全は、あだ名を「神医」といい、建康府の出身である。医術に精通し、鍼灸から薬や鉱物を用いた治療まで、知らぬものはなかった。難病や重病、腫れ物や潰瘍、内傷や外から受けた病も、彼の手にかかればたちどころに効き目が現れた。そのため江湖の人々は、敬意を込めて「神医」と呼んだ。死の淵にある者を救うその腕は、古の扁鵲や華佗にも比べられ、名声は遠近に広く知れ渡っていた。

安道全はもともと建康府で薬屋を開き、病人を救って暮らす良医で、梁山泊とは何の関わりもなかった。彼が山へ入ることになったのは、宋江の大病がきっかけである。梁山の好漢たちは高唐州や華州を攻略し、ますます威名を高めていた。その後、玄女廟で天書を授かり、さらに曾頭市を攻めた宋江は、戦の疲れから背中に悪性の腫れ物を生じた。毒が広がって全身が赤く腫れ、水も食事も受け付けず、命が危うくなった。山寨にも医者はいたが、誰も手の施しようがない。神行太保の戴宗は焦り、名医を探し回ったものの見つからなかった。そこへ浪裏白条の張順が、かつて母の病を建康府の神医・安道全に治してもらったと申し出た。あの医術なら宋江も救えるというのである。頭領たちは大いに喜び、戴宗と張順に、夜を徹して建康府へ赴き、礼を尽くして安道全を迎えるよう頼んだ。

建康に着いた張順と戴宗は安道全を見つけた。しかし彼はそのころ、李巧奴という妓女と深い仲になり、酒と色事に溺れて、張順と山へ行こうとしなかった。何度懇願し、大金を約束しても、安道全は言い逃ればかりする。張順が困り果てていると、思いがけない大事件が起こった。李巧奴にはもう一人の情夫がいた。張旺という、妓楼の女主人に食わせてもらう遊び人で、金のためなら人も殺す悪党だった。張旺は夜中に李巧奴と女主人を殺し、財物を奪った。張順は偶然この事件に巻き込まれ、危うく罪を問われかけた。追い詰められた彼は、この状況を逆に利用し、壁に血で「人を殺したのは安道全なり」と書いて、安道全の退路を断った。血文字を見た安道全は、建康に残れば必ず訴追されると悟り、進退きわまって荷をまとめ、張順、戴宗とともにその夜のうちに梁山へ逃れた。この「張順、夜に建康府を騒がせ、神医を計略で山へ迎える」一件は、安道全登場の物語であり、梁山が人材を得るためには手段を選ばなかったことも示している。

梁山に着いた安道全は、すぐに宋江の背の腫れ物を診た。病状を詳しく調べ、鍼灸を施し、外には良薬を塗り、内には煎じ薬を与えて数日養生させると、腫れは次第に治まった。十日もたたぬうちに宋江は全快し、気力を取り戻して軍務に復帰した。以後、安道全は山寨に留まり、頭領や将兵の病気と戦傷を専門に治療し、負傷者を癒やしては成果を上げた。梁山大聚義で百八人の席次が定められると、地煞の地霊星に応じる第五十六位となり、内科・外科を担う医師たちを統率する梁山軍の主医となった。

宋江が朝廷の招安を受けた後、安道全も従軍した。大遼への北征、田虎や王慶への討伐では、病人や負傷者は皆彼の治療に頼り、救った命は数知れなかった。だが、その結末は多くの仲間とは異なる。大軍が方臘討伐へ南下しようとしたころ、皇帝が軽い病にかかった。宮中の医師たちが治せずにいると、安道全の医術を推す者があった。そこで勅命が下り、彼は都に留められ、太医院に仕えて天子を診ることになった。このため、宋江とともに方臘征討へ向かうことはなかった。

後世、このことを語る人々は、安道全の幸運を嘆賞する。方臘との戦いでは梁山の好漢の十に七、八が失われ、死傷は惨憺たるものだった。都に留まった安道全は災いを避け、馬革に屍を包まれることもなく、太医院の職と俸禄を得て、都で安らかに生涯を終えた。百八人のうち、命を保って天寿を全うできた稀な一人である。梁山の多くの兄弟を救った医術は、最後には自分自身の命をも救った。「神医」の名は実にふさわしく、始めも終わりも恵まれた人生だったといえよう。
安道全，绰号「神医」，建康府人氏。其人医道精通，针灸药石，无所不晓，凡疑难重症、.zh_TW:
安道全，綽號「神醫」，建康府人氏。其人醫道精通，針灸藥石，無所不曉，凡疑難重症、癰疽瘡瘍、內傷外感，到他手中，無不立見奇效，因此江湖上下，皆敬稱一聲「神醫」。古之扁鵲、華佗，妙手回春，安道全之術，亦可與之比肩，故此名播四方，遠近知聞。

安道全本是建康府一名良醫，開張藥鋪，懸壺濟世，原與梁山泊並無干涉。其得以上山，全因宋江一場大病而起。當日梁山好漢大破高唐州、華州，威名日盛。後宋江因玄女廟得天書，又領兵攻打曾頭市，征戰勞頓，忽染背瘡，毒發危殆，遍體紅腫，水米不進，眼見性命垂危。寨中雖有醫者，皆束手無策。神行太保戴宗心急如焚，遍訪名醫無果。後得浪裡白條張順獻策，言其母昔年患病，曾得建康府神醫安道全針石而愈，此人醫術通神，若得他來，宋江之病可保無虞。眾頭領聞言大喜，便央戴宗、張順二人星夜下山，前往建康府禮請安道全。

張順、戴宗到了建康，尋見安道全。怎奈安道全此時正與一個煙花娼妓李巧奴打得火熱，迷戀酒色，不肯隨張順上山。張順再三懇求，許以重金，安道全只是推託。張順無奈，又值天降大禍：原來那李巧奴另有一個姦夫，喚作虔婆所豢的幫閒，名曰張旺，是個謀財害命的歹人。張旺夜間將李巧奴與鴇母一併殺害，劫了財物。張順誤打誤撞，幾乎被官司牽累。情急之下，張順索性將計就計，於壁上以血書寫「殺人者安道全也」數字，斷了安道全的退路。安道全見血字在壁，知留建康必遭官司纏身，進退無門，只得收拾行裝，隨張順、戴宗連夜投奔梁山。此「張順夜鬧建康府，賺得神醫上山」一段，乃安道全登場之關目，亦見梁山攬才之不擇手段也。

安道全到了梁山，即為宋江診治背瘡。他細看病勢，施以針灸，外敷良藥，內進湯劑，調理數日，宋江之瘡漸漸平復，不旬日間，竟得痊癒，重整精神，復理軍務。自此安道全留在山寨，專一醫治眾頭領並三軍將士之疾病金瘡，凡有損傷者，得他療治，無不奏效。梁山大聚義，排定一百單八將座次，安道全上應地靈星，位列地煞，坐第五十六把交椅，專掌一應內外科諸醫士，乃梁山軍中之主醫也。

後宋江受朝廷招安，安道全亦隨軍同行。北征大遼，南討田虎、王慶，軍中將士每有傷損，皆賴安道全調治，活人無數，功在醫道。然其結局，卻與眾將不同。當大軍將欲南征方臘之際，朝廷天子偶染微恙，宮中御醫束手，便有人保奏安道全醫術通神。天子遂降旨，將安道全留在京師，入太醫院供職，專一伺候聖躬。如此一來，安道全因奉旨留京，未能隨宋江南下征討方臘。

後人每論及此，皆嘆安道全之幸：蓋徵方臘一役，梁山好漢十損七八，死傷狼藉，慘不忍睹。安道全因留京之故，得以全身遠禍，既未馬革裹屍，又得太醫院之職，安享俸祿，善終於京師，實為一百單八將中難得保全性命、得享天年者。一身醫術，既救活了梁山無數兄弟，亦終救了自家性命。神醫之名，名實相副，可謂善始善終矣。

白胜者，济州安乐村人氏，水浒一百单八将中一员市井出身的闲汉。其人本是个赌钱使坏、.en:
Bai Sheng came from Anle Village in Jizhou, an idle townsman who became one of the 108 heroes of Water Margin. Originally a down-at-heel gambler and troublemaker, he wandered between villages and market towns, doing small business carrying wine and selling drinks while also stealing poultry, cheating and swindling. He was a disreputable street rogue. Lazy by nature, he crept about in broad daylight pursuing dubious livelihoods with the furtive movements of a rat. People in the martial world therefore gave him the nickname Daylight Rat. “Daylight” meant the full light of day; a rat was a thieving creature that hid by day and slipped out at night to steal. Calling him a Daylight Rat precisely captured a layabout who dared sneak and steal even under the sun. The name was hardly imposing, but it portrayed his sly, dishonest habits with piercing accuracy.

Bai Sheng was not a celebrated figure in Water Margin, yet he played a part in one enormous affair: the clever seizure of the birthday gifts. When Chao Gai, Wu Yong, Gongsun Sheng, Liu Tang and the three Ruan brothers planned to rob the gifts worth one hundred thousand strings of cash that Secretary Liang was sending to Grand Tutor Cai in the Eastern Capital, Wu Yong recommended Bai Sheng for a vital role in the scheme. Yang Zhi was escorting the convoy through Yellow Mud Ridge in the fierce heat of the sixth month, and the soldiers were desperately thirsty. Disguised as a village wine seller, Bai Sheng slowly climbed the ridge with two buckets of white wine, singing a country song, and rested in the pine grove. The soldiers wanted to buy a drink, but he deliberately raised objections and pretended to refuse. Wu Yong and the others, posing as date merchants, first bought and drank one bucket. Then they made a show of snatching wine from the other while Bai Sheng was supposedly off guard, secretly adding a sleeping drug. Their staged struggle erased the soldiers' suspicions. Unable to resist the men's insistence, Yang Zhi drank a few mouthfuls too. Soon the entire escort lay drugged, and Chao Gai's party carried off the birthday gifts. In this wine-selling trick at Yellow Mud Ridge, an ordinary porter singing a rustic song helped utterly deceive the capable, shrewd Blue-faced Beast Yang Zhi. It was one of the affair's most memorable strokes.

The great robbery was nevertheless uncovered. Ordered to investigate, He Tao followed the clues to Bai Sheng and arrested him. Bai Sheng initially held out, but the evidence was clear and he could not endure the torture. At last he confessed Chao Gai's name, his companions' identities and origins, and the entire course of the scheme. This confession revealed the seven culprits to the authorities and forced Chao Gai's group to fight their way to Liangshan and become outlaws. Bai Sheng himself was prosecuted and imprisoned. Later, once Chao Gai and his companions had established themselves on the mountain, they remembered his services and their old ties. They bribed the necessary officials, rescued him from the Jizhou prison and brought him to join them. At the great assembly Bai Sheng received the one-hundred-and-sixth seat, corresponding to the Earthly Depletion Star. In the army he gathered news, scouted and arranged support: his talent for sneaking and probing was well suited to intelligence work.

After the amnesty, Bai Sheng followed the army through northern and southern campaigns: against Great Liao, then Tian Hu and Wang Qing, and finally Fang La. In the last campaign the dangerous terrain of Jiangnan and Fang La's formidable troops and commanders cost Liangshan grievous casualties, staining the southeast with blood. Bai Sheng met his end away from the battle line. While the army fought its way through Jiangnan, he contracted an epidemic disease on the march. Confined to his sickbed, he never recovered and died in Hangzhou before Fang La's defeat and the victorious return to court. The Daylight Rat who had sold wine and sung a country song while helping steal the birthday gifts spent much of his life on disreputable business. Yet he too followed Liangshan's enterprise across half the realm, only to fall to a passing epidemic on the southern campaign. That idle villager with the wine buckets, who sang so leisurely and later betrayed Chao Gai under torture, ultimately returned to dust as Liangshan's stars scattered. Only his nickname and the old tale of the birthday-gift robbery remained for later generations to ponder, tracing the causes and consequences of that astonishing crime.
白胜者，济州安乐村人氏，水浒一百单八将中一员市井出身的闲汉。其人本是个赌钱使坏、.ja:
白勝は済州安楽村の出身で、『水滸伝』の百八人のうち、町場の遊び人から身を起こした一人である。もとは賭け事や悪さをして暮らす落ちぶれ者で、村や町を渡り歩き、酒を担いで売るような小商いをする一方、鶏を盗み、人をだまし、詐欺を働くことにも慣れた、表立っては語れぬ無頼漢だった。生来怠け者で、昼間からこそこそ怪しい稼ぎをし、鼠のように身を隠して動くため、江湖では「白日鼠」と呼ばれた。「白日」は真昼、「鼠」は昼に隠れて夜に出歩き、物を盗む獣をいう。白日鼠という名は、昼日中にも鼠のように盗みを働く、この町場の閑人の本性をよく表していた。勇ましくはないが、ずる賢く立ち回る姿を実に的確に描いたあだ名だった。

『水滸伝』で白勝の名は大きくないが、天下を驚かす事件に関わった。それが生辰綱の智取である。晁蓋、呉用、公孫勝、劉唐、阮氏三兄弟の七人が、梁中書から東京の蔡太師へ送られる十万貫相当の誕生祝いを奪おうと計画したとき、呉用は白勝を一味に加え、計略の要を担わせた。楊志が生辰綱を護送して黄泥岡に差しかかったのは、六月の酷暑のころだった。兵たちは暑さと渇きに苦しんでいた。白勝は酒売りの村人に変装し、白酒の桶を二つ担ぎ、山歌を歌いながらゆっくり岡へ上がり、松林で休んだ。酒を見た兵たちは買おうとしたが、白勝はわざとあれこれ言い、売りたくないふりをした。棗売りの商人を装った呉用らは、まず一桶を買って飲み、次に白勝の隙をうかがってもう一桶から酒をすくうふりをし、ひそかに眠り薬を入れた。奪い合う芝居によって、兵たちの疑いはすっかり晴れた。楊志も皆の要求に抗しきれず数口飲むと、ほどなく一行は全員薬で倒れ、十万貫の生辰綱は晁蓋たちに奪い去られた。黄泥岡で酒を売って薬を仕込むこの一幕では、山歌を歌うただの酒担ぎが、精明で有能な青面獣・楊志を見事に翻弄した。生辰綱智取の中でも、とりわけ鮮やかな手並みだった。

しかし、この大事件はついに露見した。捜索を命じられた何濤は手掛かりをたどって白勝を捕らえた。白勝は初めこそ耐えたものの、証拠も明らかなうえ拷問に耐えきれず、晁蓋らの姓名や素性、計略の一部始終を白状した。この自白によって官府は七人の犯行と知り、晁蓋たちは梁山へ逃れて山賊となるほかなかった。白勝自身は罪に問われ、牢へ入れられた。後に晁蓋らが梁山で勢力を整えると、彼の功労と旧情を思い、役人に賄賂を渡して済州の牢から救い出し、仲間として迎えた。大聚義で席次が定まると、白勝は地耗星に応じる第一百六位となった。軍中では情報集め、偵察、接応を専ら担当し、こっそり入り込んで探る手腕を諜報に生かした。

招安の後、白勝は大軍とともに南北を転戦し、大遼を討ち、田虎、王慶を平らげ、最後に方臘征討へ向かった。江南は山川が険しく、方臘の配下にも猛将や精兵が多かったため、梁山の好漢は甚大な死傷を出し、東南の地は血に染まった。だが白勝の最期は、戦場の正面ではなく、行軍中の病だった。江南を転戦する途上で疫病にかかり、病床から起き上がることなく杭州で死んだ。方臘が平定され、軍が都へ凱旋する日を迎えることはできなかった。酒を売り、山歌を歌って生辰綱を奪う手助けをした白日鼠は、世間に誇れぬ仕事の多い一生を送った。それでも梁山の大業に従って天下の半ばを転戦し、最後には流行り病によって江南の旅路に倒れたのである。酒桶を担いでのんびり歌い、後には拷問に負けて晁蓋を白状したあの遊び人も、梁山の星々が散るにつれて塵に帰った。後世に残ったのは「白日鼠」の三文字と生辰綱智取の昔話であり、人々はそれを通じ、この驚天動地の事件の始まりと終わりを幾度もたどるのである。
白胜者，济州安乐村人氏，水浒一百单八将中一员市井出身的闲汉。其人本是个赌钱使坏、.zh_TW:
白勝者，濟州安樂村人氏，水滸一百單八將中一員市井出身的閒漢。其人本是個賭錢使壞、遊手好閒的破落戶，平日裡在鄉村市鎮間走動，做些挑酒賣漿的小買賣，又慣會偷雞摸狗、坑蒙拐騙的勾當，乃是個上不得檯面的市井無賴。因他生性懶散，專一在白日裡出沒，幹些不明不白的營生，行跡如鼠，鬼鬼祟祟，江湖上的人便送他一個諢號，喚作「白日鼠」。白日者，光天化日也；鼠者，竊物之物，晝伏夜出，專一偷摸。以白日鼠為號，正狀他這個白日裡也敢偷摸、行跡如鼠的市井閒漢本色，聽來雖不威武，卻把他那一副偷奸耍滑的派頭，狀得入木三分。

白勝在水滸裡，名聲不大，卻幹了一樁天大的事，這便是智取生辰綱。當年晁蓋、吳用、公孫勝、劉唐、阮氏三雄七人，定計要劫取梁中書送往東京與蔡太師慶壽的十萬貫生辰綱，吳用便薦了這白勝入夥，做那智取一計中的緊要一環。其時楊志押著生辰綱，行至黃泥岡，正值六月酷暑，天氣炎熱，眾軍漢熱渴難當。白勝便扮作一個挑酒的村夫，挑著兩桶白酒，唱著山歌，慢悠悠上得岡來，在那松林裡歇腳。眾軍漢見了酒，早渴得慌，要買來吃，白勝卻故意推三阻四，假意不肯賣。吳用等人扮作販棗的客商，先買了一桶吃了，又趁著白勝不防，去另一桶裡舀酒，暗暗下了蒙汗藥，做出一番你爭我奪的把戲，把那軍漢的疑心徹底打消。楊志拗不過眾人，也吃了幾口，不多時，一行人盡數被蒙汗藥麻翻，那十萬貫生辰綱，便被晁蓋等人揚長劫去。這一出黃泥岡賣酒下藥，白勝以一介挑酒村夫，唱著山歌，便把那精明強幹的青面獸楊志誆得團團轉，端的是智取生辰綱裡最出彩的一筆。

怎奈這樁大案，到底還是敗露了。何濤奉命緝捕，循著線索查到白勝身上，將他拿了。白勝起初也曾硬扛，怎奈受刑不過，又見贓證確鑿，終於熬刑不住，供出了晁蓋等一干人的姓名來歷，連那智取的首尾也都招了。正是因了白勝這一招，官府才知是晁蓋等七人所為，逼得晁蓋一夥不得不殺奔梁山，落草為寇。白勝自己則吃了官司，下在牢裡。後來晁蓋等上了梁山，勢力漸成，念著白勝當日的功勞與情分，便使人買通關節，將他從濟州大牢裡救了出來，接上梁山入夥。梁山大聚義，排定座次，白勝坐了第一百零六把交椅，上應地耗星，在軍中專一打聽訊息、做些哨探接應的勾當，那一身偷摸鑽探的本事，於探事一道正合用處。

招安以後，白勝隨大軍南征北討，北征大遼，復掃田虎、王慶，終而南下征討方臘。這一場平方臘之役，江南山水險惡，方臘麾下亦多悍將精兵，梁山好漢死傷慘重，血染東南半壁。白勝的結局，卻不在陣前，而是病死途中。大軍征討方臘，轉戰江南，白勝在行軍途中染了瘟疫，纏綿病榻，竟一病不起，歿於杭州，未能等到方臘平定、班師還朝的那一日。一個挑酒賣漿、唱著山歌坑了生辰綱的白日鼠，一生乾的雖多是些上不得檯面的勾當，到頭來卻也隨著梁山的大業轉戰了半個天下，終因一場時疫，零落在了江南的征途之上。黃泥岡上那個挑著酒桶、慢悠悠唱著山歌，又受刑不過、供出晁蓋的市井閒漢，終究隨著梁山的星散而歸於塵土，徒留「白日鼠」三字與那一出智取生辰綱的舊事，供後人反覆咀嚼這場驚天大案的來龍去脈。

鲍旭，绰号「丧门神」，寇州人氏。其人生得面目狰狞，凶恶可怖，专一好杀，性如烈火，.en:
Bao Xu, nicknamed the God of Death, came from Kouzhou. His face was hideous and terrifying, and he delighted in killing. With a temper like fire, he would strike at anyone and stop only at the sight of blood: a fiend who killed without blinking. Wielding a broad sword, he fought with exceptional ferocity. Whenever he entered battle he seemed a malignant deity arriving to claim lives, and people in the martial world called him the God of Death. This name belonged to an ancient baleful spirit presiding over death, mourning and disaster. Applied to Bao Xu, it expressed both his savage disposition and his formidable murderous presence.

Bao Xu had originally been an outlaw near Kouzhou. He gathered followers on Withered Tree Mountain and lived by raiding homes and plundering travelers. Withered Tree Mountain was a haunt of Bao Xu and such men as Fan Rui, the Demon King of Chaos, Xiang Chong, the Eight-armed Nezha, and Li Gun, the Flying Great Sage. Xiang Chong and Li Gun later became chieftains of Mount Mangdang and remained friendly with him. Although fierce by nature, Bao Xu greatly respected men of prowess. He and the two men shared the same spirit and became sworn brothers.

Bao Xu's arrival at Liangshan grew out of the affair at Mount Mangdang. Fan Rui, who practiced sorcery, held that mountain with Xiang Chong and Li Gun and declared his intention of swallowing up Liangshan Marsh. Enraged, Song Jiang sent Gongsun Sheng, Lin Chong and other commanders against them. In battle, Gongsun Sheng defeated Fan Rui's sorcery with the orthodox Celestial Five Thunders arts and trapped Xiang Chong and Li Gun in the Eight Formations. After the pair were captured, Song Jiang personally untied them and treated them courteously. Moved by his generosity and righteousness, they submitted to Liangshan and persuaded Fan Rui to do likewise. The three then recommended their friend Bao Xu of Withered Tree Mountain. Xiang Chong and Li Gun knew that beneath his ferocity he was a true fighting man, with extraordinary strength and courage, who could serve Liangshan as a formidable warrior. Song Jiang sent men to recruit him. Bao Xu had long heard of Song Jiang's generosity and willingness to welcome heroes; with Xiang Chong and Li Gun also urging him, he gathered his followers, abandoned Withered Tree Mountain and joined Liangshan. Song Jiang was delighted by his imposing strength and welcomed him. Bao Xu thus took his place among the 108 heroes.

After joining, Bao Xu repeatedly led charges and threw himself into the enemy lines. His ferocity and bloodlust made him a frequent vanguard fighter, breaking formations and cutting down opponents wherever he advanced. With Xiang Chong and Li Gun, whose fighting methods included throwing knives, round shields and javelins, he formed a coordinated and exceptionally fierce assault team. Together they drove back and forth through enemy ranks, a formidable force within Liangshan's infantry. At the great assembly, Bao Xu received the sixtieth seat among the Earthly Fiends, corresponding to the Earthly Violence Star. He served as a valiant shock fighter among the mounted and foot troops. The star's name aptly reflected his violent, bloodthirsty nature.

After the imperial amnesty, Bao Xu followed Song Jiang's army against Great Liao, Tian Hu, Wang Qing and finally Fang La. He fought bravely at the front and earned considerable merit, but his ferocity ultimately brought his death. During the Fang La campaign, the army attacked Changzhou. Song Jiang led troops into the city, where they fought the defenders in the streets. Eager to kill, Bao Xu rushed in ahead of the others, swinging his sword wildly and becoming intoxicated with the slaughter. The opposing commander was Jin Jie, a valiant officer under Fang La, who brought his men to meet the invaders. Amid the confusion, Bao Xu thought only of cutting his way forward. An enemy commander's blade swept diagonally into him while he was unguarded. The God of Death, so fierce throughout his life, was felled by a single blow and died among the struggling troops in Changzhou. Li Kui, the Black Whirlwind, was beside him. Furious at the sight, he drove in with both axes and forced the enemy back. He and Bao Xu had always been close, sharing a bloodthirsty temperament, and Li Kui sought revenge for him. Bao Xu, who had killed countless others, died by the blade himself. He never returned to court with the army or received an imperial honor in life: a lamentable end.

Bao Xu's life began as that of a savage bandit on Withered Tree Mountain. Recommended by Xiang Chong and Li Gun, he joined Liangshan and became known for murderous ferocity, serving repeatedly as a courageous fighter at the head of assaults. The terrible reputation of the God of Death made him seem a life-taking spirit on the battlefield, and enemies trembled at his name. Yet his lust for killing led him to advance recklessly and perish in Changzhou. The violence of the Earthly Violence Star ceased only at death. He stands as one of the fierce warriors among Water Margin's host of dangerous men.
鲍旭，绰号「丧门神」，寇州人氏。其人生得面目狰狞，凶恶可怖，专一好杀，性如烈火，.ja:
鮑旭は、あだ名を「喪門神」といい、寇州の出身である。顔つきは凶悪で恐ろしく、ひたすら殺すことを好んだ。性は烈火のごとく、人を見れば斬りかかり、血を見て初めて収まる、眉一つ動かさず人を殺す凶漢だった。幅広の剣を使い、戦場では並外れて勇猛に戦った。その凶悪さと殺戮への執着から、ひとたび出陣すれば命を奪う凶神が現れたようで、江湖の人々は「喪門神」と呼んだ。喪門神とは古くから死や喪、災厄をつかさどる凶神の名であり、そのあだ名は鮑旭の荒々しい気性と鋭い殺気をよく示している。

鮑旭はもともと寇州一帯の賊で、枯樹山に仲間を集めて山賊となり、家々を襲い、略奪して暮らしていた。枯樹山は、鮑旭や混世魔王の樊瑞、八臂哪吒の項充、飛天大聖の李袞らが拠った場所である。後に項充と李袞は芒碭山の頭領となり、鮑旭とは親しくしていた。鮑旭は凶暴ではあったが、豪傑には深い敬意を抱き、項充、李袞と意気投合して兄弟の契りを結んだ。

鮑旭が梁山へ入ったのは、芒碭山の一件が縁だった。当時、妖術を使う混世魔王・樊瑞は、項充、李袞とともに芒碭山の王を名乗り、梁山泊を併呑すると宣言していた。怒った宋江は、公孫勝や林冲らに兵を率いて討伐させた。両軍が交えると、公孫勝は五雷天罡の正法で樊瑞の妖術を破り、八陣図で項充と李袞を囲い込んだ。計略に陥って捕らえられた二人を、宋江は自ら縄を解き、礼を尽くして遇した。仁義に感激した二人は梁山に帰順し、樊瑞にも降伏を勧めた。三人が加わると、枯樹山の友人・鮑旭を宋江に推挙した。項充と李袞は、鮑旭が凶暴ながらも並外れた力と勇気を持つ好漢で、梁山の猛将となれることを知っていたのである。宋江は枯樹山へ使者を送って招いた。鮑旭も、宋江が義を重んじ、財を惜しまず豪傑を迎えるという評判を以前から聞いており、二人の誘いも受けて兵をまとめ、枯樹山を捨てて梁山へ入った。その威猛な姿を見た宋江は大いに喜んで受け入れ、鮑旭は百八人の列に加わった。

入山後の鮑旭は、たびたび敵陣へ突入し、勇を奮って先頭に立った。凶猛で殺戮を好むため前衛の先鋒を務めることが多く、敵の陣を突き破り、行く先々で兵を斬り倒した。項充、李袞と組み、飛刀、丸盾、投げ槍などを用いる三人は、連携して敵陣を往来し、梁山歩兵の中でもひときわ獰猛な戦力となった。大聚義で席次が定められると、鮑旭は地煞の地暴星に応じる第六十位となり、騎兵と歩兵の中で敵陣に突入して討ち取る驍将を務めた。地暴星の名は、凶暴で殺し好きな彼の性格にまさしくふさわしかった。

朝廷の招安を受けた後、鮑旭は大軍に従って大遼、田虎、王慶を討ち、さらに方臘征討へ赴いた。常に陣頭で勇敢に戦い、多くの功を立てたが、その凶暴さがついには命取りとなった。方臘との戦いで大軍が常州を攻めると、宋江は城内に兵を進め、守備軍との市街戦となった。鮑旭は人を斬ろうと先を争って城へ入り、剣を振り回してはますます殺気立った。そこへ方臘配下の驍将・金節が、梁山軍の侵入を見て兵を率いて迎え撃った。乱戦の中、鮑旭は前へ進んで斬ることに夢中で、敵将が斜めに振るった刀を防げず、まともに受けた。一世を凶猛に生きた喪門神も、一刀で倒され、常州城内の乱軍に命を落としたのである。そばにいた黒旋風の李逵は激怒し、双斧を振るって突入し、敵を退けた。鮑旭と李逵はともに殺し好きで気が合い、以前から親しかったため、李逵はその仇を討とうとした。無数の人を殺した鮑旭も、最後は刀の下に死んだ。凱旋の日を迎えず、生きて朝廷の栄典を受けることもなかった。哀れな結末である。

鮑旭の一生を見れば、枯樹山の凶悪な賊が、項充と李袞の推挙によって梁山に入り、殺戮を好む勇猛さで名を成し、たびたび先頭で敵陣を衝く将となった姿が浮かぶ。喪門神の凶名は高く、戦場では命を奪う神のように恐れられた。だが殺し好きゆえに進み過ぎ、常州城内にその身を失った。地暴星の凶暴さは死んで初めて止んだのであり、『水滸伝』に集う荒ぶる者たちの中でも、一人の猛将であった。
鲍旭，绰号「丧门神」，寇州人氏。其人生得面目狰狞，凶恶可怖，专一好杀，性如烈火，.zh_TW:
鮑旭，綽號「喪門神」，寇州人氏。其人生得面目猙獰，兇惡可怖，專一好殺，性如烈火，逢人便砍，見血方休，是個殺人不眨眼的惡煞。慣使一口闊劍，臨陣廝殺，悍勇異常。因其凶神惡煞、嗜殺成性，一上陣便如索命的凶神臨世，江湖人都喚他做「喪門神」。喪門神者，古之凶煞之名，主死喪兇禍，鮑旭以此為號，正見其性情之兇狠、殺氣之凌厲。

鮑旭原是寇州一帶的強人，嘯聚枯樹山落草為寇，打家劫舍，劫掠為生。枯樹山乃鮑旭與混世魔王樊瑞、八臂哪吒項充、飛天大聖李袞等盤踞之處。後來項充、李袞二人乃芒碭山頭領，與鮑旭相善。鮑旭性情雖兇，卻最敬重豪傑，與項充、李袞意氣相投，結為兄弟。

鮑旭之歸梁山，緣於芒碭山一段。當日芒碭山有混世魔王樊瑞，會使妖法，與項充、李袞二人據山為王，聲言要來吞併梁山泊。宋江聞之大怒，遣公孫勝、林沖等領兵征討。兩軍交鋒，公孫勝以五雷天罡正法破了樊瑞的妖術，又用八陣圖困住項充、李袞二人。項充、李袞中計被擒，宋江親解其縛，以禮相待，二人感宋江仁義，遂歸順梁山，並勸樊瑞一同歸降。樊瑞、項充、李袞歸順之後，便向宋江引薦了枯樹山的好友鮑旭。原來項充、李袞深知鮑旭雖兇，卻是條好漢，膂力過人，悍勇能戰，可為梁山一員猛將，故舉薦之。宋江聞鮑旭之名，便差人往枯樹山招納。鮑旭素聞宋江仗義疏財、廣納豪傑之名，又得項充、李袞之招，遂收拾人馬，棄了枯樹山，前來梁山入夥。宋江見鮑旭威猛，大喜收納。自此鮑旭廁身梁山一百單八將之列。

鮑旭上山之後，每每衝鋒陷陣，奮勇當先，因其兇悍嗜殺，常作前部先鋒，專一衝突敵陣，砍殺敵軍，所向披靡。他與項充、李袞三人，又慣使飛刀、團牌、標槍之類，三人配合，往來突陣，兇猛異常，乃梁山步軍中一支悍勇之師。梁山大聚義，排定一百單八將座次，鮑旭上應地暴星，位列地煞，坐第六十把交椅，專充馬軍步軍中衝陣殺敵之驍將。地暴星之號，正應其兇暴嗜殺之性，名實相符。

後宋江受朝廷招安，鮑旭隨大軍北征大遼，南討田虎、王慶，復南征方臘，每於陣前奮勇廝殺，立功不少。然其兇悍亦終招殺身之禍。徵方臘一役，大軍攻打常州。宋江引兵殺入城中，與方臘守軍巷戰。鮑旭素來好殺，爭先衝入城內，揮劍亂砍，殺得性起。不料城中敵軍大將，乃方臘麾下驍將金節，見梁山兵馬殺入，便領軍接戰。混戰之中，鮑旭只顧向前砍殺，不防敵將一刀斜揮，正中鮑旭。可憐喪門神一世兇悍，竟被一刀剁翻，死於常州城中亂軍之內。黑旋風李逵在側，見鮑旭被殺，大怒，奮起雙斧殺入，方將敵軍殺退。鮑旭與李逵素來相善，二人皆是嗜殺之性，意氣相投，故李逵為之報仇。鮑旭一生殺人無數，終亦死於刀下，未及班師還朝，亦不曾受得朝廷封贈，可嘆可悲。

觀鮑旭一生，本枯樹山一兇惡強人，因項充、李袞之薦而歸梁山，以兇悍嗜殺著稱，每作前部衝陣之將，悍勇能戰。喪門神之號，兇名赫赫，臨陣如索命凶神，敵人聞之喪膽。然終以好殺冒進，殞身於常州城中。地暴星之兇暴，至死方休，亦《水滸》群兇中一員悍將也。

蔡福，绰号「铁臂膊」，上应地平星，梁山泊英雄座次第九十四位。其人本贯北京大名府，.en:
Cai Fu, nicknamed Iron Arm, corresponded to the Earthly Balance Star and held the ninety-fourth seat among Liangshan's heroes. He came from Daming Prefecture, the Northern Capital, and served as chief jailer over its two prison divisions. He handled imprisonment, punishment and executions: the head of the gaol's men who wielded the blades and axes. His brother was Cai Qing, called the Single Flower. Both served in the Daming penal establishment, the elder as chief jailer and the younger as a warder. They earned their living from the government's criminal justice and were accustomed to the bloody edge of the executioner's blade.

Iron Arm suited Cai Fu's profession. He possessed extraordinary strength, with thick arms as hard as iron, and used a heavy executioner's sword. Whenever a condemned man was beheaded in the marketplace, his blade rose and fell cleanly, never missing its mark. The weight and force of that iron-like arm inspired dread, giving him his nickname. Years of prison service had also made him thoroughly familiar with criminal law and the ways of the world. Shrewd and experienced, he adjusted his conduct to the person before him. Although he dealt in life and death, he was not simply a cruel man; he chiefly sought to adapt to circumstances and preserve himself.

Cai Fu became prominent through the case of Lu Junyi, the Jade Qilin. Song Jiang had long admired Lu's reputation and wanted to lure him to Liangshan. He sent Wu Yong to devise a plot, inscribe a seditious poem in Lu's house and have Li Gu report him. Falsely accused of colluding with Liangshan, Lu Junyi was confined in Daming's death row with his life hanging by a thread. This prison was under the Cai brothers' charge. Lu's steward Li Gu, who was already having an affair with his master's wife and wanted him dead, offered Cai Fu a large bribe to kill him in prison. Cai Fu had intended to take the money and carry out the request, but while he hesitated, Chai Jin, the Little Whirlwind, secretly entered Daming on Song Jiang's orders. He found Cai Fu, promised him great riches and repeatedly insisted that Lu must be kept alive. Weighing the stakes, Cai Fu recognized Liangshan's strength and Lu Junyi's destiny as a Heavenly Spirit. He accepted the request, discreetly protected the prisoner and prevented his death in the gaol. Secretary Liang later ordered Lu Junyi's execution several times, but Cai Fu delayed and maneuvered to frustrate it. Lu owed much of his survival to Cai Fu, whose protection was the most consequential good deed of his life.

Liangshan subsequently attacked Daming twice to rescue Lu Junyi and Shi Xiu. On the Lantern Festival night, the heroes coordinated forces inside and outside the city, burned Cuiyun Tower and stormed in, throwing the Northern Capital into turmoil. Caught between the sides, Cai Fu and Cai Qing abandoned their official positions and submitted to Liangshan. As the city fell and bloodlust ran high, Cai Fu performed another great kindness. He sought out Wu Yong and Chai Jin and repeatedly begged them to reduce the slaughter and spare innocent residents. Wu Yong agreed and ordered the army to restrain itself. Countless people in Daming survived because Cai Fu had spoken. This desire to save lives revealed a rare compassion beneath a profession lived by the bloody blade. Thereafter the brothers followed the others to Liangshan.

Because of his long experience in criminal punishment and his remarkable arm strength, Cai Fu was assigned to carry out and supervise executions in the stronghold. Most military death sentences were handled by the Cai brothers, who served Liangshan's penal authority. When the 108 heroes' seats were fixed at the great assembly, Cai Fu was assigned the Earthly Balance Star and the ninety-fourth seat, next to Cai Qing. Both belonged to the Earthly Fiends, one carrying out executions and the other overseeing them, each with his duty.

After the imperial amnesty, Cai Fu served the army against Liao, Tian Hu and Wang Qing. His doom came during the brutal campaign against Fang La in Jiangnan, where so many Liangshan heroes were lost. During fierce fighting around Hangzhou he was killed in battle, dying in imperial service without returning to his native home. The man called Iron Arm had spent his life wielding the executioner's blade and seeing countless prisoners, only to shed his own blood in the south and return in a warrior's shroud. Cai Qing was fortunate enough to survive and make his way home. When Song Jiang returned, Cai Fu was among the fallen officers remembered and honored for their service. He had been a man of Daming's prisons who lived among blades and axes; yet by choosing to protect Lu Junyi and pleading for the city's inhabitants, he showed uncommon mercy beneath those hardened arms. In this he surpassed an ordinary executioner, and readers of Water Margin have reason to pause and sigh at his story.
蔡福，绰号「铁臂膊」，上应地平星，梁山泊英雄座次第九十四位。其人本贯北京大名府，.ja:
蔡福は、あだ名を「鉄臂膊」といい、地平星に応じ、梁山泊の英雄の第九十四位に列する。北京大名府の出身で、当地の監獄では両院押牢節級を務め、牢獄と刑罰、処刑を取り仕切っていた。すなわち牢を管理し、刀斧を扱う処刑人たちの頭である。弟には「一枝花」の蔡慶がおり、兄弟とも大名府の牢城に勤めていた。兄は節級、弟は小押獄で、いずれも官府の刑罰に関わる仕事で食べ、刃の上の血に慣れた人物だった。

「鉄臂膊」というあだ名は蔡福の仕事にぴたりと合う。膂力に優れ、腕は太く鉄のように硬く、処刑用の鬼頭刀を使い慣れていた。市中で斬首を行うたび、刀を上げて下ろす動きは鮮やかで、一度も外さなかった。鉄のような腕から繰り出される一刀は重く力強く、人々を震え上がらせたため、この名が付いたのである。長年牢に勤めた蔡福は、刑法にも世間の人情にも通じた、抜け目なく老練な男だった。相手を見て態度を変えることに巧みで、生殺を扱うからといって一途に残酷なのではなく、その場に応じて身を守ろうとしていた。

蔡福の名が現れるのは、玉麒麟・盧俊義の一件である。宋江はかねて盧俊義の名声を慕い、計略で山へ迎えようとした。呉用を遣わして盧家に謀反の詩を書かせ、さらに李固に訴えさせたため、盧俊義は梁山と通じたと濡れ衣を着せられ、大名府の死刑囚牢へ入れられた。その命が危うい牢を管理していたのが、蔡福と蔡慶だった。盧俊義の家令・李固は、すでに主人の妻と密通し、主人を殺そうと蔡福に大金を贈り、牢内で始末するよう頼んだ。蔡福は金を受けて実行するつもりだったが、迷っているところへ、宋江の命で潜入した小旋風・柴進が現れた。柴進も大金を約束し、盧俊義に手を下さず必ず守るよう、繰り返し頼んだ。蔡福は軽重を量り、梁山の勢力と、盧俊義が天罡星の命を持つことを考えて、保護を承諾した。そしてひそかに世話をし、牢内で命を失わぬようにした。後に梁中書が幾度も斬首を命じた際も、蔡福が間に立って引き延ばした。盧俊義の命が保たれたのは彼の力によるところが大きく、これは蔡福の生涯で最も大切な善行となった。

その後、梁山は盧俊義と石秀を救うため、大名府を二度攻めた。元宵の夜、好漢たちは内外呼応し、翠雲楼に火を放って城へ入り、北京を大混乱に陥れた。乱軍の中で進退に窮した蔡福と蔡慶は、官の身分を捨てて梁山に帰順した。城が落ち、殺気の高まる中、蔡福はさらに大きな善行をした。呉用と柴進を探し、殺戮を少なくし、無実の民をむやみに害さぬよう何度も懇願したのである。呉用は願いを聞き入れ、三軍に節度を守るよう命じた。蔡福の一言で、大名府の無数の人々が命を救われた。人を生かそうとする思いは、日々血の刃を扱う仕事とは裏腹に、稀な仁心を示していた。こうして兄弟は仲間とともに梁山へ上った。

入山後、蔡福は刑罰に慣れ、腕力にも優れることから、山寨で処刑とその監督を専門に担った。軍の死刑執行は多くが蔡福、蔡慶兄弟に任され、梁山の刑罰をつかさどる一員となった。大聚義で百八人の席次が定まると、蔡福は地平星に応じる第九十四位に座り、弟の蔡慶と隣り合った。兄弟とも地煞に列し、一人は刑を執行し、一人は斬首を監督して、それぞれの役目を果たした。

朝廷の招安後、蔡福は大軍に従い、遼、田虎、王慶との戦いに尽くした。そして方臘征討の江南で、梁山の好漢が数多く失われる中、彼にも最期が訪れた。杭州一帯の激戦に加わった蔡福は、不幸にも陣中で戦死し、王事に命を捧げて故郷へ帰ることはできなかった。処刑の刀を握り、数えきれぬ人を見てきた鉄臂膊も、最後には江南に血を流し、馬革に屍を包まれる身となった。弟の蔡慶は幸い生き残り、転戦の末に帰還した。宋江が凱旋し、戦死した将をしのんで功に応じた栄典を求めたとき、蔡福もその中に数えられた。刀斧の間で暮らす大名府の獄吏ではあったが、盧俊義を守ろうとした一念、城中の人々を救った一言には、硬い腕の下にある慈悲が見える。並の処刑人とは異なるその姿に、『水滸伝』を読む者も幾度か嘆息せずにはいられない。
蔡福，绰号「铁臂膊」，上应地平星，梁山泊英雄座次第九十四位。其人本贯北京大名府，.zh_TW:
蔡福，綽號「鐵臂膊」，上應地平星，梁山泊英雄座次第九十四位。其人本貫北京大名府，乃大名府監獄裡的兩院押牢節級，專一執掌刑獄、行刑問斬之事，便是那衙門裡掌管牢獄、操持刀斧的劊子手頭目。他有個兄弟喚作「一枝花」蔡慶，弟兄二人同在大名府牢城充役，一個為節級、一個為小押獄，皆是吃官府刑名飯、慣於刀頭舔血的人物。

說起「鐵臂膊」這綽號，正合蔡福的本行。其人膂力過人，臂膀粗硬如鐵，慣使一柄行刑的鬼頭刀，每逢市曹問斬，蔡福手起刀落，乾淨利落，從無虛發，那一條鐵也似的臂膊掄將起來，端的力大勢沉、令人膽寒，故得「鐵臂膊」之名。蔡福身為押牢節級，久在獄中，深諳刑名律例、人情世故，最是個精明老練、看人下菜的角色。他雖掌生殺於刀斧之間，卻也並非一味狠毒之徒，惟隨機應變、明哲保身而已。

蔡福之名，因玉麒麟盧俊義一案而顯。話說宋江久慕盧俊義之名，欲賺他上山，便差吳用使計，在盧俊義家中題下反詩，又教李固告發。盧俊義被誣通梁山，下在大名府死囚牢裡，性命懸於一線。這死牢，正是蔡福、蔡慶弟兄掌管。盧俊義的管家李固，早與盧妻有私，一心要害死主人，便重賂蔡福，要他在牢中結果盧俊義性命。蔡福本欲收錢辦事，正在兩難之際，恰有梁山小旋風柴進，奉宋江之命潛入大名府，尋到蔡福，許以重金，再三囑託，定要他保全盧俊義、不可下手。蔡福掂量輕重，知梁山勢大、盧俊義又是天罡星命，便順水推舟，應承下來，暗中周全照看，使盧俊義在牢中不致喪命。後梁帥梁中書幾番要將盧俊義斬首，皆賴蔡福從中拖延周旋，盧俊義這條性命，多得蔡福之力保全。這一節，正是蔡福一生最緊要的功德。

後來梁山為救盧俊義、石秀，兩番攻打大名府。元宵之夜，梁山好漢裡應外合，火燒翠雲樓，殺入城中，大鬧北京。亂軍之中，蔡福、蔡慶弟兄進退兩難，索性棄了官身，歸順梁山。當此城破之際，殺氣方熾，蔡福卻做了一樁大善事：他尋到吳用、柴進，再三懇求，但乞少造殺戮、莫教濫害無辜百姓。吳用準其所請，傳令約束三軍，大名府滿城生靈，因蔡福這一言而得保全無數。這一片活人之念，比之他平日刀頭舔血的行當，反見出一段難得的仁心。自此蔡福、蔡慶弟兄隨眾上了梁山。

入山之後，蔡福因久慣刑名、臂力過人，便在山寨之中專一掌管行刑監斬之事，凡軍中正法、問斬之差，多由蔡福、蔡慶弟兄料理，乃是梁山執掌刑憲一路的人物。梁山大聚義，排定一百單八將座次，蔡福上應「地平星」，坐了第九十四把交椅，與兄弟蔡慶相鄰，弟兄二人同列地煞，一掌行刑、一司監斬，各司其職。

後來朝廷招安，蔡福隨大軍徵遼、討田虎、平王慶，皆在軍中效命。及至南征方臘，江南一場惡戰，梁山好漢折損極眾，蔡福的劫數，亦應在此。話說大軍征討江南，鏖戰於杭州一帶。蔡福隨軍廝殺，不幸死於陣中，歿於王事，未得生還故里。可憐這條鐵臂膊，一世執掌刑刀、閱人無數，臨了卻血灑江南、馬革裹屍。其兄弟蔡慶，卻幸得保全性命，轉戰而還。宋江班師之後，追念陣亡將佐，論功封贈，蔡福亦在其列。觀這鐵臂膊一生，本是大名府刑獄中人，慣於刀斧之間討生活，然一念保全盧俊義、一言活滿城生靈，剛硬臂膊之下，自有幾分難得的仁恕之心，比之尋常劊子手，蔡福實有過人之處，讀《水滸》者於此，亦當為之三嘆。

蔡庆，绰号「一枝花」，上应地损星，梁山泊英雄座次第九十五位。其人本贯北京大名府，.en:
Cai Qing, nicknamed the Single Flower, corresponded to the Earthly Loss Star and held the ninety-fifth seat among Liangshan's heroes. He came from Daming Prefecture, the Northern Capital, and was the younger brother of Cai Fu, Iron Arm. Both served in Daming's prison establishment. Cai Fu was chief jailer over the two divisions and handled executions; Cai Qing was a junior warder who helped guard death row and supervise prisoners. Both earned their living from official punishment and were familiar with the blood on an executioner's blade.

His nickname, the Single Flower, had an elegant origin quite unlike the fearsome names of many heroes. Cai Qing had a distinctive habit: he loved to wear a fresh flower beside his temple or on his cap. Although he worked in a prison and practiced the bloody business of guarding condemned men and overseeing beheadings, he was fond of looking handsome and dressing attractively. Whether at an execution in the marketplace or on duty in the gaol, he always wore a bright flower and displayed it openly through the streets. Residents of the Northern Capital, seeing the handsome warder and his habitual ornament, gave him the graceful name Single Flower Cai Qing. Combining toughness with softness, the nickname lent this prison official an unusual air of charm. He lacked his elder brother's astonishing strength, but was agile and skilled with an executioner's sword. The brothers worked well together in administering punishment.

Cai Qing's story mostly follows Cai Fu's and becomes prominent in the case of Lu Junyi, the Jade Qilin. Wu Yong's plot landed Lu Junyi in Daming's death row with his life hanging by a thread. The Cai brothers managed that prison. Li Gu, Lu's steward, heavily bribed Cai Fu to kill his master, while Chai Jin, the Little Whirlwind, secretly entered Daming and offered riches to have him protected. After weighing the consequences, Cai Fu agreed to preserve Lu's life. Cai Qing followed his brother in secretly caring for the prisoner and keeping him alive. When Secretary Liang repeatedly ordered Lu Junyi's execution, the brothers delayed and maneuvered on his behalf. He owed much of his survival to the pair. This was a meritorious act in which Cai Qing followed his brother in doing good.

Liangshan later attacked Daming twice to rescue Lu Junyi and Shi Xiu. On the Lantern Festival night the heroes coordinated an assault from within and without, burned Cuiyun Tower and stormed into the Northern Capital. Caught between the sides amid the fighting, Cai Fu and Cai Qing abandoned their official standing and joined Liangshan. When the city fell and the troops were eager to kill, Cai Fu sought out Wu Yong and Chai Jin and repeatedly begged them not to harm innocent people. Cai Qing supported the plea at his side. Their combined efforts persuaded Wu Yong to restrain the army and spared the city's inhabitants. This concern for life revealed an uncommon humanity beneath the brothers' everyday work in the prisons. Cai Qing then accompanied his elder brother to join the mountain stronghold.

After joining Liangshan, Cai Qing's experience with criminal punishment placed him alongside Cai Fu in the execution service. Most death sentences in the army were carried out or supervised by the brothers, who became officers of Liangshan's penal authority. At the great assembly, when the 108 heroes' ranks were settled, Cai Qing received the Earthly Loss Star and the ninety-fifth seat, next to his elder brother. Both stood among the Earthly Fiends, one executing and one supervising, performing their respective duties in the same service.

Cai Qing was not a mighty commander who independently held a front or led spectacular charges. Nevertheless, he accompanied the army in its wars, answered wherever he was needed and did not lag behind. He served in the two victories over Tong Guan and the three defeats of Gao Qiu. After the imperial amnesty he followed the northern expedition against Great Liao and the campaigns against Tian Hu and Wang Qing, serving in every campaign while remaining beside his brother.

The brutal southern campaign against Fang La cost Liangshan many heroes. Cai Fu was killed in the fighting at Hangzhou, dying in imperial service, but Cai Qing was fortunate enough to survive and return after further campaigning. Escaping blades, spears and arrows, he was one of the rarer Earthly Fiends to reach a peaceful ending. Once Fang La was defeated and the army returned to court, rewards were distributed. Cai Qing could have accepted an official appointment, but the loss of comrades and the parting of brothers by death had disenchanted him with wealth and distinction. Having no wish to serve as an official, he declined honors and returned to his native Daming to spend the rest of his life as an ordinary law-abiding citizen. Single Flower Cai Qing had earned his living amid prison blades and axes, yet retained a personal grace in his love of flowers and fine appearance. He had also helped his brother preserve Lu Junyi and save the city's inhabitants, showing tenderness and compassion beneath a harsh occupation. Compared with Cai Fu's bloody death in Jiangnan, Cai Qing's safe retirement to his birthplace provided one of the Liangshan heroes' more complete and fortunate conclusions.
蔡庆，绰号「一枝花」，上应地损星，梁山泊英雄座次第九十五位。其人本贯北京大名府，.ja:
蔡慶は、あだ名を「一枝花」といい、地損星に応じ、梁山泊の英雄の第九十五位に列する。北京大名府の出身で、「鉄臂膊」蔡福の実弟である。兄弟はともに大名府の牢城に勤め、兄の蔡福は両院押牢節級として処刑をつかさどり、蔡慶は小押獄として死刑囚牢の警備や囚人の監督を手伝っていた。どちらも官府の刑罰の仕事で暮らし、刀の先の血を見慣れた人物だった。

「一枝花」というあだ名には、他の好漢の恐ろしげな呼び名とは違う、風雅な由来がある。蔡慶には、いつも鬢や帽子に一輪の生花を挿すという独特の好みがあった。牢獄に身を置き、斬首の監督や牢番という血なまぐさい仕事をしながらも、見栄えや装いを大切にしていたのである。市中での処刑でも牢内の当直でも、色鮮やかな花を挿して堂々と歩いた。北京の人々は、姿のよい獄吏がいつも花を着けているのを見て、「一枝花」蔡慶という雅号を贈った。剛と柔を併せ持つその名は、刑獄の人にひと味違う風流を添えている。兄ほど驚くべき腕力はなかったが、身のこなしは軽快で、刑刀を使い慣れ、兄と協力して刑罰の務めを果たした。

蔡慶の事績は兄と重なるものが多く、玉麒麟・盧俊義の一件で名が現れる。盧俊義は呉用の計略によって大名府の死刑囚牢へ落とされ、命が危うくなった。その牢を管理していたのが蔡氏兄弟である。家令の李固は主人を殺そうと蔡福に大金を贈ったが、小旋風・柴進も大名府へ潜入し、大金を約束して盧俊義の保護を頼んだ。軽重を量った蔡福が保護を承諾すると、蔡慶も兄とともにひそかに世話をし、牢内で命を失わぬようにした。梁中書が幾度も処刑を命じた際にも、兄弟が間に立って引き延ばした。盧俊義の命が助かったのは二人の力によるところが大きい。これは蔡慶が兄に従って行った善行の一つだった。

その後、梁山は盧俊義と石秀を救うため、大名府を二度攻めた。元宵の夜、好漢たちは内外から呼応し、翠雲楼を焼いて城内へ入り、北京を騒乱に陥れた。乱軍の中で進退に窮した蔡福と蔡慶は、官の身分を捨てて梁山へ帰順した。城が落ち、殺気が盛んなそのとき、蔡福は呉用と柴進を探し、無実の人々をむやみに殺さぬよう繰り返し懇願した。蔡慶もそばで賛同し、兄弟の願いを受けた呉用は三軍を抑えて、城中の人々を守らせた。日頃の刑獄の仕事とは裏腹に、人を生かそうとするその思いには稀な仁心が見える。こうして蔡慶は兄とともに梁山へ上り、仲間となった。

入山後、蔡慶は刑罰に慣れていたことから、兄の蔡福とともに山寨の処刑と監督を専門に担った。軍中の死刑は多くが蔡氏兄弟に任され、梁山の刑罰をつかさどる者となった。大聚義で百八人の席次が定まると、蔡慶は地損星に応じる第九十五位に座り、兄の蔡福と隣り合った。兄弟とも地煞に列し、一人は刑の執行、一人は斬首の監督を受け持ち、それぞれの務めを果たした。

蔡慶は、敵陣に突入して一方面を独力で担う猛将ではなかった。しかし軍の一員として戦いに従い、命じられるまま各所で働き、後れを取ることはなかった。童貫を二度破り、高俅を三度退けた大戦でも軍中で力を尽くした。招安後は大遼への北征、田虎、王慶の討伐に従い、南北を転戦するたびに兄と連れ立って軍務を果たした。

方臘征討の江南では、激しい戦によって梁山の好漢が数多く失われた。兄の蔡福も杭州で戦死し、王事に命を捧げたが、蔡慶は幸い命を保ち、転戦して帰還した。刀槍や矢に倒れず、地煞の将の中では稀に安らかな最期へたどり着いた人となったのである。方臘が平定されて大軍が都へ戻り、功に応じた褒賞が与えられると、蔡慶にも官職を得る道はあった。だが仲間の死傷や兄弟の生き別れ、死に別れを経験して、功名富貴をむなしいものと悟り、仕官する気も失っていた。そこで栄達を辞退し、故郷の北京大名府へ戻り、普通の良民として余生を送った。一枝花・蔡慶は、刀斧の間で暮らす獄吏でありながら、花と装いを愛する風流を持ち、兄とともに盧俊義や城中の人々を救った。厳しい仕事の下には、柔らかな心と慈悲があったのである。江南に血を流した兄に比べ、無事に身を引いて故郷へ帰れた蔡慶の結末は、梁山の好漢の中でも円満なものだった。
蔡庆，绰号「一枝花」，上应地损星，梁山泊英雄座次第九十五位。其人本贯北京大名府，.zh_TW:
蔡慶，綽號「一枝花」，上應地損星，梁山泊英雄座次第九十五位。其人本貫北京大名府，乃「鐵臂膊」蔡福的親兄弟。弟兄二人同在大名府牢城充役：兄長蔡福為兩院押牢節級，掌行刑問斬；蔡慶則為小押獄，協同看守死牢、監押人犯，皆是吃官府刑名飯、慣於刀頭舔血的人物。

說起「一枝花」這綽號，頗有一段雅趣，與尋常好漢那等凶煞名號大不相同。原來蔡慶生平有個獨特癖好——平素最愛戴一枝鮮花在鬢邊帽上。他雖身在刑獄、操持那監斬看牢的血腥行當，卻偏生愛俏好妝，無論市曹問斬、抑或牢中當值，鬢邊總簪著一朵花兒，顏色鮮明，招搖過市。北京滿城百姓見這押獄生得風流俊俏、又慣戴花，便送他一個雅號，喚作「一枝花」蔡慶。這綽號剛柔相濟，倒把刑獄中人襯出幾分別樣風流。其人雖不及兄長蔡福那般膂力驚人，然身手也自利落，慣使一口刑刀，與兄長同執刑憲，弟兄相得。

蔡慶之事，多與兄長蔡福並行，因玉麒麟盧俊義一案而顯。話說盧俊義被吳用使計賺下大名府死囚牢，性命懸於一線，這死牢正是蔡福、蔡慶弟兄掌管。盧俊義的管家李固，重賂蔡福要害主人；梁山小旋風柴進，卻又潛入大名府，以重金囑託蔡福保全盧俊義。蔡福掂量輕重，應承保人，蔡慶便隨兄長一道，在牢中暗裡周全照看，使盧俊義不致喪命。後梁中書幾番要斬盧俊義，皆賴蔡氏弟兄從中拖延周旋，盧俊義這條性命，多得弟兄二人之力。這一節，正是蔡慶隨兄行善的一樁功德。

後來梁山為救盧俊義、石秀，兩番攻打大名府。元宵之夜，梁山好漢裡應外合，火燒翠雲樓，殺入城中，大鬧北京。亂軍之中，蔡福、蔡慶弟兄進退兩難，索性棄了官身，歸順梁山。當此城破、殺氣方熾之際，蔡福尋到吳用、柴進，再三懇求莫教濫害無辜，蔡慶亦在旁附議，弟兄合力，求得吳用約束三軍，大名府滿城生靈因之得保。這一片活人之念，比之弟兄平日刑獄中的行當，反見出難得的仁心。自此蔡慶隨兄長一道上了梁山入夥。

入山之後，蔡慶因久慣刑名，便與兄長蔡福一道，在山寨之中專一掌管行刑監斬之事。凡軍中正法、問斬之差，多由蔡氏弟兄料理，乃是梁山執掌刑憲一路的人物。梁山大聚義，排定一百單八將座次，蔡慶上應「地損星」，坐了第九十五把交椅，與兄長蔡福相鄰，弟兄二人同列地煞，一掌行刑、一司監斬，各司其職，並峙於刑憲之列。

蔡慶雖非衝鋒陷陣、獨當一面的猛將，然身在軍中，亦隨眾征戰，往來聽用，不曾落後。兩贏童貫、三敗高俅諸般大戰，蔡慶皆在陣中效力。後來朝廷招安，蔡慶隨大軍北征大遼，又討田虎、平王慶，轉戰南北，每役皆在軍中效命，與兄長相伴而行。

及至南征方臘，江南一場惡戰，梁山好漢折損極眾。蔡慶的兄長蔡福，竟死於杭州陣中，歿於王事；蔡慶卻幸得保全性命，轉戰而還，不曾死於刀槍箭矢，亦是地煞將中難得的善終之人。大軍平定方臘、班師還朝，論功行賞。蔡慶本可受朝廷封賞、做個官身，然他經歷了弟兄折損、生死離合，看破功名富貴，更兼無心仕宦，便辭了功名，重回北京大名府鄉里，做一個尋常良民，安度餘生。觀這一枝花蔡慶一生，本是大名府刑獄中人，慣於刀斧之間討生活，卻獨有愛花好俏的一段風流，又隨兄長保全盧俊義、活滿城生靈，剛硬行當之下自有幾分柔腸仁念。比之兄長蔡福血灑江南，蔡慶能全身而退、歸隱故里，亦不失為梁山好漢中一個圓滿的收梢。

曹正者,开封府人氏也。其家世代屠宰为业,本是个杀猪卖肉的屠户。曹正自幼习得一身好.en:
Cao Zheng came from Kaifeng Prefecture. His family had been butchers for generations, and he himself slaughtered pigs and sold meat.
