A vajra guardian is a mighty protector of Buddhism, large and powerfully built; "in the clouds" suggests a figure towering above them, as solid as a pagoda. Ordinary people standing beside Song Wan felt that he filled the space between heaven and earth, and so the name suited him.

Song Wan belonged to Liangshan's earliest company of outlaws. Before the settlement prospered, its chief was Wang Lun, White-Robed Scholar. A failed examination candidate, Wang Lun was narrow-minded and unable to tolerate others. Though he occupied Liangshan's natural defenses of mountain and marsh, he had no great ambition. Song Wan and Du Qian, Touching the Sky, were the first leaders to follow him there and establish the stronghold. At its foundation, Wang Lun commanded, with Du Qian and Song Wan assisting. Later Zhu Gui, Dry-Land Crocodile, joined them, operating an inn below the mountain to gather news and guide recruits up to the camp. Such was Liangshan Marsh in its earliest days. Song Wan and Du Qian could rightly be called its founding officers, with the longest service of all.

Wang Lun's pettiness shaped Song Wan's fortunes. Framed by Gao Qiu, Lin Chong, Panther Head, came to Liangshan on a snowy night seeking refuge. Wang Lun feared that this skilled warrior would eventually take his place, so he raised every obstacle and refused to accept him unless he first descended the mountain to obtain a pledge of loyalty through killing. As old members of the band, Song Wan and Du Qian felt Wang Lun was unjust, but lacked the standing to challenge him. They echoed his words and dared not argue strongly. Later Chao Gai, Wu Yong, Gongsun Sheng, Liu Tang and the three Ruan brothers robbed the birthday tribute. When the crime was discovered, all seven fled to Liangshan, and Wang Lun again tried to turn newcomers away. Unable to endure any more, Lin Chong killed the narrow-minded chief in the assembly hall. With Wang Lun dead, the others chose Chao Gai to lead them. Song Wan and Du Qian witnessed the whole confrontation. Both were habitually cautious: they neither helped Wang Lun nor took the initiative, but joined the others in supporting Chao Gai and thereafter served their new chief without complaint.

Under Chao Gai and then Song Jiang, Liangshan Marsh grew ever stronger until it had gathered 108 heroes. Song Wan had been there from the beginning, but his martial ability and judgment were unexceptional. Consequently, many later arrivals ranked above him. At the great ranking, he embodied the Earthly Star of the Demon, took the 82nd seat and was assigned to guard the first pass on the southern approach to the mountain. Readers should understand that although Song Wan was no fierce general capable of charging enemy lines and commanding a front alone, guarding passes and stockades was still a real contribution to Liangshan's defenses. The stronghold also needed mature, prudent leaders who faithfully attended to their duties.

Song Wan and Du Qian had been inseparable since Liangshan's founding and shared a deep bond. In the stronghold they were often named together and advanced or withdrew as a pair, becoming its best-known veteran duo. Both were extraordinarily tall, and their nicknames, Vajra in the Clouds and Touching the Sky, formed an amusing match.

After the court granted amnesty, Song Wan served with the army against the Liao, Tian Hu, Wang Qing and Fang La. The southern campaign against Fang La was bitterly fought and cost Liangshan many heroes; it also brought Song Wan's doom. During the assault on Runzhou, Liangshan's troops clashed with Fang La's forces. Cavalry surged through the confused fighting, and Song Wan was caught beneath the horses and trampled to death, giving his life in imperial service. Poor old hero of the founding days: he had held Liangshan since Wang Lun's time, served through the rule of Chao Gai and Song Jiang and campaigned north and south, only to die horribly beneath the hooves of battling horses outside Runzhou. After Song Jiang brought the army home, he remembered the fallen officers and secured honors according to their service; Song Wan was among those commemorated.

Looking back on Song Wan's life, we find one of Liangshan's oldest founders, yet a man of modest gifts who remained among the earthly stars, quietly guarding passes and serving without any earth-shaking achievement. Nevertheless, he never left Liangshan through the rule of Wang Lun, Chao Gai and Song Jiang. From the first outlaw settlement to the great southern campaign, this veteran accompanied Liangshan from beginning to end. Though Vajra in the Clouds stood as tall as a tower, even he could not escape a soldier's death in Jiangnan. His story leaves the reader with a sigh.
宋万者,梁山泊开山元老之一也。其籍贯出身,原著不甚详载,只知他生得身材高大,凛凛.ja:
宋万は梁山泊草創の功臣の一人である。出身地や生い立ちは原作に詳しく記されず、背が高く、威風堂々たる大男だったことだけが知られている。そのため江湖では「雲裏金剛」と呼ばれた。この四字は、その体の大きさをよく表している。金剛とは仏門を守護する力士で、大きな体と強い力を持つ。「雲裏」は雲の上にまでそびえるほど高く、塔のように堂々とした姿をいう。普通の人が宋万のそばに立てば、天地を支えているかのように感じられたので、この名がついたのである。

宋万は、梁山泊に最も早くから立て籠もった好漢の一人であった。まだ梁山が栄えていなかったころ、寨主は白衣秀士・王倫であった。王倫は科挙に落ちた書生で、心が狭く、人を受け入れることができなかった。梁山の山と水泊という天険を占めながら、大志を持たぬ男である。宋万と摸着天・杜遷は、最初に王倫に従って山へ入り、ともに山寨を築いた頭領であった。梁山の基礎を成したのは、王倫を主とし、杜遷と宋万を補佐とする体制である。のちに旱地忽律・朱貴が加わり、山の下で酒屋を営み、往来の情報を集め、入山する人々を案内した。これが創建当時の梁山泊の姿であり、宋万と杜遷は最古参の功臣といえた。

しかし王倫の度量の狭さが、宋万の境遇にも関わることになる。豹子頭・林沖は高俅に陥れられ、雪の夜に梁山へ登って庇護を求めた。王倫は、その高い武芸によっていずれ自分の地位を奪われるのではないかと恐れ、あれこれ難癖をつけて受け入れず、山を下りて「投名状」を取って来なければ仲間にしないと言い張った。古参の宋万と杜遷も不公正だとは思ったが、立場が低く発言力もなく、同調するばかりで強く争えなかった。のちに晁蓋、呉用、公孫勝、劉唐、阮氏三兄弟の七人が生辰綱を奪い、露見して梁山へ逃れて来たときも、王倫は追い返そうとした。耐えかねた林沖は聚義庁で王倫を斬り、この狭量な寨主を倒した。王倫が死ぬと、皆は晁蓋を新たな主に推した。宋万と杜遷はこの内紛を目の当たりにしたが、もとより分を守る二人は王倫を助けず、自ら進み出ることもなかった。ただ皆とともに晁蓋を擁立し、以後は新しい主の下で落ち着いて命に従った。

晁蓋が梁山を治め、続いて宋江が継ぐと、山寨は日ごとに栄え、百八人の将が集まった。創建からいる宋万は古参ではあったが、武芸や才略はそれほど優れず、地位はかえって後から来た諸将より下になった。大いに席次を定めた際には、地魔星に応じて第八十二位に座し、山前南路の第一関を守る役に就いた。宋万は敵陣へ突入し、一方面を任される猛将ではない。それでも関所や柵を守る仕事は、梁山の防備を確かに支える務めであった。老練で慎重、分を守るこのような頭領も、山寨には欠かせないのである。

宋万と杜遷は草創のころから影のように寄り添い、情誼が最も厚かった。山寨では並んで名を呼ばれ、進退をともにすることが多く、梁山泊を代表する古参の二人組であった。ともに大柄で、一人は「雲裏金剛」、もう一人は「摸着天」といい、そのあだ名も互いに引き立て合っていた。

のちに朝廷の招安を受け、宋万は大軍に従って遼を征し、田虎と王慶を平定し、方臘を討ち、いずれも軍中で働いた。南の方臘討伐は激戦となり、梁山の好漢を数多く失わせたが、宋万の命運もそこで尽きた。大軍が潤州を攻め、方臘軍と入り乱れて戦っていたとき、騎兵が激しく衝突し、宋万は乱戦の馬に踏まれて非業の死を遂げた。王事に殉じたのである。哀れにも、この草創以来の老好漢は、王倫の時代から梁山を守り、晁蓋、宋江の二代の事業を支え、南北に転戦した末、潤州城下の乱軍の馬蹄にかかって惨死した。その最期は実に痛ましい。宋江が凱旋して戦死した将佐を追悼し、功に応じた追贈を受けさせたとき、宋万もその列に含まれた。

宋万の一生を見れば、梁山の創建を担った最古参でありながら、才が抜きんでていなかったため、最後まで地煞に列し、関所を守って黙々と働き、天地を驚かす大功を立てることはなかった。しかし王倫、晁蓋、宋江の三主を経ても梁山を離れず、草莽の創業から大軍の南征まで付き従った。梁山と始終をともにした老将といえよう。雲裏金剛は塔のようにそびえていても、ついには江南で戦死する運命を免れなかった。読む者は嘆息せずにいられない。
宋万者,梁山泊开山元老之一也。其籍贯出身,原著不甚详载,只知他生得身材高大,凛凛.zh_TW:
宋萬者,梁山泊開山元老之一也。其籍貫出身,原著不甚詳載,只知他生得身材高大,凜凜一條大漢,故江湖上送他一個綽號,喚作「雲裡金剛」。這「雲裡金剛」四字,極狀其身軀之偉岸:金剛本是佛門護法力士,身形高大、孔武有力;「雲裡」者,言其高出雲表,望之巍然如塔。尋常人立於宋萬之側,但覺其頂天立地,故得此名。

宋萬乃是梁山泊最早一班坐山的好漢。當初梁山泊未曾興旺之時,寨主乃是白衣秀士王倫。那王倫本是個落第的秀才,心地狹隘,不能容人,雖據著梁山水泊天險,然胸無大志。宋萬與摸著天杜遷二人,是最早跟隨王倫上山、共聚山寨的頭領。論起梁山的根基,王倫為主,杜遷、宋萬為輔,後又添了個旱地忽律朱貴,在山下開酒店、探聽往來訊息、接引上山人馬。這便是梁山泊草創之時的局面。宋萬、杜遷二人,可謂梁山的開山之臣,資格最老。

然王倫器量狹小,這一節便牽連了宋萬的際遇。話說豹子頭林沖,因高俅陷害、雪夜上梁山,前來投奔。王倫恐林沖武藝高強,日後奪了他的位子,百般刁難,不肯收留,定要林沖下山去取個「投名狀」來,方許入夥。宋萬、杜遷身為山寨舊人,雖覺王倫行事不公,然位卑言輕,亦只得隨聲附和,不敢力爭。後來晁蓋、吳用、公孫勝、劉唐、阮氏三雄等七人,劫了生辰綱,事發逃上梁山,王倫又欲推拒。林沖忍無可忍,在聚義廳上火併王倫,手刃了這個心胸狹隘的寨主。王倫既死,眾人推晁蓋為新寨主。這一場火併,宋萬、杜遷皆是親歷者,只是二人素來本分,既不助王倫,亦不曾出頭,惟隨眾擁立晁蓋,自此安心在新主之下聽用。

晁蓋既據梁山,後宋江繼之,梁山泊日益興旺,聚得一百單八將。宋萬這開山的老人,資格雖老,然論武藝才略,實不甚出眾,故在山寨之中,位次反落於後進諸將之後。梁山大排座次,宋萬上應地魔星,坐了第八十二把交椅,職司守把山前南路第一關。看官須知,宋萬雖非衝鋒陷陣、獨當一面的猛將,然他守關把隘、看守寨柵,亦是梁山防務中一份實在的差使。這般老成持重、安分守己的頭領,寨中亦不可少。

宋萬與杜遷二人,自梁山草創便形影相隨,情分最篤,在山寨之中常並稱、同進退,是梁山泊有名的一對老資格頭領。二人皆身材高大,一個喚「雲裡金剛」,一個喚「摸著天」,綽號亦相映成趣。

後來朝廷招安,宋萬隨大軍徵遼、平田虎王慶、討方臘,皆在軍中效力。及至南征方臘,這一場惡戰,梁山好漢折損極眾,宋萬的劫數,也應在此。話說大軍攻打潤州,與方臘軍馬廝殺。亂軍之中,馬軍衝突,宋萬於陣前不幸被亂軍馬匹踐踏,死於非命,歿於王事。可憐這條開山的老好漢,自王倫在時便據守梁山,歷經晁蓋、宋江兩代基業,轉戰南北,末了卻慘死在潤州城下的亂軍馬蹄之間,死得甚是悽慘。宋江班師之後,追念陣亡將佐,論功封贈,宋萬亦在其列。

觀宋萬一生,本是梁山草創之臣,資歷最老,然才不出眾,終居地煞之列,守關把隘,默默效力,不曾有甚驚天動地的大功。然他歷王倫、晁蓋、宋江三主而始終不離梁山,自草莽創業以至大軍南征,可謂與梁山相終始的一員老將。雲裡金剛雖巍然如塔,終亦不免馬革裹屍於江南,讀之令人為之一嘆。

孙二娘者，水浒一百单八将中难得的一员女豪，菜园子张青之妻，落草前与丈夫同在孟州道.en:
Sun Erniang was one of the few female heroes among Water Margin's 108. The wife of Zhang Qing, Gardener, she ran a murderous inn with him at Crossroads Slope on the road to Mengzhou before joining the outlaws, earning their living by selling buns filled with human flesh. She was born into the martial world: her father, the outlaw Sun Yuan, was known as Mountain Yaksha. From childhood he taught her martial skills, and she grew bold and ruthless, with none of the conventional softness expected of a woman. Broad-browed and large-eyed, with a round face and thick waist, she acted fiercely and struck cruelly. At Crossroads Slope she drugged the food and drink sold to passing travelers. The fleshy victims became bun filling, while the lean ones were thrown into the ditch. Her name terrified the martial world, which called her Female Yaksha. A yaksha is already a fearsome spirit; the added word "female" captured her savage looks and merciless hands, as fierce as any man's. The tale describes danger concealed beneath the sign outside her inn. Many travelers unknowingly drank her drug, lost their lives and had their flesh carved up for buns. Her methods were horrifying indeed.

Her first connection with Liangshan came through Wu Song. Tattooed and exiled to Mengzhou, he passed Crossroads Slope and entered the Female Yaksha's deadly inn. Seeing this powerful man accompanied by two escorting officers, Sun Erniang formed an evil plan, drugged the wine and urged him to drink. Wu Song was extraordinarily alert. He detected something wrong and pretended to be drunk; when she came to carry him away, he seized her and pinned her to the ground, nearly killing her. At that critical moment Zhang Qing returned. Recognizing a hero of Wu Song's caliber, he quickly called his wife off, bowed and apologized, and revived the two officers. The three then pledged themselves as sworn kin. Sun Erniang and Zhang Qing admired Wu Song's iron courage, while he respected their loyalty. Crossroads Slope thereafter became a stopping place for traveling heroes. Later, after Wu Song's bloody attack at Mandarin Duck Tower left him a fugitive, the couple again found a way to save him. They disguised him as a wandering Buddhist practitioner and supplied monastic papers, robes, a bowl and ordination sabers. The familiar ascetic appearance of Pilgrim Wu Song thus came from Sun Erniang's hands. Sheltering him and arranging this disguise best displayed her courage, resourcefulness and loyalty.

Though Sun Erniang and her husband ran a deadly inn, they observed the martial world's code and did everything possible to protect true heroes in trouble. Lu Zhishen, Shi Jin and others also received their shelter at Crossroads Slope. Later, as Song Jiang's three assaults on Zhu Family Manor, the commotion at Mount Hua and other great events increased Liangshan's power, the couple closed their business and joined the stronghold at Liangshan Marsh. Once there, Sun Erniang shared its affairs with Gu Dasao, Hu Sanniang and the other women, bringing the expertise of her former trade. At the great assembly she took the 103rd seat as the Earthly Star of Vigor. Together with Zhang Qing she managed the western mountain inn, gathering news from travelers in all directions, welcoming heroes seeking admission and questioning suspected spies. Ordinary though it appeared, the inn was vital to Liangshan's network of eyes and ears. Sun Erniang remained as forceful and watchful as ever, guarding this gateway without leaving a gap.

After the amnesty, Sun Erniang followed the army through campaigns against the Great Liao, Tian Hu and Wang Qing, and finally south against Fang La. Though a woman commander, she yielded nothing to men in battle, often fighting shoulder to shoulder with Zhang Qing as they protected each other. But the Fang La campaign brought perilous terrain and many fierce enemy generals. More than half Liangshan's heroes were killed or wounded, staining the southeast with their blood. Sun Erniang's end came in that terrible war. During the attack on Qingxi County, as the army fought Fang La's loyalists, his officer Du Wei struck her with a throwing knife amid the confusion, and she died at the front. Skilled in concealed throwing blades, Du Wei attacked without warning in the melee. Caught unprepared, she fell victim to him. The Female Yaksha who had ruled Crossroads Slope and drugged countless travelers ultimately died by an enemy's hidden weapon. She and Zhang Qing both perished in the final stages of Fang La's defeat and never enjoyed the rewards that followed amnesty. That round-faced, thick-waisted and ruthless innkeeper was scattered with Liangshan's stars among Jiangnan's mountains and rivers. Only the name Female Yaksha remained to recall the old martial-world tales of her struggle with Wu Song and her part in making him a pilgrim.
孙二娘者，水浒一百单八将中难得的一员女豪，菜园子张青之妻，落草前与丈夫同在孟州道.ja:
孫二娘は、水滸の百八人の中でも数少ない女傑の一人で、菜園子・張青の妻である。山賊となる前は、夫と孟州への道にある十字坡で人を殺す宿屋を営み、人肉饅頭を売って暮らしていた。もとより江湖の生まれで、父は山夜叉・孫元という緑林の好漢であった。幼いころから父の教えを受けて武芸を身につけ、激しく容赦のない気性となり、普通の女に期待される淑やかさとは無縁だった。太い眉と大きな目、丸い顔と太い腰を持ち、振る舞いは獰猛、手口は残忍であった。十字坡で旅の商人にしびれ薬を飲ませ、倒れた者のうち太った者は饅頭の具にし、痩せた者は川溝へ捨てた。その名を聞けば江湖の誰もが恐れたので、「母夜叉」と呼ばれた。夜叉だけでも恐ろしい神であるのに、さらに母の字を付けた名は、男にも劣らぬ凶相と荒々しい手並みを示している。作中の十字坡の店は、表の看板の下に殺意を隠していた。多くの旅人が薬を飲み、わけもわからぬまま命を落とし、肉を削がれて饅頭にされた。その毒辣さはまことに恐ろしい。

孫二娘が梁山と縁を結ぶ最初の相手は武松であった。孟州へ刺配される武松は十字坡を通り、母夜叉の店に入った。孫二娘は、たくましい武松が二人の護送役を伴っているのを見て悪心を起こし、酒にしびれ薬を混ぜて勧めた。だが武松はきわめて機敏で、早くから不審を見抜き、酔ったふりをした。孫二娘が担ぎ上げに来ると、逆につかんで地面へ押し倒し、危うく命を奪うところであった。その瀬戸際に張青が帰り、武松ほどの好漢だと知って、急いで妻を制し、身を低くして詫び、二人の役人も介抱した。三人はそこで義兄弟の契りを結んだ。夫婦は武松を鉄のような男と敬い、武松も二人の義気を認めた。それ以来、十字坡は江湖の好漢が立ち寄る場所となった。のちに武松が鴛鴦楼を血に染めて逃亡したときも、夫婦が救う方法を考え、行者の姿に変装させ、度牒、衣、鉢、戒刀を与えた。「行者武松」の頭陀姿は、まさに孫二娘の手によるものである。武松をかくまい、行者に仕立てたこの一件にこそ、彼女の胆力と義気がよく表れている。

人を殺す店を営んではいたが、孫二娘夫婦も江湖の道義は重んじ、本物の好漢が難に遭えば力の限り助けた。魯智深や史進らも、十字坡で庇護を受けたことがある。宋江の三度の祝家荘攻めや西岳華山の騒動などを経て梁山の勢いが増すと、張青と孫二娘は十字坡の商売を畳み、ともに水泊梁山の大寨へ加わった。入山後、孫二娘は女将として、またこの仕事に通じる者として、顧大嫂や扈三娘らと山寨の務めを分担した。大集会で席次が定まると、第百三位、地壮星に応じ、夫と西山の酒屋を預かった。各地を往来する者から情報を集め、入山を望む好漢を迎え、通行する間者を問いただした。一見普通の酒屋でも、梁山の耳目を支える要所である。そこに座する孫二娘は、相変わらず気が強く警戒も鋭く、入口を隙なく守り抜いた。

招安後、孫二娘は大軍に従って転戦し、北の大遼を征し、田虎、王慶を掃討し、最後には南の方臘を討った。女将ながら戦場では男に引けを取らず、張青と肩を並べて戦い、互いの左右を守ることが多かった。しかし方臘討伐では、江南の山河が険しい上に敵にも猛将が多く、梁山の好漢は半数以上が死傷し、東南を血に染めた。孫二娘も、この凄惨な征討の中で最期を迎えた。大軍が清渓県を攻め、方臘の腹心たちと激しく戦う中、孫二娘は敵将・杜微の投げ刀を受け、戦場に倒れた。杜微は飛刀という暗器を得意とし、混戦で不意を突いたため、彼女は対処する間もなく毒手にかかった。十字坡を支配し、無数の江湖の客をしびれ倒した母夜叉が、最後は敵将の暗器に命を奪われたのである。夫の張青ともども方臘平定の最終段階で死に、招安後の栄華を分かち合うことはできなかった。丸顔で腰が太く、容赦なく手を下した十字坡の荒々しい女は、梁山の星々が散るのとともに江南の山水へ消えた。ただ「母夜叉」の三字が残り、武松との格闘や行者への変装という、かつての江湖の物語を後世にしのばせるのである。
孙二娘者，水浒一百单八将中难得的一员女豪，菜园子张青之妻，落草前与丈夫同在孟州道.zh_TW:
孫二孃者，水滸一百單八將中難得的一員女豪，菜園子張青之妻，落草前與丈夫同在孟州道十字坡開一家黑店，賣人肉饅頭為生。其人本是江湖出身，父親乃綠林中一條好漢，喚作山夜叉孫元，孫二孃自幼得了父親的傳授，一身武藝，潑辣狠辣，全無尋常女子的脂粉氣。她生得粗眉大眼，胖麵肥腰，行事兇悍，下手狠毒，專一在十字坡上摻了蒙汗藥賣與過往客商，把人麻翻了，肥的做饅頭餡，瘦的填了河溝，江湖上提起她，無不膽寒，因送她一個諢號，喚作「母夜叉」。夜叉本是凶神，再加一個母字，正狀其兇相狠手、不讓鬚眉的潑悍。書中寫她那十字坡的店面，門前招幌之下，暗藏殺機，多少江湖客人吃了她的麻藥，糊里糊塗送了性命，剮了肉做饅頭，其手段之毒，端的駭人。

孫二孃與梁山結緣，先在武松身上。武松刺配孟州，途經十字坡，正撞著這母夜叉的黑店。孫二孃見武松生得雄壯，又押著兩個公人，便起了歹心，將蒙汗藥摻在酒裡勸他吃。武松何等機警，早看出蹊蹺，假意吃醉，待孫二孃上前來扛他，反一把揪住，按翻在地，險些就送了她的性命。正在這危急關頭，張青歸來，見了武松這般好漢，連忙喝住妻子，倒身陪話，又解了那兩個公人。三人就此結為兄弟，孫二孃與張青敬武松是條鐵打的漢子，武松也佩服這夫妻的義氣，自此十字坡成了江湖好漢往來的一處落腳之地。後來武松血濺鴛鴦樓，亡命天涯，又是孫二孃夫妻設法相救，把他打扮做個行者模樣，與了一身度牒衣缽戒刀，「行者武松」這副頭陀打扮，正是出於孫二孃之手。這一段安頓武松、改扮行者，最見孫二孃的膽識與義氣。

孫二孃夫妻雖開黑店，卻也講江湖道義，凡是真正的好漢落難，他們必盡力周全。魯智深、史進等人，也都曾在十字坡受過他們的庇護。後來宋江三打祝家莊、鬧西嶽華山種種大事，梁山聲勢日盛，張青、孫二孃夫妻遂收了十字坡的營生，一同投奔水泊梁山，入了大寨。孫二孃上山之後，因是女流，又精於此道，便與顧大嫂、扈三娘等一班女將分掌寨中事務。梁山大聚義，排定座次，孫二孃坐了第一百零三把交椅，上應地壯星，與丈夫張青一同執掌西山酒店，專一打聽四方往來訊息，迎接來投的好漢，盤問過往的奸細。這酒店看似尋常，實是梁山耳目所繫的緊要去處，孫二孃坐鎮於此，潑辣依舊，警覺依舊，把那門戶守得滴水不漏。

招安以後，孫二孃隨大軍轉戰，北征大遼，復掃田虎、王慶，終而南討方臘。她雖為女將，臨陣卻不輸男兒，每與張青並肩廝殺，照應左右。怎奈徵方臘一役，江南山水險惡，方臘麾下亦多悍將，梁山好漢死傷過半，血染東南。孫二孃的結局，便歿於這一場慘烈的征伐之中。大軍攻打清溪縣，與方臘死黨廝並，亂軍之中，孫二孃被方臘的部將杜微以飛刀所傷，竟死於陣前。那杜微善使一手飛刀暗器，於混戰裡出其不意，孫二孃措手不及，遂遭了毒手。一員叱吒十字坡、麻翻無數江湖客的母夜叉，到頭來死在敵將的暗器之下，與丈夫張青皆歿於平方臘的最後關頭，未能同享招安後的榮華。十字坡那個胖麵肥腰、下手狠辣的潑辣婆娘，終究隨著梁山的星散，零落在了江南的山水之間，徒留「母夜叉」三字，供後人追想她當年按翻武松、改扮行者的那一段江湖舊事。

病尉迟孙立，祖贯琼州人氏，后来落籍登州，乃梁山泊七十二地煞之一，应地勇星，坐第三.en:
Sun Li, Sick Yuchi, was originally from Qiongzhou and later settled in Dengzhou. One of Liangshan Marsh's Seventy-Two Earthly Stars, he embodied the Earthly Star of Courage and held the 39th seat, serving as a junior cavalry general and long-range scouting commander. His face had a yellowish, slightly sickly look, but he wielded a steel whip superbly and was skilled with a long spear. An accomplished warrior, he excelled in both mounted combat and archery. His appearance and abilities recalled the famous Tang general Yuchi Gong, courtesy name Jingde; his unhealthy complexion added the word "Sick" to his nickname. Before joining Liangshan, he was Dengzhou's military commandant, overseeing its mounted and infantry troops, a hero who began as an imperial officer.

Sun Li's younger brother was Sun Xin, Little Yuchi, whose wife was the celebrated female warrior Gu Dasao, Female Tiger. Through this network of relatives, they were also bound by life-and-death loyalty to two hunters from the hills below Dengzhou: the brothers Xie Zhen and Xie Bao, known to Yang Xiong, Sick Guan Suo, and caught up in the case of Old Master Mao. Ordered by the prefect to hunt a tiger, the brothers killed it, only for the wealthy local Mao to steal the credit, falsely accuse them of robbery and have them imprisoned under sentence of death. Furious at the news, Gu Dasao resolved to break her two cousins out. She approached Sun Xin and had others persuade Sun Li. As a serving commandant, Sun Li was reluctant to rebel and hesitated repeatedly. In the end, Gu Dasao pressed the duty of blood kinship, while Yue He, Iron Whistle, and others arranged help inside and outside the prison. Sun Li hardened his resolve, abandoned his post and joined Sun Xin, Gu Dasao, Xie Zhen, Xie Bao, Yue He, Zou Yuan and Zou Run in the Dengzhou prison break and rescue. The party then fought its way toward Liangshan. Thus the eight members of the Dengzhou group came to the mountain, with Sun Li as their leading figure.

They arrived while Song Jiang's three assaults on Zhu Family Manor were at a critical stage. The manor had employed the exceptionally skilled instructor Luan Tingyu, Iron Staff, and Liangshan had suffered repeated setbacks. By a fortunate coincidence, Luan Tingyu and Sun Li had studied under the same master. Delighted to learn this, Wu Yong devised a feigned submission to coordinate an attack from within and without. Sun Li claimed to be Dengzhou's commandant, transferred to help arrest the Liangshan bandits, and led his party into Zhu Family Manor under that pretext. Recalling his shared training with Luan Tingyu, he won the complete trust of the Zhu family. On the day of Liangshan's main assault, Sun Li, Sun Xin, Gu Dasao, Yue He and their companions rose inside the estate, set fires and fought to seize the gates. Sun Li himself captured one of the manor's three outstanding young warriors at the front. The supposedly impregnable stronghold fell at last. His deception at Zhu Family Manor was the first great achievement of his life and the decisive move in the three assaults. Yet he could not be entirely free of guilt, for his fellow disciple Luan Tingyu died in the confused fighting caused by the plan.

At Liangshan's great assembly and ranking of the heroes, Sun Li placed among the highest earthly stars, 39th overall. He remained a cavalry commander and often led his Dengzhou companions on scouting missions and charges. In the fierce campaigns that twice beat Tong Guan and three times defeated Gao Qiu, he took the field with his whip and contributed substantially. He was a steady, dependable fighting general.

After the amnesty, Sun Li followed Song Jiang north against the Liao and south against Fang La, frequently leading his soldiers into hard battle. Remarkably, although the southern campaign cost more than half the 108 heroes, he was among the few who emerged unharmed. His family circle met different fates: Sun Xin and Gu Dasao survived, while Xie Zhen and Xie Bao fell in action. When Fang La was defeated and the army returned to court, Sun Li received the rank of Wuyi Lang and an appointment as commander over the circuits. Taking Sun Xin, Gu Dasao and his other relatives, he returned to Dengzhou for service and lived out his days as an official. A hero who began as Dengzhou's commandant and made a long detour through Liangshan thus ended where he had begun, one of the tale's few fortunate survivors.
病尉迟孙立，祖贯琼州人氏，后来落籍登州，乃梁山泊七十二地煞之一，应地勇星，坐第三.ja:
病尉遅・孫立は、祖先の地を瓊州とし、のちに登州へ移り住んだ。梁山泊七十二地煞の一人、地勇星に応じて第三十九位に座し、馬軍小彪将兼遠方偵察の頭領を務めた。顔色はやや黄色く、少し病人めいていたが、鋼鞭を巧みに使い、長槍にも慣れ、武芸に優れて騎射ともに精しかった。姿と腕前が唐の名将・尉遅恭、字は敬徳に似ており、そこに病相が加わって、江湖では「病尉遅」と呼ばれた。もとは登州の兵馬提轄で、一州の騎兵と歩兵を率いる、朝廷の武官出身の好漢である。

弟は小尉遅・孫新といい、その妻は有名な女将、母大虫・顧大嫂であった。この一族は縁戚を通じ、登州の山裾に住む二人の猟師とも生死をともにする情誼を結んでいた。病関索・楊雄の旧知で、毛太公の事件に巻き込まれた解珍、解宝の兄弟である。二人は登州知府の命令で虎狩りに出て大虫を仕留めたが、土地の富豪・毛太公に手柄を奪われ、逆に盗賊だと訴えられ、命を狙われて死牢に入れられた。知らせを聞いた顧大嫂は激怒し、二人の従弟を救うため牢破りを決意した。孫新を訪ね、さらに人を頼んで孫立を説得させた。提轄として官職にあった孫立は、たやすく朝廷に背くことをためらい、何度も迷った。だが顧大嫂が血縁の大義をもって迫り、鉄叫子・楽和らの内外からの協力も整うと、ついに覚悟を決めた。官職を捨て、孫新、顧大嫂、解珍、解宝、楽和、鄒淵、鄒潤らと登州の牢を破って解兄弟を救い、梁山泊を目指して走った。これが登州系八人の入山の由来で、孫立はその一団を率いる人物であった。

孫立が梁山へ来たのは、宋江の三度の祝家荘攻めが難局にある時だった。祝家荘は、武芸絶倫の師範、鉄棒・欒廷玉を迎えて守りを固め、梁山は何度攻めても損害を受けていた。ところが偶然にも、欒廷玉と孫立は同じ師に学んだ兄弟弟子であった。これを知った呉用は喜び、偽りの帰投によって内外から呼応する策を立てた。孫立は、梁山の賊を捕らえるため派遣された登州兵馬提轄という名目で一行を率い、祝家荘を頼るふりをして中へ入った。欒廷玉と同門の旧情を語り、祝家の父子から疑いのない信頼を得た。梁山軍の総攻撃の日、孫立、孫新、顧大嫂、楽和らは荘内で呼応し、各所に火を放ち、門を奪って戦った。孫立はさらに自ら陣前で祝家荘の三傑の一人を生け捕りにし、難攻不落を誇った荘を一挙に破った。この「孫立の偽装帰投による祝家荘攻略」は、生涯最初の大功であり、三度の攻撃を決する最も大切な一手でもあった。ただし、この策によって兄弟子の欒廷玉が乱軍の中で死んだため、孫立の心にも後ろめたさが残った。

梁山の大集会で英雄の席次が定まると、孫立は地煞の上位、全体で第三十九位に列した。引き続き馬軍の頭領となり、登州の仲間を率いて偵察や突撃に出ることが多かった。童貫を二度破り、高俅を三度退けた激戦では、いずれも鞭を構えて戦場へ進み、大いに働いた。堅実で信頼できる戦将であった。

招安後、孫立は宋江の大軍に従って北の遼を征し、南の方臘を平らげ、たびたび兵に先んじて激戦に身を投じた。百八人の半数以上が江南で失われる中、孫立は無事に帰れた数少ない者の一人である。弟の孫新、弟嫁の顧大嫂、戦死した解珍、解宝と、一門の中でも生死は分かれた。方臘が平定され、軍が朝廷へ戻ると、功に応じて武奕郎、諸路都統領の職を授けられた。孫新、顧大嫂ら親族を伴って登州へ帰り、任用されて官吏のまま老後を送った。登州の提轄から身を起こし、梁山を経由した好漢が、最後には登州へ戻ったのである。この物語では珍しい、穏やかな結末を得た人物といえよう。
病尉迟孙立，祖贯琼州人氏，后来落籍登州，乃梁山泊七十二地煞之一，应地勇星，坐第三.zh_TW:
病尉遲孫立，祖貫瓊州人氏，後來落籍登州，乃梁山泊七十二地煞之一，應地勇星，坐第三十九把交椅，為馬軍小彪將兼遠探出哨頭領。此人生得面色微黃、有幾分病容，卻使得一手好鋼鞭、慣使長槍，武藝高強、騎射俱精；因相貌、本事頗類唐時名將尉遲恭尉遲敬德，而面帶病容，故江湖上送他一個諢名「病尉遲」。他原是登州兵馬提轄，統領一州馬步軍兵，正是個朝廷武官出身的好漢。

孫立有個兄弟喚作小尉遲孫新，孫新的渾家便是那有名的女將母大蟲顧大嫂。這一門連枝帶親，又與登州山下的兩個獵戶結下生死交情——便是病關索楊雄的舊識、毛太公一案中的解珍、解寶兩兄弟。解珍、解寶奉登州知府之命上山獵虎，打得大蟲卻被本鄉富戶毛太公賴了功勞、反誣陷他二人是強盜，下在死牢裡要害性命。顧大嫂聞知，怒髮衝冠，便要劫牢救這兩個表弟。她尋上孫新、又央人去說動孫立：當時孫立身為提轄、官身在體，本不肯輕易反了朝廷，幾番躊躇；終是顧大嫂以血親大義相逼、又有鐵叫子樂和等裡應外合，孫立這才橫下一條心，棄了官職，同孫新、顧大嫂、解珍、解寶、樂和、鄒淵、鄒潤等一干人馬劫了登州大牢、救出解氏弟兄，殺奔梁山泊投奔而來。這便是登州一系八人上山的來歷，孫立正是這一夥的領頭人物。

孫立投梁山，正撞著宋江三打祝家莊打得吃緊。原來祝家莊請了一位武藝絕倫的教師鐵棒欒廷玉坐鎮，梁山幾番攻打皆吃了虧。說來也巧，這欒廷玉與孫立竟是同師學藝的師兄弟！吳用聞知大喜，便定下一條「裡應外合」的詐降之計：教孫立打著「登州兵馬提轄奉調緝捕梁山草寇」的旗號，引著一行人馬假意投奔祝家莊、住進莊內，與欒廷玉敘了同門之誼，騙得祝氏父子深信不疑。到得梁山大軍總攻之日，孫立、孫新、顧大嫂、樂和等人在莊內裡應、四下放火、奪門廝殺，孫立更親自陣前活捉了祝家莊三傑之一，這才一舉攻破了號稱固若金湯的祝家莊。這「孫立詐降破祝家莊」，正是他平生第一樁大功，也是三打祝家莊中最緊要的一著。只是欒廷玉這個師兄因這場計策死於亂軍，孫立心中亦不無愧色。

梁山大聚義、英雄排座次時，孫立位列地煞之首數員、總數第三十九位，仍充馬軍頭領，常領登州一夥弟兄出哨衝陣。兩贏童貫、三敗高俅諸番惡戰，孫立皆挺鞭上陣、出力不少，是一員穩當可靠的戰將。

受了招安之後，孫立隨宋江大軍北征遼國、南平方臘，每每身先士卒、鏖戰疆場。難得的是，這一百單八將下江南折損過半，孫立卻是得以全身而退的有數幾人之一；他那兄弟孫新、弟媳顧大嫂、連同解珍解寶中陣亡的，一門之內死生各異。方臘既平、班師還朝，論功行賞，孫立得授武奕郎、諸路都統領之職，仍帶了孫新、顧大嫂等親眷，回登州原籍任用、為官終老。一員從登州提轄起家、繞道梁山的好漢，到頭來仍舊歸了登州，倒也算得這部書裡難得的善終之人。

小尉迟孙新，祖贯琼州人氏，本是军户出身，后来落籍登州，乃梁山泊一百单八将中应地数.en:
Sun Xin, Little Yuchi, came from a military household originally rooted in Qiongzhou and later settled in Dengzhou. Among Liangshan Marsh's 108 heroes he embodied the Earthly Star of Numbers and held the 100th seat. His elder brother was Sun Li, Sick Yuchi, Dengzhou's military commandant. Both brothers were accomplished warriors, familiar with spear and staff and skilled in mounted archery. Sun Xin somewhat resembled the famous Tang general Yuchi Gong, courtesy name Jingde. Since he was the younger brother, the martial world named him Little Yuchi rather than Great Yuchi, neatly matching his brother's Sick Yuchi. His wife was the celebrated heroine Gu Dasao, Female Tiger. Instead of serving as officials in the city, the couple ran an inn outside Dengzhou. People from every walk of life passed through, bringing them many friends in the martial world and making their inn a well-known meeting place below Dengzhou's hills.

Sun Xin's road to Liangshan began with the righteous prison break at Dengzhou. Gu Dasao had two younger cousins, the famous local hunters Xie Zhen, Two-Headed Snake, and Xie Bao, Double-Tailed Scorpion. Ordered by the prefect to hunt a tiger, the brothers wounded a fierce white-browed beast, which rolled into the estate of the wealthy Old Master Mao. Wanting to claim the reward, Mao dishonestly took the credit and accused the brothers of daylight robbery and attacking his house. Colluding with the authorities, he had them tortured into false confessions and placed on death row, intending to kill them. Furious that her cousins had suffered such an injustice and were near death, Gu Dasao resolved to break them out. She first consulted Sun Xin, then asked him to persuade Sun Li. As a commandant and serving official, Sun Li was unwilling to rebel lightly and repeatedly hesitated or refused. But Gu Dasao pressed him with their duty to blood relatives. Yue He, Iron Whistle, would help from inside the prison, while Zou Yuan, his nephew Zou Run and the other heroes would act outside. Sun Li finally made up his mind and abandoned his office. Sun Xin, Sun Li, Gu Dasao, Yue He, Zou Yuan, Zou Run and their companions then broke into the Dengzhou jail, freed the Xie brothers and killed Mao's entire household. Together they set out for Liangshan. Thus the eight heroes of the Dengzhou group came to the mountain, with Sun Xin playing a vital part.

Their arrival coincided with a difficult stage in Song Jiang's three assaults on Zhu Family Manor. The manor had recruited the extraordinary martial instructor Luan Tingyu, Iron Staff, and Liangshan had suffered in its repeated attacks. By chance, Luan Tingyu and Sun Li had studied under the same master. Delighted, Wu Yong devised a false submission: Sun Li would claim to be Dengzhou's military commandant, transferred to hunt down the bandits, and lead Sun Xin, Gu Dasao, Yue He, Xie Zhen, Xie Bao and the others into Zhu Family Manor under that pretext. They would lodge inside and await their chance. On the day of Liangshan's full assault, Sun Xin followed his family in setting fires throughout the estate, seizing gates and fighting in coordination with the attackers outside. The apparently impregnable manor fell in one decisive effort. Sun Xin contributed greatly to this victory from within and without.

At Liangshan's great assembly, Sun Xin was placed among the earthly stars as the Earthly Star of Numbers, occupying the 100th seat. He and Gu Dasao served as army leaders while also managing the stronghold's inns, welcoming traveling heroes and gathering news from all directions. He thus continued the trade he had practiced in Dengzhou. In the fierce campaigns that twice defeated Tong Guan and three times overcame Gao Qiu, he also fought alongside his Dengzhou companions.

After the amnesty, Sun Xin followed the army north and south through bitter fighting against the Liao, Tian Hu, Wang Qing and finally Fang La in Jiangnan. More than half the 108 heroes were lost in the southern campaign, yet Sun Xin, his brother Sun Li and his wife Gu Dasao were among the few to come through unharmed. After Fang La's defeat and the army's return to court, rewards were distributed according to merit. Accompanying Sun Li and taking Gu Dasao with him, Sun Xin returned to Dengzhou for service and lived out his days in office. A hero who left a Dengzhou inn and took a long road through Liangshan thus came home at last, one of the few people in the story to enjoy a peaceful end.
小尉迟孙新，祖贯琼州人氏，本是军户出身，后来落籍登州，乃梁山泊一百单八将中应地数.ja:
小尉遅・孫新は、祖先の地を瓊州とする軍戸の生まれで、のちに登州へ移り住んだ。梁山泊百八人のうち地数星に応じ、第百位に座した好漢である。実の兄は、登州兵馬提轄で「病尉遅」と呼ばれる孫立だった。兄弟はいずれも武芸に長け、槍棒を使い慣れ、騎射にも精しかった。孫新の姿は唐の名将・尉遅恭、字は敬徳にいくらか似ていたが、弟で年も若かったため、江湖では「大尉遅」ではなく「小尉遅」と呼ばれた。兄の「病尉遅」と対になるあだ名である。妻は、名高い女傑「母大虫」こと顧大嫂であった。夫婦は城内で官に仕えるのではなく、登州城外で酒屋を営んだ。店にはさまざまな身分の者が往来し、多くの江湖の友を得て、登州の山裾でもよく知られた場所となっていた。

孫新の入山は、登州の牢破りという義挙に始まる。顧大嫂には、城外の名高い猟師である二人の従弟、「両頭蛇」解珍と「双尾蠍」解宝がいた。兄弟は知府の命を受けて虎狩りに出て、吊り上がった目と白い額を持つ大虫に矢を当てたが、虎は土地の富豪・毛太公の屋敷へ転がり落ちた。毛太公は虎の死骸を役所へ持ち出して褒賞を得ようと、良心を捨てて手柄を横取りし、逆に兄弟を、白昼に押し入り暴れた強盗だと訴えた。さらに官府と結託し、拷問で偽りの自白をさせ、死刑囚の牢へ入れて命を奪おうとした。従弟たちが大きな冤罪を受け、命が危ういと知った顧大嫂は激怒し、牢を破って救うことを決めた。まず夫の孫新に相談し、兄の孫立を説得するよう頼んだ。官職にある孫立は、たやすく朝廷に背くことを嫌い、何度も迷って断った。しかし顧大嫂が血縁の大義をもって強く迫り、鉄叫子・楽和が牢内で、鄒淵と甥の鄒潤らが外で呼応する手はずも整ったので、ついに覚悟を決め、官職を捨てた。孫新は兄、妻、楽和、鄒淵、鄒潤らと登州の牢を破り、解兄弟を救い、毛太公の一家を皆殺しにして、そのまま梁山へ走った。これが登州系八人の好漢の入山の由来であり、孫新はその重要な一人だった。

一行が梁山へ来たのは、宋江の三度の祝家荘攻めが難局にある時であった。祝家荘は武芸絶倫の師範、鉄棒・欒廷玉を迎えて守り、梁山は何度も損害を受けていた。ところが欒廷玉と孫立は同じ師に学んだ兄弟弟子だった。これを知った呉用は喜び、偽りの帰投の策を立てた。孫立が、賊の捕縛に派遣された登州兵馬提轄を名乗り、孫新、顧大嫂、楽和、解珍、解宝らを率いて祝家荘を頼るふりをし、中へ入って内応するのである。梁山軍の総攻撃の日、孫新は兄たちとともに荘内の各所に火を放ち、門を奪って戦い、内外から呼応して、堅固を誇った祝家荘を一挙に破った。この大功に、孫新も少なからぬ力を尽くした。

梁山の大集会で席次が定まると、孫新は地煞に列し、地数星として第百位に座した。妻の顧大嫂とともに軍中の頭領となり、山寨の酒屋を営み、往来する好漢を迎え、各地の情報を集める仕事も担当した。登州での商売を引き続き務めたのである。童貫を二度破り、高俅を三度退けた激戦でも、登州の仲間たちと出陣して働いた。

招安後、孫新は大軍と南北へ出征し、遼を征し、田虎と王慶を平定し、江南で方臘を討って、激戦を重ねた。百八人の半数以上が江南で失われたにもかかわらず、孫新は兄の孫立、妻の顧大嫂と同じく、無事に戻れた数少ない者の一人であった。方臘が平定され、軍が朝廷へ帰って功に応じた褒賞が与えられると、孫新は妻を連れ、兄とともに故郷の登州へ戻って任用され、官吏として老後を送った。登州の酒屋を出て梁山を経由した好漢が、最後には登州の土へ帰ったのである。この物語では珍しく、穏やかな最期を得た人物といえよう。
小尉迟孙新，祖贯琼州人氏，本是军户出身，后来落籍登州，乃梁山泊一百单八将中应地数.zh_TW:
小尉遲孫新，祖貫瓊州人氏，本是軍戶出身，後來落籍登州，乃梁山泊一百單八將中應地數星的好漢，坐第一百把交椅。他有個嫡親哥哥，便是那登州兵馬提轄、綽號「病尉遲」的孫立。孫家弟兄兩個皆有一身好武藝，慣使槍棒、精熟騎射；孫新生得與唐時名將尉遲恭尉遲敬德有幾分相似，又因排行在弟、年紀較輕，江湖上便不叫他「大尉遲」，單送他一個諢名，喚作「小尉遲」，正與他哥哥那「病尉遲」的諢號配作一對。孫新的渾家，便是那有名的女中豪傑、綽號「母大蟲」的顧大嫂；夫妻兩個不在城裡做官，卻在登州城外開著一座酒店度日，店裡往來三教九流，結識了不少江湖上的朋友，是登州山下一處有名的去處。

孫新上梁山，緣起於登州劫牢一樁義舉。原來顧大嫂有兩個表弟，便是登州城外的兩個出名獵戶——綽號「兩頭蛇」的解珍、綽號「雙尾蠍」的解寶。解氏弟兄奉知府之命上山獵虎，打中了一隻吊睛白額大蟲，那虎卻滾落到本鄉富戶毛太公的莊院裡去了。毛太公貪圖虎屍去官府請功，竟昧心賴了功勞，反誣解珍、解寶白晝搶劫、上門行兇，又勾結官府將弟兄兩個屈打成招，下在死囚牢裡，要害他二人性命。顧大嫂聞知表弟蒙了奇冤、性命垂危，怒髮衝冠，便要劫牢救人；她先尋丈夫孫新商議，又央孫新去說動哥哥孫立。那孫立身充提轄、官身在體，本不肯輕易反了朝廷，幾番躊躇推託；終是顧大嫂以血親大義苦苦相逼，又有鐵叫子樂和在牢中裡應、鄒淵鄒潤叔侄等一班好漢外合，孫立這才橫下一條心，棄了官職。於是孫新便同哥哥孫立、渾家顧大嫂、樂和、鄒淵、鄒潤等一干人，劫了登州大牢、救出解氏弟兄、殺了毛太公滿門，一發投奔梁山而來。這便是登州一系八位好漢上山的來歷，孫新正是這一夥裡的緊要人物。

孫新一行投梁山，恰撞著宋江三打祝家莊打得吃緊。那祝家莊請了一位武藝絕倫的教師鐵棒欒廷玉坐鎮，梁山幾番攻打皆吃了虧；偏巧這欒廷玉與孫立竟是同師學藝的師兄弟。吳用聞知大喜，便定下一條詐降之計：教孫立打著「登州兵馬提轄奉調緝捕草寇」的旗號，引著孫新、顧大嫂、樂和、解珍解寶等一行人，假意投奔祝家莊、住進莊內做了內應。到得梁山大軍總攻之日，孫新便隨哥嫂在莊中四下放火、奪門廝殺、裡應外合，一舉破了那固若金湯的祝家莊。這一場裡應外合的大功，孫新出力不少。

梁山大聚義、排定座次時，孫新位列地煞，上應地數星，坐第一百位，與渾家顧大嫂同充軍中頭領，又一併料理山寨裡開設酒店、迎接往來好漢、探聽四方訊息的勾當，仍守著他登州開店的老本行。兩贏童貫、三敗高俅諸番惡戰，他也隨登州一夥弟兄出陣效力。

受了招安之後，孫新隨大軍南征北討，徵遼、平田虎王慶、下江南打方臘，一路鏖戰。難得的是，這一百單八將下江南折損過半，孫新卻與哥哥孫立、渾家顧大嫂一般，皆是得以全身而退的有數幾人。方臘既平、班師還朝，論功行賞，孫新隨哥哥孫立、帶了渾家顧大嫂，一同回登州原籍任用，為官終老。一個從登州酒店裡走出、繞道梁山的好漢，到頭來仍舊歸了登州故土，倒也算得這部書裡難得的善終之人。

索超，绰号「急先锋」，应天罡之数，乃天空星临世。其人原系河北大名府留守司正牌军，.en:
Suo Chao, nicknamed Impatient Vanguard, belonged to the heavenly stars as the earthly incarnation of the Heavenly Star of the Sky. Originally an officer in the garrison headquarters of Daming Prefecture in Hebei, he was a fierce and valiant warrior. His temper was hasty and unyielding: in battle he would charge before receiving orders, always eager to ride out first. Thus the troops called him Impatient Vanguard. His face was dark as the bottom of a cooking pot, his sideburns stiff as steel needles, and his imposing body stood a full eight chi tall. With his gold-dipped battle-axe, he possessed courage that ten thousand men could not withstand.

Suo Chao won fame in a contest on Daming's training ground. Grand Secretary Liang had recently acquired a new subordinate: Yang Zhi, formerly an instructor of the capital's Eight Hundred Thousand Imperial Guards, who had lost the flower-and-stone tribute, killed Niu Er with his saber and been tattooed and exiled to Daming. Admiring his skill and wishing to promote him, Liang reviewed the troops and ordered Zhou Jin to compete against him with bow and spear. Zhou Jin lost both contests. The deputy officer Suo Chao, angry to see his superior beaten, rode out to settle the matter with Yang Zhi himself. Fully armored, the two warriors galloped and clashed before the drill hall, Yang Zhi with a spear and Suo Chao with an axe. They fought more than fifty exchanges without a winner, drawing cheers from the soldiers and Liang alike. Seeing such exceptional fighters, Liang feared one might be injured and ordered the gongs sounded to end the contest. He promoted both to military commandants. From then on, Suo Chao and Yang Zhi stood as equals, their names renowned throughout Hebei.

Later Liangshan's heroes robbed the birthday tribute, and the gathering of Chao Gai's band alarmed the court. When Lu Junyi fell into danger, Song Jiang attacked Daming three times to rescue him and Shi Xiu. As a defending general, Suo Chao fought bravely. It was deep winter, with heavy snow. Unaware of the trap, he rode out to challenge Liangshan's troops. A vanguard warrior met him, but after only a few exchanges Suo Chao was drawn into an ambush. Galloping in pursuit, he and his horse plunged into a prepared pit. Hooked poles hauled him out, and he was taken alive to Liangshan. Song Jiang personally untied him and spoke kindly. Moved by this generosity and righteousness, Suo Chao submitted and joined the band.

On Liangshan, Suo Chao became one of the Eight Cavalry Tigers and Vanguard Commanders. Alongside Yang Zhi, Xu Ning, Zhu Tong, Shi Jin, Mu Hong, Hua Rong and the other brave generals, he specialized in charging enemy formations. At the great assembly he took the prestigious 19th seat as the Heavenly Star of the Sky. His fighting art centered on his great gold-dipped axe, which cut like the wind and struck with immense weight, making him especially suited to leading an assault and breaking the enemy's finest troops. In every major battle he went at the front, sweeping all before him. Hasty though he was, his loyalty and courage were admirable, fully answering the name Impatient Vanguard.

After the amnesty, Suo Chao followed Song Jiang on campaigns north and south. As a vanguard commander against the Liao, he repeatedly distinguished himself and helped his brothers defeat the enemy, returning victorious to court. He later marched against Fang La. That campaign inflicted Liangshan's heaviest losses, and Suo Chao was among the dead. During the assault on Hangzhou, Fang La fielded an exceptional general, State Preceptor Deng Yuanjue, Precious Light Tathagata, who wielded a massive iron monk's staff with extraordinary courage. Seeing him display his prowess, Suo Chao could not restrain his temper. He spurred his horse forward and swung his axe straight at Deng Yuanjue. After only a few exchanges, his eagerness for victory left him at his opponent's mercy. Deng struck him with the staff, shattering his skull and killing him before the armies. Alas that the Impatient Vanguard, famed for half a lifetime, should fall beneath Hangzhou's walls.

Throughout his life, Suo Chao was extraordinarily brave, masterful with his axe and heedless of personal danger in battle, one of Liangshan's rare great warriors. Yet the impatience that made his name also hastened his death. On the training ground, haste brought fame; in the snowy battle, haste brought capture; at Hangzhou, haste brought death. From beginning to end, the same trait made and unmade him. After Song Jiang returned, he set memorial tablets in the Hall of Loyalty and Righteousness to summon the souls of the fallen, and Suo Chao's name stood among them, receiving the incense of later generations. Though he lacked the resourcefulness of Resourceful Star or the astonishing prowess of Pilgrim, his loyal heart and martial skill earned him a place among the heavenly stars. He did not disgrace the name Impatient Vanguard, and his life remains a worthy chapter in Liangshan Marsh's heroic tale.
索超，绰号「急先锋」，应天罡之数，乃天空星临世。其人原系河北大名府留守司正牌军，.ja:
索超は「急先鋒」と呼ばれ、天罡の数に属する天空星の化身である。もとは河北大名府の留守司に属する正牌軍で、勇猛な武将であった。性格はせっかちで剛烈、戦場では命令を待たず、いつも先に馬を出した。そのため軍中で急先鋒と呼ばれたのである。顔は鍋底のように黒く、鬢は鋼の針のように硬く、八尺の堂々たる体を持っていた。金蘸斧を使い、まことに万人も敵わぬ勇気を備えていた。

索超が名を上げたのは、大名府の教練場での武芸試合である。当時、北京大名府の梁中書は新たな配下を得ていた。東京八十万禁軍の教頭だった楊志で、花石綱を失い、刀で牛二を殺したため、この地へ刺配されて来た男であった。梁中書はその武芸を愛し、引き立てようと、教練場で軍馬を閲し、周謹に命じて弓と槍で楊志と勝負させた。周謹が続けて敗れると、副牌軍の索超は上官の敗北に憤り、自ら馬を進めて楊志と雌雄を決しようとした。二将は鎧を整え、馬を躍らせ、楊志は槍、索超は斧を振るい、演武庁の前で往来して激しく戦った。五十余合を重ねても勝敗はつかず、兵たちも梁中書も喝采を送った。二人の見事な武勇を認めた梁中書は、傷つけ合うのを恐れて鉦を鳴らし、戦いを止めさせ、ともに管軍提轄使へ昇進させた。以来、索超と楊志は同格となり、河北に名を轟かせた。

その後、梁山の好漢が生辰綱を奪い、晁蓋らが義を結んだことで朝廷は揺れた。盧俊義が難に遭うと、宋江は彼と石秀を救うため大名府を三度攻めた。両軍が向かい合う中、大名の守将である索超は勇んで出戦した。時は厳冬の大雪。索超は計略と知らず、馬を飛ばして陣を出て、梁山軍に一騎討ちを挑んだ。梁山の先鋒が迎え撃ったが、数合も交えぬうちに索超は伏兵の策にかかった。追いかけて馬を走らせるうち、あらかじめ掘られた落とし穴へ人馬もろとも転落し、鉤で引き上げられて生け捕りとなり、山へ送られた。宋江は自ら縄を解き、優しく慰めた。その義気に感じた索超は梁山に帰順し、仲間入りした。

入山すると、索超は馬軍八驃騎兼先鋒使の一人となり、楊志、徐寧、朱仝、史進、穆弘、花栄らと並ぶ勇将として、突撃を専門に担った。大集会で席次が定まると、天空星に応じて第十九位に座し、高い地位を得た。武芸の中心は大きな金蘸斧で、風のように斬り、重く強い一撃を放った。先陣を切って敵を破り、その精鋭を打ち砕くのに最も適していた。大戦のたびに前軍へ立ち、向かうところをなぎ倒した。気は急いても忠勇は称えるに値し、まさに「急先鋒」の三字にかなっていた。

招安後、索超は宋江に従って南北へ出征した。遼国との戦いでは先鋒としてたびたび功を立て、兄弟たちと遼軍を破り、勝利して朝廷へ帰った。続いて方臘討伐にも加わった。この戦いは梁山に最も大きな損失を与え、索超もその中で殉じた。大軍が杭州を攻めたとき、方臘の配下には、宝光如来の国師・鄧元覚という上将がいた。渾鉄の禅杖を使い、並外れて勇猛な男である。その威勢を見た索超は気を抑えられず、馬を躍らせ、斧を振るって真っ向から向かった。数合も戦わぬうち、勝ちを急ぐあまり逆に制され、鄧元覚の禅杖を受けた。頭を砕かれて陣前に倒れ、その命を終えた。半生の名声を持つ急先鋒が、杭州城下で落命したとは、まことに惜しいことである。

索超は生涯、比類ない剛勇と熟練した斧法を誇り、戦場で身を顧みず奮戦した、梁山でも得難い猛将であった。しかし、その「急」の一字は名を成すと同時に死を早めた。教練場では急いて名を揚げ、雪中の出戦では急いて捕らえられ、杭州では急いて命を失った。その始終を見れば、成功も失敗も同じ性質から生まれたといえる。宋江が凱旋したのち、忠義堂に戦死した諸将の位牌を設けて魂を招くと、索超の名も列せられ、後世の香火を受けた。智多星の機転や行者の神勇には及ばずとも、忠烈の心と武芸によって天罡に入り、急先鋒の名に恥じぬ働きをした。その一生は、梁山泊の豪傑の物語にふさわしい一篇である。
索超，绰号「急先锋」，应天罡之数，乃天空星临世。其人原系河北大名府留守司正牌军，.zh_TW:
索超，綽號「急先鋒」，應天罡之數，乃天空星臨世。其人原系河北大名府留守司正牌軍，一員勇悍驍將。論其性情，急躁剛烈，臨陣不待將令，每每搶先出馬，故軍中以「急先鋒」呼之。觀其形貌：生得面如鍋底，鬢若鋼針，凜凜一軀，堂堂八尺，使一柄金蘸斧，端的有萬夫不當之勇。

索超之出名，在大名府教場比武一節。其時北京大名府梁中書帳下，新得一人，乃東京八十萬禁軍教頭楊志，因失了花石綱、刀殺牛二，刺配至此。梁中書愛其武藝，欲加抬舉，遂於教場點視軍馬，命周謹與楊志比箭、比槍。周謹連敗，副牌軍索超見本管輸了，心中不忿，挺身出馬，要與楊志見個高下。兩將各全裝披掛，縱馬揮兵，楊志使槍，索超使斧，在演武廳前往來衝殺，鬥到五十餘合，不分勝敗。看的眾軍並梁中書，無不喝彩。梁中書見二人英雄了得，恐有傷損，傳令鳴金收軍，就將二人都抬作管軍提轄使。自此索超與楊志同列，名震河北。

後梁山好漢劫了生辰綱，又因晁蓋等聚義，朝廷震動。盧俊義遭難，宋江為救盧俊義、石秀，三打大名府。兩軍對壘，索超身為大名守將，奮勇出戰。其時正值隆冬大雪，索超不知是計，飛馬出陣，單搦梁山人馬廝殺。梁山陣中先鋒出迎，鬥未數合，索超中了埋伏，縱馬追趕之際，陷入預先掘下的陷坑，連人帶馬翻將下去，被撓鉤搭起，活捉上山。宋江見了，親解其縛，溫言撫慰，索超感其義氣，遂歸順梁山，入了夥。

既上梁山，索超位列馬軍八驃騎兼先鋒使之一，與楊志、徐寧、朱仝、史進、穆弘、花榮等同為驍將，專司衝鋒陷陣。梁山大聚義，排定座次，索超應天空星，坐第十九位，地位甚是顯赫。其武藝以一柄金蘸大斧為本，劈砍如風，勢大力沉，最宜於陣前先登破敵、摧鋒折銳。每逢大戰，索超必為前部，所向披靡。其性雖急，然忠勇可嘉，正合「急先鋒」三字。

招安之後，索超隨宋江南北征討。徵遼國，索超身為先鋒，屢立戰功，與眾兄弟共破遼兵，得勝還朝。其後又隨徵方臘。方臘一戰，乃梁山好漢損折最重之役，索超亦殉身其間。其時大軍攻打杭州，方臘麾下有一員上將，乃寶光如來國師鄧元覺，使一條渾鐵禪杖，驍勇異常。索超見其耀武，按捺不住性子，縱馬掄斧，直取鄧元覺。兩將鬥未數合，索超急於求勝，反為所制，被鄧元覺一禪杖打中，腦漿迸裂，死於陣前，結果了性命。可嘆一員急先鋒，半世英名，竟隕於杭州城下。

索超一生，剛勇絕倫，斧法精熟，臨陣奮不顧身，是梁山不可多得的猛將。然其「急」之一字，既成其名，亦促其亡：教場比武，急而揚名；雪天出戰，急而被擒；杭州交鋒，急而喪命。觀其始終，可謂成也在急，敗也在急。後宋江班師，於忠義堂為陣亡諸將設位招魂，索超之名亦列其中，享後人香火。論其為人，雖不及智多星之機變、行者之神勇，然以一腔忠烈、滿身武藝，躋身天罡之列，亦不負「急先鋒」之號，足為梁山泊一段豪傑文章。
